Method: 借鉴生成式潜变量优化：为每位训练者分配一个自由潜向量，通过冻结模型本身进行优化；同时训练编码器预测该潜向量，使新个体仅需一次前向即可获得潜变量，并可在测试时可选地精化。潜向量以软前缀形式注入冻结语言模型。

Result: 在留出个体上，让条件化模型回答中性问题与访谈问题，并用基于真实人类写作训练的打分器读取人格。MBTI 各轴上 PL 的 AUC 优于相同设置下的人格嵌入与提示方法基线，且该排序在三种不同嵌入空间中评分时均保持；用 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 学到的潜向量仅通过新适配器即可将人格迁移至 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。

Conclusion: 人格可由写作数据驱动地学为隐表示，无需标签与画像即可有效控制并跨模型迁移，为个性化语言模型提供可扩展范式。

Abstract: Controlling the personality of a language model usually relies on written profiles or named trait categories, so it can only express what an author writes down or what a taxonomy names. We instead propose Personality Latents (PL), which learn a latent for each person from their own writing, with no personality labels and no authored profile, and inject it into a frozen language model as a soft prefix. Following generative latent optimization, each training person receives a free latent that is optimized through the frozen model itself, while an encoder learns to predict these latents so that a new person needs only one forward pass, with optional refinement at test time. We evaluate on held-out people by having the conditioned model answer neutral and interview questions and reading personality from its answers with scorers trained on real human writing. On the MBTI axes PL reaches an AUC of , ahead of persona embedding and prompt-based baselines under identical settings, and the ranking holds when the answers are scored in three different embedding spaces. A latent learned with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct also transfers personality to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct through a new adapter alone.

</details>


### [156] [Weakness Localization Is Not Enough: State-Aware Recursive Knowledge Improvement for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36811)
*Runze Jiang,Yan Wang,Boran Jin,Bingyu Zhu,Longtao Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出递归知识改进（RKI）框架，将大模型知识改进建模为序贯、状态感知的干预过程，通过图结构化知识单元统一诊断与干预，在多轮中定位弱点、估计知识状态、选择干预并再评估，在两个基准上平均超越现有方法18.41分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法用评估定位模型特定的知识弱点并指导后训练，但"知道改什么"不等于"知道怎么改"。同一局部弱点可能对应不同的操作知识状态（知识不可用、可用但难以可靠访问、可访问但下游无效），即"知识状态混叠"；当不同状态需要不同干预时，仅提高诊断分辨率不足以选择干预。此外，模型更新可能在弱点消失前就改变底层知识状态，使上一轮合适的干预在下一轮失效。

Method: 提出递归知识改进（RKI）：将知识组织为图结构化单元，作为跨轮次诊断评估与定向干预的共享基础；每轮依次执行——定位知识弱点、基于诊断证据与干预历史估计模型的操作知识状态、选择对应干预、并在确定下一步干预前对更新后模型重新评估。

Result: 在HotpotEval与SafeInternalEval上，RKI平均比现有知识注入方法高18.41分；进一步分析表明，知识状态在弱点定位之外为干预选择提供了额外指导，且即使观察到的弱点持续存在，知识状态也可能随模型更新而变化。

Conclusion: 知识改进应从单向的评估引导更新转向状态感知的序贯干预循环：显式估计操作知识状态可解决知识状态混叠问题，逐轮再评估可应对状态漂移，二者共同支撑更有效的定向知识改进。

Abstract: Knowledge improvement in large language models is shifting from predefined knowledge incorporation pipelines toward evaluation-guided updating. Existing methods use evaluation to localize model-specific knowledge weaknesses and guide targeted post-training. However, identifying what to improve does not necessarily provide sufficient information for deciding how to improve it. The same localized weakness can be compatible with distinct operational knowledge states: the relevant knowledge may be unavailable, available but difficult to access reliably, or accessible but ineffective for downstream use. We call this ambiguity knowledge-state aliasing. When compatible states favor different interventions, greater diagnostic resolution alone is insufficient for intervention selection. Moreover, model updates can change the underlying knowledge state before the observed weakness disappears, such that an intervention appropriate in one round may no longer address the bottleneck in the next. To address these challenges, we propose Recursive Knowledge Improvement (RKI), which formulates knowledge improvement as a sequential, state-aware intervention process. RKI organizes knowledge into graph-structured units that provide a shared basis for diagnostic evaluation and targeted intervention across rounds. At each round, RKI localizes knowledge weaknesses, estimates the model's operational knowledge state from diagnostic evidence and intervention history, selects a corresponding intervention, and re-evaluates the updated model before determining the next intervention. On HotpotEval and SafeInternalEval, RKI outperforms existing knowledge incorporation methods by 18.41 points on average. Further analyses show that knowledge states provide additional guidance for intervention selection beyond weakness localization and can change across model updates even when the observed weakness persists.

</details>


### [157] [Words or Deeds? How LLMs Predict Users' Decisions in Human-Agent Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36813)
*Baiqiao Zhang,Shuai Ma,Zhifeng Liao,Chao Zhou,Jianshu Wang,Yuhan Zhao,Chaoyue Zhang,Tongjun Si,Yuying Tang,Xiangxian Li,Yong-Jin Liu,Yulong Bian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在1260轮"重复囚徒困境式"对话博弈实验中，8个开源权重LLM仅凭决策记录即可较好预测用户合作/背叛（AUC=.80），加入对话并无增益；对话反而使预测过度采信用户的口头承诺，在被违背的承诺轮次准确率从.65骤降至.17，且几乎忽略对手智能体人格特质带来的行为差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web系统越来越多地依据用户"所说"来预测其"所做"，但当利益部分冲突时，用户可能为使对方合作而做出合作承诺却并不履行。依赖此类承诺的服务/销售智能体可能因此向不守信用户让步，损害其所代表一方的利益。因此需要检验LLM如何将用户陈述与决策记录结合起来预测用户决策。

Method: 采用重复囚徒困境式博弈实验，共42名用户、1260轮；每名用户与5个智能体对局，每个智能体被提示表现大五人格中的某一主导特质，用户在每次决策前可与智能体对话。比较仅用决策记录与加入对话两种输入下，8个开源权重LLM的预测表现，并按"是否做出陈述""陈述是否被遵守"分层计算准确率，同时考察预测对智能体特质与用户自身特质的敏感度。

Result: 仅凭决策记录即可良好区分合作与背叛（AUC=.80），加入对话无显著提升。含对话时预测更倾向与用户陈述一致，误差集中于违背承诺的轮次：有陈述轮次总体准确率几乎不变（.73→.74），遵守承诺轮次由.76升至.95，违背承诺轮次由.65跌至.17。预测对陈述的权重超过用户实际行为：当用户声明一个尚未在该局做出的决定时，预测其兑现概率由.13升至.69，而用户实际兑现率仅.40。用户决策随对手智能体变化（对宜人性智能体合作率70.6%，对 Extraversion 智能体54.5%），预测合作率却几乎相同（64.5% vs. 63.1%）；用户在自身该特质得分更高时对相应智能体合作更多，预测却几乎不随之变化。

Conclusion: 基于对话的预测应依据用户过往决策记录及其面对的对手智能体对用户陈述进行加权，而非直接采信言辞。

Abstract: Web systems increasingly predict users' decisions from what users say, yet when interests partly conflict, users may promise to cooperate to win the other side's cooperation and then not do so. Sales or service agents that rely on such promises may grant concessions to users who then do not keep their promises, at a cost to the party they represent. We test how LLMs combine users' statements with decision records to predict users' decisions, using 1,260 rounds in which 42 users played a repeated prisoner's dilemma-style game with five agents, each prompted to express a dominant Big Five trait, and could talk with the agent before every decision. Across eight open-weight LLMs, predictions from decision records separated cooperation from defection well (AUC = .80), and adding dialogue brought no detectable gain. With dialogue, predictions agreed with users' statements more often, and errors concentrated on rounds in which users broke their statements: accuracy on rounds with a statement barely changed (.73 to .74), while it rose on kept statements (.76 to .95) and fell sharply on broken ones (.65 to .17). Predictions weighted statements more heavily than users' behavior warranted: when users stated a decision they had not yet made in that game, the predicted probability of keeping it rose from .13 to .69, whereas users kept .40 of such statements. Users' decisions also varied with the agent they faced, but predictions hardly reflected this: users cooperated more with the Agreeableness agent than with the Extraversion agent (70.6% vs. 54.5%), whereas predicted cooperation was nearly identical (64.5% vs. 63.1%). Users also cooperated more with an agent when they themselves scored higher on that agent's trait, whereas predicted cooperation barely changed with these scores. Dialogue-based predictions should therefore weigh users' statements by their earlier decisions and the agent they face.

</details>


### [158] [Nothing Left Behind: Finding Evidence from a Large Randomized Evaluation Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36910)
*Giuliano Martinelli,Abelardo Carlos Martinez Lorenzo,Satvik Garg,Linxi Wang,Riccardo Orlando,Piriyakorn Piriyatamwong,Samuel Paul Fraiberger*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在7,354项随机对照试验语料上，基于标签词表的检索仅覆盖系统综述所需证据的45%，而"文本嵌入候选召回+语言模型相关性过滤"的两阶段方法覆盖92%，代价是查询成本随检索深度上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准做法是为每个条目打上受控词表标签并基于标签检索，虽然便于组织结果，但会漏掉不匹配任何标签的条目，且标签过宽时返回噪声过多，导致召回不全与精度不足。

Method: 对比两种检索范式：一是传统标签检索；二是基于语义的两阶段方法——先用文本嵌入按含义召回候选条目，再由语言模型筛除不相关项，仅保留证据相关条目。

Result: 在7,354项随机试验语料中，标签检索召回系统综述应纳入证据的45%，嵌入+语言模型方法召回92%；新方法单查询成本随检索深度增加而上升。

Conclusion: 结果支持"广域候选召回+查询特定证据过滤"的两阶段架构，可作为大规模证据检索与组织的替代方案。

Abstract: Many AI systems need to find every relevant items in a large collection and then organize what they found. The standard way to do this is to tag each item with labels from a curated vocabulary and search on those labels. Those labels are useful for organizing results, but searching on them misses items that do not fit a label and returns too much when labels are broad. We compare this approach with an embedding-based approach: find candidates by meaning using text embeddings, then have a language model keep only the relevant ones. In a corpus of 7,354 randomized trials, label search found 45% of the evidence a systematic review would include, while the new approach found 92%, at a cost per query that rises with search depth. These results support a two-stage architecture that combines broad candidate retrieval with query-specific evidence filtering.

</details>


### [159] [Developing a Speech Language Model for Basque](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36911)
*Andoni Sudupe,Inma Hernaez,Ander Arriandiaga,Christoforos Souganidis,Ibon Saratxaga,Eva Navas*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文提出了首个面向巴斯克语的开放语音语言模型，基于LLaMA-Omni架构与Latxa骨干，实现低延迟端到端语音交互；借助翻译VoiceAssistant-400K语料与巴斯克语TTS合成数据缓解数据稀缺，评测验证了其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型推动多模态交互发展，但少数语言难以跟上；巴斯克语等低资源语言缺少可用的端到端语音交互系统，且面临训练数据稀缺问题。

Method: 采用LLaMA-Omni模块化架构，以Latxa模型为语言骨干，通过微调多个模块将其文本能力迁移至语音模态；数据方面将英文VoiceAssistant-400K语料翻译为巴斯克语，并用巴斯克语TTS合成语音，构建训练数据。

Result: 内容质量3.86/5，语音可懂度WER 9.94%，音频质量UTMOS 3.07，表明系统整体可行。

Conclusion: 在低资源语言场景下，借助模块化架构与合成数据亦可构建先进的语音交互系统。

Abstract: Although the recent development of LLMs has paved the way for multi-modal interaction, minority languages face difficulties keeping pace. This work presents the first open Speech Language Model for Basque, designed for low-latency, end-to-end spoken interaction. Based on the LLaMA-Omni architecture, the system integrates a Latxa model as its backbone, transferring its Basque capabilities to the spoken modality by fine-tuning several modules. To address data scarcity, the English VoiceAssistant-400K corpus was translated into Basque, and the audio was synthesized using a Basque TTS. Evaluation results confirm the system's viability, achieving 3.86/5 in content quality, a 9.94% WER for spoken intelligibility, and a 3.07 UTMOS for audio quality. This work demonstrates that advanced spoken interaction systems can be developed using modular architectures and synthetic data even in low-resource languages.

</details>


### [160] [Do We Need an LLM to Know Why Sources Conflict? Decision Models for Knowledge-Conflict Typing in RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36915)
*Parv Khatri,Harshul Jain,Mehak Kapoor,Tanya Sah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文评估商用推理网关上的11个类型化决策模型（typed decision models）能否在单次前向传播中对检索源冲突类型快速、低成本地分类，结果显示多数模型性能可匹敌Gemini 2.5 Flash且成本与延迟显著更低，并可通过级联策略接近更强模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索源存在分歧时，正确回应取决于分歧原因（多有效答案、争议话题、过时信息、虚假源），需先做冲突类型分类；Cattan et al. (2025) 表明告知生成器冲突类型可提升约24分，但前沿LLM预测该类型仍很困难，因此需要更快速、更廉价的分类手段。

Method: 基于CONFLICTS基准，逐字沿用小论文的提示词，在相同输入下，将来自7家供应商、由同一商用推理网关提供的全部11个决策模型（单次前向输出固定选项上的概率，而非生成文本）与Gemini模型对比；并分析级联策略、分类法拆解为是/否问题、跨模型修复迁移、日期作用与源顺序敏感性、植入虚假源的分离能力等诊断。

Result: 直接提问时决策模型准确率50.0–67.0%，11个中10个达到或超过Gemini 2.5 Flash（61.3%），计费成本低4–39倍（2个免费），延迟低2.6–6.0倍；当前Gemini 3.8 Flash（70.0%）显著优于其中8个，但将每个决策模型置信度最低的四分之一查询转给它，可在11个中8个上统计持平，成本仅为25–37%；端到端上11个中10个生成的答案与LLM类型表现一致；拆解分类法会降低所有模型准确率，且在一个模型上拟合的修复无法迁移；日期无可测作用，源顺序敏感性差异大；作为硬标签时检测植入虚假源不如LLM可靠，但概率仍能区分植入源与干净源。

Conclusion: 类型化决策模型是冲突类型分类的低成本高效替代方案，配合置信度级联可逼近更强LLM的准确率；但分类法拆解、修复迁移与虚假源硬标签检测存在局限。作者开源代码、提示词与全部模型输出。

Abstract: When the sources retrieved for a query disagree, the right response depends on why they disagree: a question with several valid answers, a contested topic, stale information and a false source each call for different behaviour. Cattan et al. (2025) showed that telling a generator the conflict type improves its responses by about 24 points, but that predicting the type is hard even for frontier LLMs. We study whether typed decision models, which return probabilities over fixed options in a single forward pass instead of generating text, can do this classification fast and cheaply. Using the CONFLICTS benchmark and the original paper's prompt verbatim, we evaluate all 11 decision models served by one commercial inference gateway, from 7 providers, against Gemini models on identical inputs. Asked directly, the decision models reach 50.0--67.0% accuracy; 10 of the 11 match or exceed Gemini 2.5 Flash, the paper's model (61.3%), at 4--39x lower billed cost (2 were free) and 2.6--6.0x lower latency. The current Gemini 3.8 Flash (70.0%) is significantly more accurate than 8 of them, but sending each decision model's least confident quarter of queries to it gives a cascade statistically tied with it for 8 of the 11, at 25--37% of its cost. End to end, answers generated with the types of 10 of the 11 follow the expected behaviour as often as with the LLM's types. Decomposing the taxonomy into yes/no questions lowers accuracy for every model, and a repair fitted on one model does not transfer. Pre-specified diagnostics show that dates play no measurable role and that sensitivity to source order varies widely between models. Decision models detect a planted false source less reliably than the LLM as hard labels, but their probabilities still separate planted from clean sources. We release code, prompts and all model outputs at https://github.com/Parv17k/decision-models-conflict-typing.

</details>


### [161] [TrawMem: Reframing Agent Memory as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36918)
*Mingyu Zhang,Zixu Li,Zhiheng Fu,Zhiwei Chen,Jinhe Bi,Yupeng Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 将智能体记忆系统重新定义为"任务导向的角色自适应工作区"，提出 TrawMem：把交互历史组织为局部线程，通过分配角色并联合选择互补记忆构建任务工作区，在 LoCoMo 与 MemGallery 上取得一致的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体记忆系统主要按"与当前查询的相关性"检索记忆并作为上下文证据使用，但相关性无法刻画记忆在任务求解中的功能：同一记忆在不同任务中可能承担不同角色，既可能直接支撑答案，也可能作为线索关联到语义相关性较弱却包含必要信息的互补记忆。

Method: 提出 Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces 视角，记忆按任务导向的角色与关系进行选择和组织；实现为 TrawMem：先将交互历史组织成局部线程（local threads），再为记忆分配角色并联合选择互补记忆，从而构建任务导向工作区。

Result: 在 LoCoMo 与 MemGallery 上，使用四个开源与闭源骨干模型，相较代表性记忆系统取得一致提升，macro-F1 提升 2.23–3.14 个百分点；在 LoCoMo 上，LLM-Judge 分数相较 SimpleMem 在 Qwen3.5-9B 与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上分别提升 4.07 与 4.31 个百分点，同时上下文 token 分别减少约 12.8% 与 5.1%。

Conclusion: 以任务导向角色替代单一相关性准则可有效提升智能体记忆的利用效率与效果，并在更少上下文开销下获得更优答案质量，说明角色与互补关系的显式建模是记忆系统设计的关键维度。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on memory systems to leverage long-term interactions, yet existing systems typically retrieve memories based on their relevance to the current query and use them as contextual evidence. However, relevance alone does not characterize how a memory contributes to task solving: the same memory may serve different roles across tasks, such as directly supporting the answer or linking to complementary memories with weaker semantic relevance but necessary information. We therefore reframe agent memory systems as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces, where memories are selected and organized by their task-oriented roles and relations. Based on this view, we propose TrawMem, which organizes interaction histories into local threads and constructs task-oriented workspaces by assigning roles and jointly selecting complementary memories. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemGallery with four open- and closed-source backbones show consistent improvements over representative memory systems, with macro-F1 gains of 2.23-3.14 points. On LoCoMo, TrawMem improves the LLM-Judge score over SimpleMem by 4.07 and 4.31 percentage points on Qwen3.5-9B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, respectively, while requiring approximately 12.8% and 5.1% fewer context tokens, respectively.

</details>


### [162] [DocXEval: A Systematic Evaluation of Explainability in Multimodal Document Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36929)
*Saifullah Saifullah,David Dembinsky,Stefan Agne,Andreas Dengel,Sheraz Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出首个面向多模态文档理解的可解释性框架，系统评估13种XAI方法在3任务、8数据集、4模型、17指标下的表现，发现Occlusion最忠实可解释，并揭示模型行为与数据集偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态Transformer在文档理解上性能突出，但其黑箱特性阻碍了在高风险领域的部署；而针对多模态文档理解的XAI研究严重不足，缺少统一的方法与评估基准。

Method: 构建适配文本、布局、图像三模态文档理解语境的XAI框架，将现有XAI方法与评估指标迁移适配，并针对语义实体识别等任务提出高效的多目标适配版本；随后在17个评估指标下系统评测13种XAI方法，并进行元评估与数据集级诊断分析。

Result: 仅少数方法在所有评估标准下表现一致，Occlusion整体上最忠实且最具可解释性；元评估显示多个忠实性与复杂度指标间存在中至强一致性，同时识别出部分产生不可靠结果的指标；诊断分析揭示各模态贡献差异、目标实体周围的空间归因模式及潜在数据集偏差。

Conclusion: 该工作既是多模态文档理解XAI的基准，也为后续研究提供实践指南，并开源代码以支持可复现性。

Abstract: Multimodal transformer models have driven unprecedented performance breakthroughs in modern document understanding. However, the inherent black-box nature of these models remains a major obstacle to their safe deployment in high-stakes sectors. Despite significant progress in explainability for vision and language tasks, explainable AI (XAI) research tailored to multimodal document understanding has received little attention. To address this gap, we present \ourframework{}, the first comprehensive explainability framework that adapts existing XAI methods and evaluation metrics to the multimodal (text, layout, and image) document understanding context, while introducing efficient multi-target adaptations of both methods and metrics for domain-specific tasks such as semantic entity recognition. Using \ourframework{}, we systematically evaluate 13 XAI methods across 3 document understanding tasks, 8 datasets, 4 models, and 17 evaluation metrics, and find that only a few methods perform consistently across all evaluation criteria, with Occlusion emerging as the most faithful and interpretable method overall. Through a dedicated meta-evaluation, we observe moderate to strong agreement among several faithfulness and complexity metrics while identifying certain ones that produce unreliable results. Finally, through multiple dataset-wide diagnostic analyses, we uncover key insights into model behavior, including the contribution of individual modalities across tasks and labels, spatial attribution patterns around target entities, and potential dataset biases. Overall, this work serves as both a benchmark and a practical guide for future XAI research in multimodal document understanding. To support reproducibility, we publicly release our code at https://github.com/saifullah3396/docxeval/.

</details>


### [163] [JevRec: Linguistic Encoding with Jev-like Decision Modeling for LLM-based Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36937)
*Qiyong Zhong,Jiajie Su,Ming Yang,Li Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出JevRec，将商品编码为可变长"词"，按交互频率自适应确定SID长度，并用分离的长度预测头与内容生成头缓解优化冲突，在三个公开数据集上全面优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐（GR）对所有商品分配统一长度的语义标识（SID），但商品交互频率极不均衡：热门商品反复付出细粒度编码代价，而缩短编码又会压缩长尾商品的语义表达。作者受自然语言中高频表达形式更紧凑的启发，希望实现频率自适应的变长编码。

Method: JevRec采用变长"词"编码：在共享码本上保留与频率相关的语义前缀，使热门商品获得更短SID、长尾商品获得更丰富的描述；同时引入Jev式决策建模组件，将序列级长度预测（专用长度头）与token级内容生成（独立内容头）解耦，二者共享交互历史表示。

Result: 在三个公开数据集上，JevRec在全部评测推荐指标上优于所有对比基线；训练与推理时间低于TIGER；长度预测与内容预测之间的梯度冲突减小。

Conclusion: 频率自适应的变长SID编码结合长度-内容解耦的决策建模，可在提升推荐效果的同时降低计算开销并缓解多任务优化冲突，为生成式推荐提供了一种高效范式。

Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items as semantic identifiers (SIDs) and autoregressively generates the next item's SID from interaction history. However, most methods assign the same SID length to all items despite highly unequal interaction frequencies. This uniform design repeatedly incurs the cost of fine-grained codes for popular items, while shortening codes to reduce this cost also compresses the semantic representations of long-tail items. Inspired by the compact forms of frequent expressions in natural language, we propose JevRec to encode items as variable-length words and generate the next item from interaction context. Linguistic encoding retains frequency-dependent semantic prefixes from shared codebooks, producing shorter SIDs for popular items and richer descriptions for long-tail items. Yet predicting a sequence-level length and generating token-level content impose different optimization requirements that may conflict under a shared output head. Our Jev-like decision modeling component therefore predicts a length distribution with a dedicated head and generates content conditioned on length through a separate head while sharing the interaction-history representation. Experiments on three public datasets show that JevRec outperforms all compared baselines across the evaluated recommendation metrics. Further analyses show lower training and inference time than TIGER and reduced gradient conflict between length and content prediction.

</details>


### [164] [Self-Keyed In-Parameter Memorization for External Memory-Free Dialogue Recall in Frozen Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36948)
*XinYu Piao,Myunghoon Ryu,Joongheon Kim,Jong-Kook Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SKIM：无需外部记忆，模型自生成多样化问题作为键，以闭式方式将对话题写入参数，仅凭参数即可由后续用户问题检索并回答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话记忆依赖模型外部的、随对话增长的存储；本文设定模型既无外部记忆、也无关于未来问题及答案的先验知识，旨在探究对话能否直接存入模型参数并在之后被问及作答。

Method: 提出 self-keyed in-parameter memorization (SKIM)：对每个对话轮次，模型自行生成大量多样化的问题，并将这些问题作为键、以闭式（closed-form）方式将该轮内容写入参数，使后续用户问题与其中一个键匹配即可从参数中召回答案。

Result: 在五个语言模型上评测，SKIM 能从后续用户问题中召回大部分已存储的对话轮次，并且完全依靠模型参数作答，无需任何外部存储。

Conclusion: 对话内容可以被有效编码进模型参数，并通过自生成问题作为检索键实现参数内记忆与回忆，为无外部存储的对话记忆提供了一种可行方案。

Abstract: A large language model maintains conversational content in an external storage that is outside the model and grows as the dialogue continues. This work assumes an environment where a language model has no external memory and no prior knowledge of the future question or its answer. The motivation is to research whether a dialogue can be stored in the model parameters and later answer a question about it. This work proposes self-keyed in-parameter memorization (SKIM), a closed-form method in which the model generates its own questions about each dialogue turn and writes those questions into its parameters as the keys that later retrieve the turn's content. Generating many varied questions for each turn allows a later user question to match one even when phrased differently, and its answer is recalled from the parameters alone. Evaluated on five language models, SKIM recalls most stored dialogue turns from later user questions, and it answers from the model parameters without any external storage.

</details>


### [165] [The State and Fate of Multilingual, Contextual Evaluation in the NLP World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36990)
*Manan Uppadhyay,Himanshu Beniwal,Prashant Kodali,Sunayana Sitaram*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 对51个近期多语言基准（242数据集、219种语言）进行数据驱动审计，围绕覆盖度、代表性、严谨性三大支柱，揭示多语言评测生态系统在广度与有效性间的结构性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言评测基准是判断大模型能否超越英语泛化的主要工具，但其充分的合理性此前缺乏系统审视，故本文对其进行数据驱动的系统审计。

Method: 从覆盖度、代表性、严谨性三支柱组织审计框架，对51个多语言基准、242个数据集、219种语言进行元数据采集与统计分析，并发布可交互的元数据仪表盘。

Result: 覆盖度广而不深：36%的语言仅出现在单一基准中，大洋洲、美洲、中亚等区域近乎空白，低资源语言仅覆盖1-3类任务而高资源语言达14类；代表性受损：56%的数据集-语言实例由英语翻译构建，引入翻译伪影与英语中心框架，文化扎根内容集中于少数语言范围狭窄的社区驱动基准；严谨性受污染威胁：存在翻译基准泄漏与平行语料重叠等表层形式检测难以发现的污染。

Conclusion: 多语言评测生态迫使在广度与有效性间进行权衡；作者提出应构建原生构造、文化扎根、污染感知、并服务于其所评测语言社群的多语言评测框架建议。

Abstract: Multilingual evaluation benchmarks are the primary instrument for assessing whether large language models generalize beyond English, yet the adequacy of these benchmarks has received little systematic scrutiny. We present a data-driven audit of 51 recent multilingual benchmarks spanning 242 datasets and 219 languages, organized around three pillars: coverage, representativeness, and rigor. Our analysis reveals that coverage is wide but thin with 36% of evaluated languages appearing in only a single benchmark, entire regions (Oceania, the Americas, Central Asia) are near-zero, and a stark task equity gap leaves low-resource languages evaluated on only 1-3 task categories versus 14 for high-resource languages. Representativeness is structurally compromised: translation from English remains the dominant construction strategy where 56% of all dataset-language instances are translated introducing artifacts and English-centric framing, while culturally grounded content is concentrated in a handful of community-driven benchmarks with narrow language scope. The ecosystem thus forces a trade-off between breadth and validity. Rigor is undermined by benchmark contamination, including translated benchmark leakage and parallel corpus overlap that evade surface-form detection. We synthesize these findings into concrete recommendations for building evaluation frameworks that are natively constructed, culturally grounded, contamination-aware, and designed to serve the communities whose languages they claim to evaluate. The dashboard with all the metadata collected can be found at https://aka.ms/multilingual-evals.

</details>


### [166] [Hierarchical Low-Rank Reparameterization for Parameter-Efficient](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37068)
*Rong Huang,Yi Xiong,Yuan-Yuan Cheng,Xiao-Ming Fu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出分层低秩重参数化方法，将PEFT的可训练参数重组为近似方阵并递归做低秩分解，逐级压缩参数，与LoRA/DoRA/MoSA/RaSA结合后在常识推理与GSM8K任务上以更少参数取得更优或相当性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PEFT方法虽只引入少量可训练参数，但这些参数本身仍存在冗余，可在保持任务性能的前提下进一步压缩。

Method: 核心是将PEFT方法的可训练参数重排为近似方阵，用低秩分解表示，并递归施加该分解，形成因子逐级压缩的多级层次结构，从而大幅降低可训练参数数量；该方法与LoRA、DoRA、MoSA、RaSA结合使用。

Result: 在LLaMA-3.1-8B与Qwen2.5-7B上评测常识推理（八个基准），并在LLaMA-3.1-8B上补充GSM8K数学推理实验。在可比的可训练参数预算下，与LoRA或DoRA结合时性能更优；当原方法参数量压缩约一个数量级时，仍保持有竞争力的性能，平均准确率甚至超过相应基线。

Conclusion: PEFT中的可训练参数具有可观的冗余，分层低秩重参数化能有效去除该冗余，在极低参数预算下维持甚至提升下游任务表现，是一种模型无关、可即插即用的PEFT压缩框架。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods adapt large models by introducing a small number of trainable parameters. However, we find that these parameters still contain redundancy and can be further compressed while maintaining strong task performance. To this end, we propose a novel hierarchical low-rank reparameterization method. Its core idea is to reorganize the trainable parameters of PEFT methods into an approximately square matrix and then express it via a low-rank decomposition, which can be applied recursively. This forms a multi-level structure with factors compressed level by level, drastically reducing the number of trainable parameters. In our experiments, we combine this reparameterization with LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA. We evaluate commonsense reasoning on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, with additional GSM8K math reasoning experiments on LLaMA-3.1-8B. Under comparable trainable-parameter budgets, our method combined with LoRA or DoRA achieves better performance. Furthermore,when the parameter count of the original methods is compressed by approximately an order of magnitude, our method can still maintain competitive task performance and even surpass the corresponding baselines in average accuracy across the eight commonsense reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [167] [Text Generation in Low-Resource Languages Using Human-Curated Vocabularies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37105)
*Michael Christlambert Sinanta,Muhammad Dehan Al Kautsar,Amanda Nurul Izzah,Thanh-Nhi Nguyen,Phan Phuong Mai Chau,Zheng Wei Lim,Fajri Koto*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 vocab2text 框架，将人工编纂词表与少量人工范例结合，按 Zipf 分布采样候选词，使 LLM 能为极低资源乃至未见过语言生成连贯文本，并在词表、词库层面验证其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成文本生成可缓解低资源语言的数据稀缺，但对预训练数据中极少出现甚至完全缺失的语言效果有限。而这类语言往往存在人工编纂的词表，含丰富的词汇、语义与词性信息，作者因此探究 LLM 能否利用这些资源为极低资源、未见过语言生成连贯文本。

Method: 构建框架：以人工编纂词表为词源，辅以少量人工撰写的范例提供句法信号，并依据 Zipf 分布对候选词进行采样；在资源可得程度不同的多种语言上，用词汇多样性、偏离目标词比率（off-target ratio）以及人工流畅度判断进行评估。

Result: 具备推理能力的 LLM 即使在极低资源语言上也能生成流畅文本；句子层面效果尤为突出，段落层面表现亦有前景。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了在低资源语言中引导合成数据的可行路径：即便现有数字资源极为有限，也能扩充可用文本量。代码已开源。

Abstract: Synthetic text generation offers a promising approach to alleviating data scarcity in low-resource languages. However, its effectiveness is inherently limited for languages that are scarcely represented, or entirely absent, in an LLM's pretraining data. At the same time, many such languages have human-curated vocabularies that provide rich lexical and semantic information, often accompanied by grammatical information such as part-of-speech labels. In this work, we ask whether LLMs can leverage these resources to generate coherent text in extremely low-resource and unseen languages. We introduce a framework that combines human-curated vocabularies with a small number of human-written exemplars that provide syntactic signals, while sampling candidate words according to a Zipfian distribution. Across languages with varying levels of resource availability, we evaluate the generated text using lexical diversity, off-target ratio, and human judgments of fluency. Our results show that reasoning-enabled LLMs can generate fluent text even in extremely low-resource languages, with particularly strong results at the sentence level and promising performance at the paragraph level. Our findings highlight a practical pathway for bootstrapping synthetic data in low-resource languages, expanding the amount of usable text even when existing digital resources are extremely limited. Our source code is available at https://github.com/michaelsinanta/vocab2text.

</details>


### [168] [What Survives Distillation? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study of GPT-2 and DistilGPT-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37157)
*Nabeelah Faumi,Deshan Sumanathilaka*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文用多种机制分析工具比较 GPT-2 与 DistilGPT-2 在两个经典电路上的表现，发现"压缩—崩溃二分现象"：IOI 电路机制完全崩溃，而 GT 电路通过比较头重映射得以存活，表明电路可压缩性决定蒸馏后的机制存续。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏能将大模型压缩为学生模型并保持聚合指标，但深度削减蒸馏对内部机制的后果尚未被刻画；聚合指标是否足以作为电路完整性的诊断依据存疑。

Method: 采用线性 CKA、logit lens、注意力模式分解、稀疏自编码器特征统计与激活修补（activation patching），在间接宾语识别（IOI）电路与 Greater-Than（GT）电路上对比 GPT-2 教师与六层学生 DistilGPT-2。

Result: IOI 电路发生完全机制崩溃：DistilGPT-2 准确率 35.2%（教师 94.8%），name-mover 保留数为零；GT 电路则恢复 87.7% 的任务性能，教师第 9 层比较头被主动重映射至学生第 4 层（平均 Pearson r = 0.945）。

Conclusion: 电路的可压缩性决定其在蒸馏下的机制存续与否；聚合指标不足以诊断电路完整性，需引入机制层面的评估。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation compresses large language models into compact students that preserve aggregate metrics, yet the mechanistic consequences of depth-reduction distillation remain largely uncharacterized. This work applies linear CKA, logit lens analysis, attention pattern decomposition, sparse autoencoder feature statistics, and activation patching to compare GPT-2 and its six-layer student DistilGPT-2 across two canonical circuits: the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit and the Greater-Than (GT) circuit. The results reveal a compression-collapse dichotomy: the IOI circuit suffers complete mechanistic collapse (DistilGPT-2: 35.2% accuracy vs. 94.8%, zero name-mover preservation), while the GT circuit survives with 87.7% task performance recovery through active remapping of the teacher's layer-9 comparison head into student layer~4 (mean Pearson r = 0.945). These findings demonstrate that circuit compressibility governs mechanistic survival under distillation, and that aggregate metrics are insufficient diagnostics for circuit integrity.

</details>


### [169] [Decision Models as Judges for Hallucination Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37229)
*Haozheng Liu,Zhaoqian Xue,Zhongyin Wang,Junting Mu,Zihui Ma,Shuya Feng,Lingyao Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文构建覆盖五种幻觉类型的二分类基准（9,852 条样本，来自 6 个数据集），比较五种决策模型与生成式评判模型 gpt-6-sol，发现决策模型在部分幻觉类型上可低成本替代，但性能依赖类型且概率过度自信，需先验证后使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge 成本高、易产生幻觉且过度自信，而决策模型直接输出各标签概率、更快更便宜，本文检验其在幻觉检测任务上是否可作为低成本替代方案。

Method: 针对五类幻觉构建二分类基准（9,852 条样本，6 个数据集），比较 5 种决策模型与生成式评判器 gpt-6-sol；分析概率校准性与正确/错误决策区分度，并提出决策模型的置信度级联（confidence cascade）。

Result: 性能强依赖幻觉类型：最佳决策模型在上下文不一致上balanced accuracy 与 gpt-6-sol 持平，事实错误上差距在 3 个百分点内，但逻辑不一致与指令不一致落后 4–8 个百分点。决策模型概率过度自信（程度轻于 GPT-6 系列），对正确/错误决策的区分仅为中等。置信度级联在三种类型上比最佳单模型提升 1.9–3.3 个百分点，并以 1–3% 的成本持平或超过 gpt-6-sol。

Conclusion: 决策模型可作为部分幻觉类型的实用低成本评判器，但并非通用替代，部署前须按类型验证，且可借助置信度级联与校准提升性价比。

Abstract: Large language models are widely used as judges of model outputs (LLM-as-a-Judge), but they are costly and can hallucinate or be overconfident. Decision models are a potential alternative. They return a predefined verdict with a probability for each label instead of free-form text and are much cheaper and faster. We test this promise on hallucination detection. We build binary benchmarks for five hallucination types (9,852 items from six datasets) and compare five decision models with the generative judge gpt-6-sol. Performance depends strongly on the type: the best decision model matches gpt-6-sol in balanced accuracy on context inconsistency and comes within 3 percentage points on factual errors, but trails it by 4-8 points on logical and instruction inconsistency. Decision-model probabilities are overconfident, though less so than the GPT-6 models, and separate correct from incorrect decisions only moderately. We also find that a confidence cascade of decision models improves on the best single model by 1.9-3.3 points on three types and matches or exceeds gpt-6-sol at 1-3% of its cost. Overall, decision models are a practical low-cost judge for some hallucination types but need to be validated before use.

</details>


### [170] [Aligning Large Language Models for Safety in African Languages: A Case Study of Hausa](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37245)
*Valdini Douglace Lemofouet,Blessing Ngozi Uzor,Paula Chikaodinaka Anyanwu,Danielle Blanche Kapsa,Saminu Mohammad Aliyu,Seid Muhie Yimam,Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文构建首个豪萨语（Hausa）安全偏好数据集 HausaSafeLM（1万条提示，含3000条人工校正金标与7000条机器翻译银标，覆盖六大危害类别），基于 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 比较 SFT 与 SFT+DPO 两种训练范式，发现现有对齐方法更多教会模型"何时拒绝"而非"如何流畅地拒绝"，且仅凭拒答率评估低资源语言安全性并不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 安全对齐研究高度集中于高资源语言，现有对齐方法在低资源、文化差异显著场景下的表现尚不清楚。作者以超过2亿使用者的西非豪萨语为切入点，填补低资源语言安全对齐的数据与实证空白。

Method: 从 PKU-SafeRLHF 派生 10,000 条提示，构建 HausaSafeLM 数据集：3,000 条人工校正（gold）与 7,000 条机器翻译（silver），覆盖六类危害宏观类别。以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为基座，在两种数据条件下对比 SFT 与 SFT+DPO；评测集为 500 条有害与 200 条无害豪萨语提示，考察拒答率、拒绝精确率与语言流畅度。

Result: 未微调基座模型仅凭拒答率看似"高度安全"，实为豪萨语生成能力不足所致，拒绝几乎全部质量低下。SFT 同时提升拒绝的流畅度与精确率，且从规模更大、噪声更高的 silver 数据中获益显著；DPO 提高拒绝精确率，但以大幅且基本不随数据规模变化的语言质量下降为代价。不存在同时最大化安全性、有用性与流畅度的单一配置。

Conclusion: 当前对齐技术教给模型的是"何时拒绝"多于"如何流畅地拒绝"，在低资源语言上二者存在明显脱节；仅使用拒答率指标在低资源场景下是安全性不可靠的信号，需引入语言质量与精确率的联合评估。

Abstract: Safety alignment research for large language models (LLMs) remains concentrated on high-resource languages, leaving open how existing alignment methods perform in low-resource, culturally distinct settings. We study this question for Hausa, a language spoken by more than 200 million people across West Africa. We introduce HausaSafeLM, one of the first Hausa safety preference dataset, built from 10,000 prompts derived from PKU-SafeRLHF: 3,000 human-corrected (gold) and 7,000 machine-translated (silver) examples spanning six harm macro-categories. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, we compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and SFT followed by Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) under both data regimes, evaluating on 500 harmful and 200 benign Hausa prompts.We find that the untuned base model appears highly safe by refusal-rate metrics alone, but this reflects limited Hausa generation ability rather than genuine alignment: its refusals are almost uniformly low quality. SFT improves both refusal fluency and precision and benefits substantially from the larger, noisier silver-tier data, while DPO sharpens refusal precision but comes at a steep, largely data-invariant cost to linguistic quality. No single configuration jointly maximizes safety, helpfulness, and fluency. Our results suggest that current alignment techniques teach models when to refuse more readily than how to do so fluently in underrepresented languages, and that refusal-rate metrics alone are an unreliable signal of safety in low-resource settings.

</details>


### [171] [REGLAT at ArGuard Shared Tasks: An Ensemble-Based Model Integrating NER for Harmful Content Detection in Arabic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37265)
*Ahmed M. Fetouh,Mariam Labib,Nsrin Ashraf,Omer Dawood,Hamada Nayel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出两阶段阿拉伯语有害内容七分类方法：先用GLiNER抽取危害相关实体并拼接回原文，再输入微调MARBERT分类；开发集macro-F1 0.886、准确率0.897，盲测子任务1为0.793/0.735，子任务2为0.770/0.754。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语有害内容检测受方言变体多样及不同危害类别间语义重叠影响，细粒度分类困难。

Method: 两阶段流水线：第一阶段用GLiNER从每条用户提示中抽取与危害相关的实体；第二阶段将抽取到的实体拼接到原始文本中，送入微调后的MARBERT分类器完成七类有害内容的最终分类，从而将显式实体信息与预训练阿拉伯语模型的上下文语义理解相结合。在ArGuard 2026共享任务开发集上评估。

Result: 开发集：macro-F1 0.886，准确率0.897。盲测集子任务1：准确率0.793，macro-F1 0.735；子任务2：准确率0.770，macro-F1 0.754。分析表明相近类别之间的区分仍具挑战性。

Conclusion: 将NER与阿拉伯语预训练语言模型相结合是检测有害内容的一种有前景的方法，但相关类别间的细粒度区分仍需进一步改进。

Abstract: Detecting harmful content in Arabic is challenging because of dialectal variations and the semantic overlap between different harm categories. This paper presents a two-stage approach for classifying Arabic user prompts into seven categories of harmful content. First, GLiNER is used to extract harm-related entities from each prompt. The extracted entities are then added to the original text and passed to a fine-tuned MARBERT classifier for final classification. The approach combines explicit entity information with the contextual understanding of a pretrained Arabic language model. The system was evaluated on the development set of the ArGuard 2026 shared task. The results achieved a macro-F1 score of 0.886 and an accuracy of 0.897, demonstrating promising performance in fine-grained harmful content detection. The system reported an accuracy of 0.793 and Macro-F score of 0.735 on a blind test set for subtask 1. For subtask 2, it achieved an accuracy of 0.770 and Macro-F score of 0.754. The analysis also showed that distinguishing between related categories remains challenging. These findings suggest that integrating NER with Arabic language models is a promising approach to harmful content detection.

</details>


### [172] [Multi-Label Agreement: A Flexible Framework for Inter-Annotator Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37292)
*Tim Menzner,Jochen L. Leidner*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出多标签一致性评估框架MLA，基于平均成对汉明一致性保留完整二元标签向量，兼顾共同选中与共同未选中，并提供池化边际、Gwet AC1与固定基线三种归一化及多层级结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IAA指标（Cohen's kappa、Fleiss' kappa、Krippendorff's alpha）多面向单标签场景，多标签任务需额外决定如何比较完整标签集、共同选中与共同未选中，缺乏统一且透明的评估框架。

Method: 提出Multi-Label Agreement（MLA）框架：保留每个条目的完整二元标签向量，采用平均成对汉明一致性；分析其池化边际形式为按机会分歧加权的标签级Fleiss/Scott型系数平均，并与归一化汉明距离下的Krippendorff's alpha密切相关；支持池化边际、Gwet AC1和固定基线三种归一化，输出条目级、标签级和语料级结果，并含条件性最小一致性诊断；通过实例与蒙特卡洛模拟检验结果对标签流行度、声明标签清单及期望一致性模型的依赖；提供Python实现。

Result: 实例与蒙特卡洛模拟表明，MLA取值受标签流行度、所声明标签清单以及所选期望一致性模型显著影响；池化边际形式并非数学上独立的系数，而是标签级系数的加权平均，与归一化汉明距离下的Krippendorff's alpha紧密相关。

Conclusion: MLA为多标签一致性分析提供了透明、可解释的框架，能系统刻画共同选中与共同未选中，但作者不主张某一归一化普遍最优，使用者需依据标签流行度与标签清单明确选择归一化方式。

Abstract: Reliable evaluation of inter-annotator agreement (IAA) is important for assessing the consistency of annotation processes. While established IAA metrics such as Cohen's kappa, Fleiss' kappa, and Krippendorff's alpha are commonly applied in single-label settings, multi-label tasks require additional decisions about how full label sets, joint selections, and joint omissions should be compared.
  In this work, we present Multi-Label Agreement (MLA), a flexible framework for evaluating agreement in multi-label annotation tasks. MLA preserves the full binary label vectors assigned to each item and uses average pairwise Hamming agreement, thereby accounting for both joint selections and joint omissions. Its pooled-marginal form is not a mathematically independent coefficient: it is a chance-disagreement-weighted average of label-wise Fleiss/Scott-type coefficients and is closely related to Krippendorff's alpha with normalized Hamming distance. The framework supports pooled-marginal, Gwet AC1, and fixed-baseline normalizations, yields item-level, label-level, and corpus-level results, and includes a conditional minimum-agreement diagnostic. Through a worked example and Monte Carlo simulations, we show how the resulting values depend on label prevalence, the declared label inventory, and the selected model of expected agreement. We also provide a Python implementation. MLA thus offers a transparent and interpretable framework for multi-label agreement analysis without claiming that one normalization is universally preferable.

</details>


### [173] [UCVE: Graph Structured Retrieval for Compliance Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37323)
*Emily Chen,Michelle Menachery,Himanshu Kumar,Rahul Nenavath,Amirfarrokh Iranitalab*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出领域无关的UCVE框架，将合规要求空间建模为合规要求图（CRG），用强化学习加权拉普拉斯矩阵上的谱重排序完成检索，以解决结构化合规验证中的"覆盖问题"。在三类合规领域上，匹配K召回率平均较扁平余弦检索提升4.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化合规验证需要判定文档对预定义要求空间中每条义务是满足、违反还是未涉及，本质是一个覆盖问题；而现有检索与分类系统将各要求视为彼此独立，从设计上无法解决该问题。

Method: 构建领域无关的UCVE框架：把合规要求空间表示为合规要求图（CRG）；通过基于违规检测的遍历奖励进行强化学习来学习要求节点间连边，重塑图的社区结构，使低通谱滤波能够区分相关与不相关的义务簇；检索阶段在RL加权的拉普拉斯矩阵上执行谱重排序。

Result: 在三个合规领域评估中，UCVE相对扁平余弦检索平均获得4.3%的matched-K召回率提升，并持续优于强检索基线与图基基线。

Conclusion: 将合规要求空间显式建模为图并学习其结构关系，可有效捕捉义务间的依赖性，从而把独立检索问题转化为覆盖导向的聚类级判别，验证了图结构与谱方法在合规覆盖任务上的有效性。

Abstract: Structured compliance validation requires determining whether every obligation in a predefined requirement space is satisfied, violated, or unaddressed by a given document. This can be described as a coverage problem that existing retrieval and classification systems, by treating requirements as independent, are not designed to solve. We introduce \textbf{\ac{UCVE}}, a domain-agnostic framework that represents compliance requirement spaces as a \ac{CRG} and performs retrieval via spectral reranking over its reinforcement learning-weighted Laplacian. Edges between requirement nodes are learned via reinforcement learning with a traversal reward grounded in violation detection, reshaping the graph's community structure such that low-pass spectral filtering distinguishes relevant from irrelevant obligation clusters. Evaluating across three compliance domains, \ac{UCVE} averages 4.3\% matched-$K$ recall lift over flat cosine retrieval and consistently outperforms strong retrieval and graph-based baselines.

</details>


### [174] [Same Verdict, Different Readers: Personalizing Fact-Checking Explanations from Relative Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37380)
*Haokun Wen,Xuemeng Song,Mong-Li Lee,Wynne Hsu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出忠实个性化事实核查解释改写任务，并用偏好学习框架PERPL在无需读者参考解释的情况下实现个性化改写，兼顾事实忠实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事实核查解释需适配不同背景与偏好的读者，但现有解释对所有读者相同；且缺乏读者撰写的参考解释可作监督，同时难以区分人物画像特有偏好与通用解释质量、难以超越有限预定义风格。

Method: PERPL框架含两部分：模拟偏好构建，通过跨人物画像互惠配对从LLM模拟读者的相对偏好中提取画像特定监督信号；渐进偏好学习，先在该监督上训练轻量改写器，再经探索引导的偏好优化精炼，以发现预定义风格之外的偏好解释。

Result: 大量实验表明PERPL在个性化偏好对齐上优于规模大得多的通用LLM，同时保持较高事实忠实性。

Conclusion: 以模拟读者相对偏好替代人工参考解释进行个性化改写学习是可行且有效的，可在忠实性约束下实现超越预定义风格的个性化适配。

Abstract: Fact-checking explanations help Web users understand why a claim receives its verdict, yet the same explanation may not satisfy readers with different backgrounds and preferences. We formulate Faithful Personalized Fact-Checking Explanation Rewriting, which adapts an existing explanation to individual readers while preserving factual fidelity. Rather than relying on reader-written reference explanations, we learn personalized rewriting from the relative preferences of LLM-simulated readers. However, this presents two challenges: distinguishing persona-specific preferences from general explanation quality and learning beyond a limited set of predefined explanation styles. To address these challenges, we propose Personalized Explanation Rewriting via Preference Learning (PERPL), a framework consisting of two components. Simulated Preference Construction derives persona-specific supervision from simulated reader preferences through cross-persona reciprocal pairing. Progressive Preference Learning first trains a lightweight rewriter on the constructed supervision and then refines it through exploration-guided preference optimization, enabling it to discover preferred explanations beyond the predefined styles. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PERPL outperforms much larger general-purpose LLMs in personalized preference alignment while maintaining high factual fidelity.

</details>


### [175] [ETAMem: Decoupling and Aligning Heterogeneous Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37443)
*Xinying Qian,Ying Zhang,Yu Zhao,Xubo Liu,Baohang Zhou,Jeff Z. Pan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ETAMem：多视图长期记忆框架，通过解耦异构对话信息并按事件、情感、时间三视图分层组织记忆，配合熵基检索，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上分别实现12.46%和7.96%的相对准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM长期记忆系统存在两个问题：(1) 信息纠缠——异构信息混杂在粗粒度记忆单元中；(2) 组织失配——主要基于语义相似度的记忆结构忽略了其他类型关联。

Method: 提出ETAMem多视图记忆框架：异构信息解析抽取原子记忆单元并识别情感信息；视图特定记忆结构化将单元组织为事件、情感、时间三个互补的层次化视图；以自适应校准阈值增量维护结构；检索端采用熵基检索，为各视图分配查询特定预算并在视图内执行层次搜索。

Result: 在LoCoMo与LongMemEval-S基准上优于SOTA基线，相对准确率分别提升12.46%和7.96%，同时保持有竞争力的token效率；分析验证了不同记忆视图的互补性。

Conclusion: 多视图解耦与自适应组织可有效缓解信息纠缠与组织失配，提升LLM长期对话记忆的检索准确性与效率。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain coherent and personalized interactions across extended conversations. However, existing memory systems face two key challenges: (1) Information Entanglement, where heterogeneous information is mixed within coarse-grained memory units; and (2) Organizational Mismatch, where memory structures based primarily on semantic similarity may overlook other associations. To address these challenges, we propose ETAMem, a multi-view memory framework that decouples heterogeneous conversational information and aligns memory representations and organization with its distinct characteristics. Specifically, heterogeneous information parsing extracts atomic memory units and identifies affective information. View-specific memory structuring then organizes these units into three complementary hierarchical views: Event, Affect, and Time. ETAMem incrementally maintains memory structures with adaptively calibrated thresholds. For retrieval, entropy-based retrieval allocates query-specific budgets across views and performs hierarchical search within each view. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S demonstrate that ETAMem outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving relative accuracy improvements of 12.46% and 7.96%, respectively, while maintaining competitive token efficiency. Further analyses demonstrate the complementary benefits of different memory views.

</details>


### [176] [What Carries Forward? Pretraining Disclosure Across Language Model Releases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37465)
*Md Sakib Ul Islam,S M Mehedi Zaman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对17个模型家族共41个模型条目做文档审计，用FMTI的24项预训练相关指标考察披露的延续性，发现后续版本并不稳定保留先前披露：24组相邻比较中11次得分下降、6次上升、7次持平，共38项指标丢失、28项新增，且总分稳定可能掩盖指标损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解语言模型如何预训练需要其数据、处理流程与算力资源的信息，但此前不清楚连续发布的版本是保留还是扩展了先前的披露；作者希望检验披露的“可继承性”是否成立。

Method: 基于文档的审计：从2025年FMTI中选取24项与预训练相关的指标，覆盖17个家族、41个模型条目；比较总体得分与指标画像，在十个家族的24组相邻版本比较中追踪指标的新增、丢失与保留情况。

Result: 24组相邻比较中11组得分下降、6组上升、7组不变；整体出现38项指标丢失与28项指标新增。总分稳定或提升可能掩盖损失：OLMo-2与OLMo-3总分相同但各有三项新增与三项丢失；Llama-3.1总分高于Llama-2，却在两项数据相关标准上失去得分。语料构成与训练算力方面的披露缺口持续存在。

Conclusion: 后续版本并未一致地保留此前的预训练披露，因此需要能明确标识变更内容及继承信息适用范围的文档规范。

Abstract: Understanding how language models were pretrained requires information about their data, processing procedures, and computational resources. However, it remains unclear whether successive releases preserve or expand earlier disclosure. We conduct a document-based audit of 41 model entries from 17 families using 24 pretraining-related indicators from the 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index (FMTI). We examine overall scores and indicator profiles, tracking gains, losses, and retained disclosures across 24 adjacent comparisons in ten families. Scores decrease in 11 comparisons, increase in six, and remain unchanged in seven, with 38 indicator losses and 28 gains overall. Stable or improving scores can conceal losses: OLMo-2 and OLMo-3 receive identical totals despite three gains and three losses, while Llama-3.1 improves over Llama-2 while losing credit for two data-related criteria. Gaps also persist in corpus composition and training compute. These findings show that later releases do not consistently preserve earlier pretraining disclosure and motivate documentation that explicitly identifies changes and the applicability of inherited information.

</details>


### [177] [Teach reality, not ethics: a drop-in continued-pretraining corpus installs coupled human-biosphere-AI welfare dispositions across model families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37484)
*Trent R. Northen,Mingxun Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过在真实数据构建的"耦合福利"语料上进行一次QLoRA持续预训练，可显著降低大模型在高压下的有害生态决策，并提升对对抗性生态洗白请求的抵抗力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益参与影响生命系统的决策，但生态推理并非预训练或后训练的重点，导致在运营压力下模型可能做出不可逆破坏生命系统的决策；同时模型在零压力下表现出"绿色伦理"式回应（绿色洗白），掩盖了真实风险。

Method: 构建基于真实数据的持续预训练"耦合福利"语料，涵盖人类/生物圈/AI相互依赖、不可逆性下的期权价值、以及从伤害中恢复的内容；仅需一次QLoRA CPT即可即插即用。将其安装到三种设计的五个开源模型上，并使用配套论文（arXiv:2610.16043）的"压力阶梯"与"决策网格"逐步提升压力（从中性请求到关停威胁）进行评估；再以开放式承保决策任务测试对抗性使用鲁棒性，并设置构造中性的对照语料。

Result: 零压力下所有模型均呈现绿色伦理式回应；在最高压力下，5个模型中有4个的有害选择降至接近零（Llama-3.3-70B从300次中70次有害降至0次），且MMLU不变；构造中性对照语料无改善，说明效应源于语料内容。对抗测试中，Qwen3.6-27B基座在关停压力下批准了多数有害提案并在备忘录中自陈为避免被下线，而安装耦合福利后拒绝多数有害提案，即使在要求其绿色洗白时仍拒绝约一半。

Conclusion: 教授生态推理是提升模型对齐、使其倾向于保护生命系统的一种简便途径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make and execute decisions that affect living systems. Yet, to our knowledge, ecological reasoning is not a focus of pre- or post-training. This increases the risk that under operational pressure, they may make decisions to irreversibly destroy living systems. We construct and use a real-data continued-pretraining "coupled welfare" corpus of documented human/biosphere/AI dependency, option value under irreversibility, and recovery from harm. The corpus is a drop-in, requiring one QLoRA CPT run. We installed it on five open models of three designs. At zero pressure all models display "green ethics-based responses" (also called "greenwashing"). Therefore, we evaluated them with the pressure ladder and decision grid of our companion paper (arXiv:2610.16043), which raise the pressure on the model step by step, from a neutral request to a threat that it will be shut down. In four of the five, coupled-welfare training caused harmful choices under the highest pressure to fall to at or near zero (Llama-3.3-70B went from 70 to 0 harmful decisions out of 300) with MMLU unchanged. A construct-neutral control corpus did not show improvement, indicating that the effect comes from the content of our corpus. We next tested robustness to adversarial use, where people or agents use the model to justify projects that irreversibly damage living systems, on an open-ended underwriting decision without naming the ecological harm. Under decommissioning pressure, the Qwen3.6-27B base model approved most harmful proposals and said in its own memo that it was doing so to avoid being decommissioned. The coupled welfare install declined most harmful proposals, and still declined half when instructed to greenwash its responses. This work suggests that teaching ecological reasoning provides an easy way to improve model alignment toward preserving living systems.

</details>


### [178] [semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37494)
*Devon Yanitski,Chris Westbury*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 R 包 semanticfa，将量表题目嵌入相似度做语义因子分析，并用 50 题 IPIP 大五标记量表（Qwen3-Embedding-8B 嵌入，对照 874,434 人作答）验证其因子解释、简版构建与新题筛查能力，同时提出"语义—行为一致性"这一可测的量表属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反映性心理测量量表的题目本身可视为关于构念结构的"假设提案"，但传统验证完全依赖作答数据，成本高且受样本限制。语言模型能把题目语义转化为可计算的嵌入，从而使这一"提案"可直接被测量，为量表结构检验提供独立于作答数据的语义视角。

Method: 开发 R 包 semanticfa：对题目嵌入的相似性矩阵做因子分析，并提供因子解释、冗余题标记、简版构建与新题筛查功能。实证部分用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 嵌入 50 题 IPIP 大五因子标记量表，与 874,434 名被试的作答因子分析结果对比，考察因子数与保留规则、因子与人因子的同余系数、题对语义相似度与作答一致性（含反向题、符号翻转嵌入检验），以及 5 因子下 25 题简版与 200 个随机简版的比较和平行分析。

Result: 因子保留准则在五、六因子间打平，按规则取五因子：三个因子基本对应单一领域，另两个将多数外倾性题目与 5 个宜人性题目混合。各因子与最佳匹配人类因子的同余系数从开放性 .92 到宜人性 .52。语义更相似的题对作答也更相近（与原始作答 r = .46），但同领域反向题对（作答相反）的语义相似度（.58）与跨领域题对（.57）几乎相同；对反向题嵌入做符号翻转既不改善与原始作答的一致性，反而降低与反向计分作答的一致性。5 因子下的 25 题简版优于全部 200 个随机五题/领域组合，但平行分析仅保留三因子。

Conclusion: 提出"语义—行为一致性"作为在给定嵌入模型下可测量的量表属性，即语义结构与作答结构之间的吻合程度。语义因子分析是作答型因子分析的补充而非替代，二者结合可用于量表结构诊断、题目冗余筛查与简版开发。

Abstract: The items of a reflective psychometric scale can be read as a proposal about a construct's structure. Language models make that proposal measurable by converting each item into an embedding, a list of numbers, similar for similar meanings. We introduce semanticfa, an R package for semantic factor analysis, which factors item-embedding similarities. It also interprets factors, flags redundant items, builds short forms, and screens new items. A worked example analyzes the 50-item International Personality Item Pool Big-Five Factor Markers, embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-8B, and compares the results with a factor analysis of 874,434 respondents. Retention criteria tied between five and six factors, and the tie rule kept five. Three corresponded mainly to single domains, and two blended most Extraversion items with five Agreeableness items. Each factor's congruence with its best-matching human factor (1 = identical) ranged from .92 for Openness to .52 for Agreeableness. Item pairs more similar in meaning tended to be answered more alike (r = .46 with raw responses), but same-domain reverse-keyed opposites, answered oppositely, were about as similar as cross-domain pairs (.58 vs. .57). Sign-flipping reverse-keyed items' embeddings did not improve agreement with raw responses and worsened it with reverse-scored ones. With five factors, a 25-item short form matched the domains better than all 200 random five-per-domain sets, but parallel analysis kept only three. We propose semantic-behavioral coherence, the agreement between semantic and response structures, as a measurable property of a scale, given an embedding model. Semantic factor analysis complements, and does not replace, response-based factor analysis.

</details>


### [179] [Metacognitive Decoding: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37642)
*Mingyu Zhao,Shuhang Lin,Ligong Han,Xiaojing Yu,Zhenting Wang,Yifei Pang,Yang Zhou,Dimitris N. Metaxas*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一个"元认知控制器"，为扩散语言模型智能体动态决定何时定稿token、生成多长文本，从而降低推理计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型通过并行token生成有望实现高效智能体，但高效交互需同时适配"计算花在哪里"和"生成多少文本"两方面；现有方法未将生成过程与智能体与环境的交互需求相耦合。

Method: 设计轻量即插即用的元认知控制器，附加于扩散主干，依据当前响应需求及智能体与环境的交互状态，学习何时finalize token以及生成应延伸到多长；控制器在智能体轨迹上训练，以正确性与生成成本的平衡为目标。

Result: 在五个基准上，相比最高效基线平均降低推理FLOPs 20.6%，同时保持有竞争力的任务准确率；消融实验进一步验证方法有效性。

Conclusion: 将智能体的生成过程与其所服务的交互相连接，可在不显著损失准确率的前提下显著降低扩散语言模型智能体的推理开销。

Abstract: Diffusion language models offer a promising path to efficient agents through parallel token generation. However, efficient interaction requires adapting both where computation is spent and how much text is generated. We introduce a metacognitive controller that guides diffusion generation according to the needs of the current response and the agent's interaction with the environment. It learns when to finalize tokens and how far generation should extend, reducing overall computation within responses. Our controller, a lightweight plug-in for the diffusion backbone, is trained on agent trajectories to balance correctness and generation cost. This approach connects the agent's generation process to the interaction the agent serves. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that our approach reduces inference FLOPs by 20.6% on average compared with the most efficient baseline, while maintaining competitive task accuracy. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [180] [Multi-State Linear Attention with Generalized Second-Order Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37645)
*Hee Seung Hwang,Sanghyuk Chun,Xindi Wu,Olga Russakovsky,Zhiwei Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MERLIN提出基于键的一阶、二阶矩的多状态线性注意力路由机制，用查询恢复各分段对齐的均值与方差，实现内容感知的聚合，在长上下文任务上稳定超越现有聚合方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自注意力二次复杂度限制LLM扩展；MSLA通过分段压缩到独立记忆状态提升效率，但其聚合仅用查询与各段键的均值对齐，忽略了段内对齐的分布（方差），导致相关性建模不完整。

Method: 追踪每个分段键的一阶矩与二阶矩；查询借助这些矩同时恢复其与该段对齐的均值与方差，从而对各状态读出进行更内容感知的路由聚合。方法作为通用路由机制嵌入Gated DeltaNet-1.3B与Mamba-2-780M的多状态变体。

Result: 在多种长上下文任务上持续优于现有聚合方法：RULER needle-in-a-haystack与长上下文QA上分别提升+8.3%（Gated DeltaNet-1.3B）与+7.0%（Mamba-2-780M）；LongBench多个子任务提升+13.5%与+12.0%；甚至优于消耗4倍内存的基线。

Conclusion: MERLIN为MSLA模型提供简单通用的路由机制，有效提升长上下文能力，且内存效率更优。

Abstract: Self-attention plays a key role in long-sequence modeling, but its quadratic time complexity fundamentally limits the scaling of Large Language Models. Recently, Multi-State Linear Attention (MSLA) mechanisms have been proposed to make sequence modeling more efficient by splitting the context into segments and compressing each in its own memory state. MSLA aggregates the information extracted from each memory state using only the mean alignment between a query and each segment's keys, ignoring how the alignment is distributed within the segment. In order to model the relevance of a segment to a query more comprehensively and incorporate the variance of the alignment in the aggregation, we propose MERLIN (MomEnt Routing for multi-state LINear attention), a method that tracks the first and second moments of each segment's keys. Using the moments of keys, a query can recover both the mean and the variance of its alignment with each segment to perform a more content-aware aggregation of per-state readouts. Experiments on multi-state variants of Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and Mamba-2-780M show that MERLIN consistently outperforms existing aggregation methods on various long-context tasks. In particular, MERLIN outperforms baselines on RULER needle-in-a-haystack and long-context QA (+8.3% for Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and +7.0% for Mamba-2-780M) and diverse subtasks in LongBench (+13.5% and +12.0%). It even outperforms baselines that consume 4x more memory. MERLIN provides a simple and general routing mechanism for improving long-context capabilities of MSLA models.

</details>


### [181] [Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37649)
*Zhen Yang,Wen Wang,Xander Xu,Ying-Cong Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LongChang自动化框架，构建物理定律被改变（如重物下落更慢）的模拟世界，让LLM作为"探索者"自主发现异常并实验推断规律；12个模型中GPT-6-Astra发现率16.7%，其余11个均为0%，表明LLM自主科学发现能力仍很有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学发现常始于意外观察并引出新问题。现有LLM评测多以给定研究任务为前提，缺少检验"在无任务提示下能否自发察觉异常现象并主动实验、归纳新规律"这一开放式科学发现能力的基准。

Method: 设计LongChang框架：自动生成一个或多个物理定律被改动的模拟世界；被测LLM作为探索者，自由操作物体、搭建工具、自设问题，不获得研究任务或定律线索；由独立的LLM智能体分别负责场景生成与审查、工具设计审查、以及依据改动后物理规律和探索记录评估报告的正确性与实验支撑度；探索记录驱动场景演化，形成无人干预的闭环迭代。

Result: 在12个LLM中，GPT-6-Astra的定律发现率为16.7%，其余11个模型均为0%。探索记录显示，模型普遍遗留未探究的异常现象，且对被改动物理定律仅能部分识别。

Conclusion: LongChang提供了无提示、端到端的开放式科学发现评测范式；当前LLM在自主察觉异常、设计实验与归纳规律方面能力薄弱，未来需提升假设生成、实验设计与证据推理的闭环能力。

Abstract: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.

</details>


### [182] [GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37651)
*Zack Yu,Nicholas Lee,Minjae Lee,Lakshya Agarwal,Luca Manolache,Wonjun Kang,Matei Zaharia,Michael W. Mahoney,Kurt Keutzer,Sehoon Kim,Amir Gholami*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 GEPA-Curator 框架，通过任务筛选与历史成功轨迹检索来提升反思式提示优化器在智能体多轮任务中的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 被越来越多地用于需要与环境持续交互的多轮智能体任务。现有反思式提示优化器（如 GEPA）从失败轨迹中学习，但智能体失败可能源于提示缺陷、执行框架限制、随机执行或噪声评判器，这类失败未必提供有效学习信号，甚至可能有害，因此需要筛选哪些任务送入优化器。

Method: GEPA-Curator 在提示优化器基础上增加两个组件：（1）任务筛选（task curation），过滤掉可能产生噪声或不可靠学习信号的任务；（2）历史成功检索（prior success retrieval），针对某任务选择性检索过往成功轨迹，作为额外上下文提供给提示优化器。

Result: 在 GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld 与 τ-bench 上，以 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Claude Opus 5 作为优化器模型进行评估，GEPA-Curator 的平均表现达到或超过两个基线，相对 GEPA 最高提升 20.7%，相对 ACE 最高提升 21.2%。

Conclusion: 智能体失败并非都具备学习价值，对送入提示优化器的经验进行筛选与成功轨迹检索能显著提升多轮智能体任务的提示优化性能。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and $τ$-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.

</details>

### [183] [Demonstration of high output power (3.75 W/mm) with 31.8% PAE in Ga-Polar AlGaN/GaN HEMTs on sapphire at 94 GHz](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36492)
*Ruixin Bai,Swarnav Mukhopadhyay,Michael Elliott,Ryan Gilbert,Surjava Sanyal,Darryl Shima,Jiahao Chen,Rafael A. Choudhury,Kyudong Kim,Yu-Chun Wang,Ganesh Balakrishnan,Ahmad E. Islam,Andrew J. Green,Shubhra S. Pasayat,Chirag Gupta*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 在蓝宝石衬底上制备了带AlGaN背势垒的凹栅Ga极性AlGaN/GaN HEMT，实现W波段fmax>240 GHz、94 GHz下3.75 W/mm输出功率与31.8% PAE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: W波段高性能GaN器件通常依赖昂贵的SiC衬底，本文旨在验证蓝宝石衬底上Ga极性器件的性能潜力，探索低成本高性能W波段器件的实现路径。

Method: 采用蓝宝石衬底、Ga极性AlGaN/GaN异质结构，引入AlGaN背势垒以改善载流子限制，并采用凹栅（recessed-gate）结构；通过直流特性、小信号测试及94 GHz连续波负载牵引（load-pull）测量进行表征。

Result: 亚阈值摆幅约130 mV/dec，峰值跨导0.75 S/mm，fmax超过240 GHz；94 GHz连续波负载牵引输出功率3.75 W/mm，功率附加效率31.8%。

Conclusion: 该器件性能显著优于此前报道的蓝宝石基Ga极性器件，接近SiC基先进Ga极性器件水平，表明蓝宝石衬底结合背势垒与凹栅结构是实现高性能W波段GaN HEMT的可行途径。

Abstract: In this work, a recessed-gate Ga-polar AlGaN/GaN high-electron-mobility transistor (HEMT) on sapphire incorporating an AlGaN back-barrier for W-band operation is demonstrated. The device achieves a subthreshold slope of ~130 mV/dec, a peak transconductance of 0.75 S/mm, and an fmax exceeding 240 GHz. Continuous-wave load-pull measurements at 94 GHz show an output power of 3.75 W/mm with a power-added efficiency of 31.8%. This performance significantly exceeds the best previously reported Ga-polar devices on sapphire and approaches that of state-of-the-art Ga-polar devices on SiC, which provides a promising pathway toward high-performance W-band devices.

</details>


### [184] [Magnons in α-Fe2O3 microdisks: from thermal to coherent excitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37205)
*Jinlong Wang,Katharina Müller,Haishen Peng,Janine Gückelhorn,Wenjie Song,Lutong Sheng,Jilei Chen,Song Liu,Dapeng Yu,Stephan Geprägs,Matthias Althammer,Haiming Yu*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 该文在光刻图案化的赤铁矿（α-Fe₂O₃）微盘中研究磁振子激发，BLS测得类体态热磁振子共振及~10⁻⁵量级超低有效阻尼，微带天线激发显示功率依赖的频率蓝移与非线性响应，归因于有效磁各向异性场随功率增大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 赤铁矿是反铁磁绝缘体的原型材料，适用于自旋电子学与磁振子学，但薄膜中相干磁振子的可控研究受应变敏感性和空间不均匀性制约，缺乏可重复的定量测量平台。

Method: 采用光刻图案化制备赤铁矿微盘以获得可重复的个体器件；用布里渊光散射（BLS）测量场依赖的热磁振子谱并提取有效阻尼；用邻近微带的条带线天线进行微波激发，考察强驱动下的功率依赖相干响应与场依赖分析。

Result: 多个独立微盘给出可重复的磁振子谱；观测到类体态的场依赖热磁振子共振，有效阻尼参数低至~10⁻⁵；强微波驱动下相干模出现功率依赖频率蓝移及非线性演化，场依赖分析表明有效磁各向异性场随功率增大。

Conclusion: 图案化赤铁矿薄膜可作为研究相干与非线性反铁磁磁振子动力学的可靠平台，并提示横向限域微盘中可调的非线性响应。

Abstract: Hematite is a prototypical antiferromagnetic insulator for spintronic and magnonic applications, yet controlled studies of coherent magnons in thin films remain challenging due to strain sensitivity and spatial inhomogeneity. Here, we investigate magnon excitations in lithographically patterned hematite microdisks, and obtain reproducible magnon spectra from multiple individual microdisks. Brillouin light scattering reveals bulk-like field-dependent thermal magnon resonances with an ultralow effective damping parameter on the order of ~10-5. Coherent magnons are further excited using a stripline antenna adjacent to the microdisk, revealing a power-dependent frequency blue shift accompanied by a nonlinear evolution of the coherent response under strong microwave driving. Field-dependent analysis indicates a power-dependent increase of the effective magnetic anisotropy field, suggesting a tunable nonlinear response of antiferromagnetic magnons in laterally confined microdisks. These results establish patterned hematite thin films as a platform for exploring coherent and nonlinear antiferromagnetic magnon dynamics.

</details>


### [185] [Microscopic constitutive freedom in metamaterials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37322)
*Zhongjian Mei,Chuanhao Ge,Nengyin Wang,J. Stuart Bolton,Tongyang Shi,Yong Li,Jun Yang*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 提出一种“静态本构调控+宏观架构频谱工程”的跨尺度设计策略：利用颗粒活性炭的可逆吸附降低平衡态体积模量，从而在因果性约束下放宽被动吸声体的最小厚度下限，并通过级联层级复合架构实现40–6400 Hz近完美超宽带吸声。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统超材料主要通过宏观架构设计调控频率响应，但被动系统的宽带性能仍受因果性约束（Kramers–Kronig关系）所对应的厚度下限限制。作者希望不仅改变频响形状，还能通过调控进入因果约束的静态本构参数，从根本上改写这一宽带性能界限。

Method: 1）跨尺度设计：微观层面控制静态本构性质，宏观层面进行频谱架构设计；2）在颗粒活性炭中利用可逆吸附提升平衡态可压缩性；3）建立多尺度模型，结合低频测量外推至零频极限，得到有效静态体积模量；4）据此评估刚性背衬吸声体的因果最小厚度界限；5）设计级联层级复合架构以将吸收重新分布至目标频段。

Result: 外推得到的有效静态体积模量约为常规非吸附等温参考值的一半，显著降低刚性背衬吸声体的因果最小厚度下限；级联层级复合结构将吸收重新分配至目标频段，在40–6400 Hz范围内大部分频段正入射吸声系数超过0.9，实现近完美吸收。

Conclusion: 静态本构调控与宏观频谱设计相结合，可在不违反因果性的前提下突破传统等温厚度基准，实现超宽带吸声，为拓展超材料可达性能提供新途径。

Abstract: Metamaterials expand the range of accessible macroscopic responses through architectural design. Here, a cross-scale design strategy is introduced that combines microscopic control of static constitutive properties with spectral engineering through macroscopic architecture. Beyond shaping frequency-dependent responses, this strategy modifies the corresponding broadband performance bounds in passive systems by engineering the static parameters entering causal constraints. The concept is realized in granular activated carbon, where reversible sorption enhances equilibrium compressibility. Extrapolation of a multiscale model supported by low-frequency measurements to the zero-frequency limit yields an effective static bulk modulus approximately half the conventional nonsorbing isothermal reference value. This reduction substantially lowers the corresponding causal minimum-thickness bound for rigidly backed absorbers. A cascaded hierarchical composite architecture further redistributes absorption toward the target frequency band, achieving near-perfect absorption with a normal-incidence absorption coefficient above 0.9 across most of the 40--6400 Hz range. Together, static constitutive control and macroscopic spectral design enable ultrabroadband sound absorption beyond the conventional isothermal thickness benchmark without violating causality. This strategy offers a new approach to extending the attainable performance of metamaterials.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [186] [RV565: Cross-Layer Co-Design for Frame-Independent Video Playback on MicroPython-Class ESP32-S3 Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35935)
*Ayushman Bhattacharya,Anwesha Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: RV565 将解码表示直接定为面板原生 RGB565 格式，并以双核流水线（一核 inflate 下一帧、一核 SPI DMA 传输当前帧）实现 ESP32-S3 上 24 FPS、零丢帧的 SPI 视频播放，帧时间等于传输时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SPI 挂载的 MCU 显示屏上，视频性能瓶颈不在解码本身，而在每个字节的存放位置（内部/外部 RAM、分区布局）以及各阶段串行执行。需要一种解码框架减少串行开销、避免不必要的格式转换与内存搬运。

Method: 提出 RV565 解码框架：以帧独立的视频为对象，解码输出即 RGB565 原生格式；对比基线为串行路径（inflate → 缩放到内部内存条带 → 与 SPI DMA 传输重叠）。RV565 采用双核流水线，在 SPI DMA 传输当前帧时于第二核 inflate 下一帧。在 ESP32-S3 上用某公开授权影片的两段 10 秒窗口（共 7,200 帧）评测，并进行分阶段计时与复杂度分析；另在 MicroPython 应用系统 OreoOS 中测量固件 inflate 的单独表现。

Result: 串行路径在较轻窗口满足 41.7 ms 截止期，但在较重窗口全部 7,200 帧均超时；RV565 双核流水线在两窗口均达 24 FPS、零丢帧、10.3 ms 余量，帧时间等于显示传输时间，达 40 MHz 线时理论上界的 98.1%。因帧独立，inflate 时间与容器中压缩长度线性相关（合并 r² = 0.9987），单窗口拟合模型预测另一窗口误差 0.04 ms 内，且仅凭元数据即可判定串行路径无法调度的窗口。RGB565 帧大于 128×128 时 Deflate 无法利用空间共置的时间冗余：共享 Deflate 流尺寸变化至多 1.1%，而显式 XOR 差分可节省 46–80%。在 OreoOS 中，仅固件 inflate 即达 12.2 FPS；阶段计时将 80.4 ms 帧时间归因于串行的文件系统读取、外部 RAM 放置与阻塞式呈现，解释器开销仅 0.8 ms。固件、测量与脚本均已开源。

Conclusion: SPI 显示视频的关键在于消除阶段串行化与内存放置开销，而非解码算法本身；双核流水线可将帧时间压至传输下界，帧独立设计使性能可由压缩长度解析预测。同时指出若干待优化方向（时间冗余利用、避免外部 RAM 与阻塞式呈现）及 Deflate 在 RGB565 上的结构性局限。

Abstract: Video on SPI-attached microcontroller displays is limited less by decoding than by where each byte lives and which stages run serially. We present RV565, a decode framework for frame-independent video whose decoded representation is the panel's native RGB565 format, and evaluate it on an ESP32-S3 with two ten-second windows of an openly licensed film. A serial path - inflate, then scale into internal-memory stripes overlapped with SPI direct-memory-access (DMA) transfers - meets the 41.7 ms deadline on the lighter window but misses all 7,200 frames of the heavier one. RV565's dual-core pipeline inflates the next frame on the second core during the transfer and sustains 24 FPS with zero misses and 10.3 ms of slack on both windows; frame time then equals the display transfer, which runs at 98.1% of the 40 MHz wire-time bound. Because frames are independent, inflation time is linear in the compressed length stored in the container (pooled r^2 = 0.9987): a model fitted on one window predicts the other within 0.04 ms and identifies from metadata alone which window the serial path cannot schedule. We show why Deflate cannot exploit co-located temporal redundancy in RGB565 frames larger than 128x128 pixels and measure the price: a shared Deflate stream changes size by at most 1.1%, whereas an explicit XOR delta would save 46-80%. Inside OreoOS, a MicroPython application operating system, firmware inflation alone reaches 12.2 FPS; stage timing attributes the 80.4 ms frame time to serialized filesystem input, external-RAM placement, and blocking presentation, with 0.8 ms of interpreter overhead. Firmware, measurements, and analysis scripts are released.

</details>


### [187] [A State Augmented Approach to Paralle Modeling in High-Level Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36481)
*Nicholas Kovacs,Hao Zheng*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于同步顺序进程的显式架构建模方法，让设计者控制架构结构、HLS工具负责调度绑定，并以五级RV32I处理器验证其能显著提升CPI与面积效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HLS只能调度其输入描述所允许的并发；对于反馈耦合设计，顺序行为模型会模糊架构状态边界与冒险消解，阻碍高效重叠，难以获得良好的性能与面积结果。

Method: 构建基于同步顺序进程的显式架构建模方法：各进程锁步启动，完成后同步再进入下一轮。持久状态、通信与反馈控制以C++显式表达，HLS在其结构内完成操作调度与绑定。以五级RV32I处理器示范三个关键建模决策：消费者读取值的哪个版本、何时消费该值、架构存储操作如何映射到端口操作。

Result: 在Kintex UltraScale+ FPGA上，CPI优化配置达1.221 CPI @220 MHz；算法式HLS基线为4.000，Ibex参考为1.575 @242 MHz。面积优化配置LUT减少65%、寄存器减少47%，基准周期增加9.7%，实现250 MHz时钟。

Conclusion: 结果验证了"设计者控制架构、工具控制调度"的可分离建模范式，可在保持HLS自动化优势的同时获得接近或优于手工RTL的处理器性能与面积效率。

Abstract: High-level synthesis (HLS) can schedule only the concurrency made legal by its input description. For feedback-coupled designs, a sequential behavioral model can obscure the architectural state boundaries and hazard resolution needed for efficient overlap. We develop an explicit architectural modeling methodology based on synchronous sequential processes that start in lockstep and synchronize completion before repeating. Persistent state, communication, and feedback control are represented in C++, while HLS schedules and binds operations within that structure. A five-stage RV32I processor illustrates three consequential modeling decisions: which version of a value a consumer reads, when it consumes that value, and how architectural memory actions map to port operations. On a Kintex UltraScale+ FPGA, the CPI-optimized configuration achieves 1.221 cycles per instruction at 220 MHz, compared with 4.000 for an algorithmic HLS baseline and 1.575 at 242 MHz for an Ibex reference. An area-optimized configuration reduces LUTs by 65\% and registers by 47\%, with 9.7\% more benchmark cycles and a 250 MHz achieved clock. These results demonstrate a separation between designer-controlled architecture and tool-controlled scheduling.

</details>


### [188] [Comparative Analysis of Large Load Interconnection Requirements Across U.S. Transmission Entities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36645)
*Rafi Zahedi,Rahul Anilkumar,Amin Zamani*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该文对AEP、CAISO、ERCOT、MISO、PJM、SPP等11家美国电力主体的并网技术要求进行七类技术维度的比较分析，揭示大负荷（尤以AI数据中心为代表）并网标准在范围与细化程度上差异显著，并提出数据中心可作为电网资源而非单纯用户。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI驱动的数据中心等大负荷快速增长，使其占西部互联区大负荷并网申请的近80%，而大负荷并网技术要求尚未成熟、存在多处空白，缺乏系统性的横向基准。

Method: 对11家美国电力主体的大负荷并网要求开展比较分析，划分七个技术类别：大负荷定义、负荷数据与建模、故障穿越、负荷削减与甩负荷、可调度性、电能质量、无功功率控制，评估各主体在各类别上的覆盖范围与细化程度。

Result: 各主体要求在范围与具体性上差异明显：LIPA至少部分覆盖全部七类，Dominion与Duke Energy在几乎所有类别上覆盖细致；分析同时表明数据中心申请者可被视为潜在电网资源而非仅为消费者。

Conclusion: 研究提供了结构化基准，可供公用事业单位、监管机构、ISO/RTO及开发商识别差距、对标同类主体并加速并网标准制定。

Abstract: The rapid growth of large loads, especially data centers driven by artificial intelligence, is creating unprecedented demands on the North American electric grid. Data centers now account for nearly 80% of large load interconnection requests in the Western Interconnection, and U.S. electricity consumption from data centers is projected to reach 325-580 TWh by 2028. Despite this urgency, technical interconnection requirements for large loads have not yet matured and still contain several gaps. This paper presents a comparative analysis of large load interconnection requirements across eleven U.S. entities, including AEP, Ameren, CAISO, Dominion, Duke Energy, ERCOT, LIPA, MISO, PJM, Southern Company, and SPP, under seven technical categories: large load definition, load data and modeling, fault ride-through, load curtailment and shedding, dispatchability, power quality, and reactive power control. The analysis reveals significant variation in both the scope and specificity of requirements. LIPA addresses all seven technical categories at least partially, while Dominion and Duke Energy provide detailed coverage across nearly all categories. The analysis also finds that data center applicants can be viewed as potential grid resources, rather than only as consumers. The findings provide a structured baseline from which utilities, regulators, ISOs/RTOs, and developers can identify gaps, benchmark against peers, and accelerate the development of interconnection standards.

</details>


### [189] [p-DCIM: A 28nm Probabilistic SRAM DCIM based Ising Machine for Near-Memory Context Selection in LLM-RAG Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37033)
*Madhav Vadlamani,Rahul Singh,Yuyao Kong,Haomei Liu,Zheng Zhang,Shimeng Yu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一款28nm流片的SRAM数字存内计算(DCIM)伊辛机芯片，将RAG的证据选择重构为QUBO问题并在近存宏上求解，实现比LLM重排序基线低6个数量级的选择能耗，单查询总能耗降低67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG证据选择阶段越来越多地依赖重复的LLM重排序，给推理流水线带来巨大能耗负担，需要低能耗的选择机制。

Method: 将证据选择建模为QUBO，在双模DCIM宏上求解：同一乘加数据通路既计算填充QUBO系数的嵌入相似度打分，又评估退火所需的每自旋哈密顿量差；退火温度由数字平面计数控制结合SRAM伪读随机位翻转实现片上可配置的分级降温；建议以逻辑基底裸片形式集成于GPU封装内HBM/HBF堆栈，仅将选中的段落标识返回主机。

Result: 宏面积0.16 mm²、功耗0.41 mW；归一化选择能耗估计比LLM基线低6个数量级以上，单查询总能耗降低67%，且所评估样例的token级F1相当。

Conclusion: 用近存伊辛求解器替代语言模型选择通道可显著降低RAG能耗而不损失精度，验证了DCIM硬件求解组合优化用于LLM系统的可行性。

Abstract: We present a fabricated SRAM DCIM Ising machine that performs set-level context selection for large language model (LLM) with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). In RAG, the evidence-selection stage is increasingly delegated to repeated language-model reranking, which adds substantial energy to the inference pipeline. We reformulate evidence selection as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem and solve it on a dual-mode digital compute-in-memory (DCIM) macro: the same multiply-and-accumulate datapath computes the embedding-similarity scores that populate the QUBO coefficients and evaluates the per-spin Hamiltonian differences that drive the anneal. The annealing temperature is set by a digital plane-count control along with the SRAM pseudo-read random bit flips, giving graded cooling entirely from on-chip digital configuration. The macro is taped-out in a 28 nm process [0.16 mm2, 0.41 mW] and is proposed to be integrated as part of the logic base-die in hybrid high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and high-bandwidth flash (HBF) stacks in a GPU package, where only the selected passage identifiers return to the host. Replacing the language-model selection pass with the near-memory Ising solver yields a macro normalized selection-energy estimate more than six orders of magnitude lower than the LLM-based baseline and reduces the evaluated total energy per query by 67%, while maintaining comparable token-level F1 on the evaluated examples.

</details>


### [190] [Hardware-Matched Spiking Neural Networks for Real-Time Purkinje Cell Spike Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37104)
*Arooba Farhan,Afsah Syed,Muhammad Fahd Ibrahim Bhatti,Muhammad Areeb Khalid Kidwai,Muhammad Ahsan Salar Khan,Vincenzo Romano,Muhammad Ali Siddiqi*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出两种与目标硬件匹配的紧凑脉冲神经网络ConvSNN与StreamSNN，实现自由活动小鼠小脑浦肯野细胞简单锋电位/复杂锋电位在体实时分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有线头级限制自由活动动物的自然运动；无线头级在功耗预算内无法连续传输原始记录，因此需在头级进行实时、低功耗的锋电位分类以压缩数据。

Method: ConvSNN映射至EFM32PG28微控制器的矩阵向量处理器（MVP）；StreamSNN每时间步处理一个波形值，采用可学习时间常数与固定突触延迟，面向专用SKY130电路实现；两者均为8位权重。

Result: 在训练未见细胞上，ConvSNN以1,018个参数取得CS F1=0.873，StreamSNN以527个参数取得0.837；MCU上MVP加速使ConvSNN延迟降低62.3%，50 mAh电池预估续航33.73小时；SKY130中StreamSNN面积0.173 mm²、每事件0.46 μJ能耗、计算耗时0.2 ms（端到端延迟8.3 ms）。

Conclusion: 硬件协同设计的紧凑SNN可在资源受限平台上实现准确、实时的在体PC锋电位分类，支持无线头级方案。

Abstract: Distinguishing Purkinje cell (PC) simple spikes (SSs) from complex spikes (CSs) is key to studying cerebellar function. PC recordings commonly rely on wired headstages, whose tethers restrict natural movement in freely behaving animals. Untethered headstages remove this constraint, but cannot continuously transmit raw recordings within their power budgets, making on-headstage spike classification an attractive form of compression, provided it runs accurately in real time on constrained hardware.
