This work presents two compact spiking neural networks (SNNs) matched to their target hardware: ConvSNN, which maps to the Matrix Vector Processor (MVP) of an EFM32PG28 microcontroller, and StreamSNN, which processes one waveform value per timestep using learned time constants and fixed synaptic delays for a dedicated SKY130 circuit. Evaluated on cells unseen during training, ConvSNN achieves a CS F1 of 0.873 with 1,018 parameters and StreamSNN 0.837 with 527 parameters, both with eight-bit weights. On the microcontroller, MVP acceleration reduces ConvSNN latency by 62.3\% and extends estimated battery life to 33.73~hours on a 50~mAh battery. In SKY130, StreamSNN occupies 0.173~mm$^2$ and consumes 0.46~$μ$J per event, with 0.2~ms of computation within an 8.3~ms end-to-end latency.

</details>


### [191] [AnalogScout: Simulation-Efficient PVT-Aware Analog Sizing with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37319)
*Yichen Long,Keren Zhu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: AnalogScout：由LLM智能体驱动的仿真高效PVT感知模拟电路尺寸设计框架，通过复用优秀设计、解析gm/Id局部尺寸与全角验证下的全局精修，在16k次仿真预算下较CMA-ES降低43.3%功耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟器件尺寸需在全PVT角满足所有指标以保证流片成功，但逐候选全角SPICE仿真主导了设计时间。传统代理模型优化器直接搜索尺寸空间，近期LLM智能体虽引入电路知识却仍将尺寸交给全局优化器；两者都依赖反复多角仿真学习电路响应，在仿真预算有限时代价高昂。

Method: 提出AnalogScout框架，融合三项机制：(1) 精英设计复用（提供已验证可复用设计）；(2) 基于gm/Id的解析式局部尺寸设计；(3) 在全角验证约束下的全局精修，由LLM智能体统筹调度。

Result: 在三个复杂度递增的SKY130 OTA上，等预算16k次仿真时功耗较进化策略CMA-ES降低43.3%；仅用7.0%预算即达到CMA-ES最终功耗水平；三个OTA功耗均低于贝叶斯优化；在两个已测试OTA上功耗低于两种复现的LLM驱动流程。

Conclusion: 以LLM智能体整合设计复用与解析局部尺寸可大幅削减多角仿真预算，实现更优的PVT感知模拟尺寸设计，验证了将解析知识与经验复用引入智能体流程的有效性。

Abstract: Analog device sizing must satisfy all specifications across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners to ensure tape-out success, but simulating every candidate at all corners dominates the sizing time and slows design iteration. Conventional surrogate-based optimizers search the sizing space directly, while recent large language model (LLM) agents add circuit knowledge to designs but still delegate the sizes to global optimizers. Both learn the circuit response from repeated multi-corner SPICE simulations and optimize on top of it, which becomes expensive under a limited simulation budget. Providing an agent with reusable verified designs and sizing sub-blocks analytically could save most of this budget. We propose AnalogScout, a simulation-efficient PVT-aware sizing framework driven by an LLM agent. Combining elite-design reuse, analytic gm/Id local sizing and global refinement under full-corner verification, AnalogScout reduces power by 43.3% relative to the evolution strategy CMA-ES at an equal budget of 16k simulations on three SKY130 OTAs of increasing complexity, and reaches the final CMA-ES power after 7.0% of that budget. It also attains lower power than Bayesian optimization on all three OTAs and than two re-implemented LLM-driven flows on the two OTAs where they were tested.

</details>


### [192] [Kernel Performance Engineering under Physical Non-Idealities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37466)
*Supun Kuruppu,Pranav Dangi,Wei Li,Zhenyu Bai,Tulika Mitra*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 论文以 H100 GPU 的分布式共享内存（DSMEM）为例，揭示传统硬件抽象所掩盖的物理非理想性（如 floorsweeping 资源削减与 TDP 功耗限制）如何影响 kernel 性能，并提出 wave-aware 聚类策略加以优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规硬件抽象隐藏了 IC 设计与制造中的物理非理想性（如 floorsweeping、功耗/热约束），这些因素会削减可用于 cluster 执行的硬件资源，抵消 DSMEM 降低数据移动所带来的收益，并使优化机会被忽视；作者希望显式地对这些约束建模以改进 kernel 性能分析。

Method: 以 NVIDIA H100 的 DSMEM 为案例，分析 floorsweeping 对 cluster 可用资源的限制；据此设计感知资源约束的 wave-aware clustering 策略；使用 global-load-and-broadcast 微基准、GEMM 以及 Hopper 版 FlashAttention 4 进行评估；并结合 TDP 限制下 DVFS 引起 SM 频率变化的机制解释吞吐变化；最后在 Tenstorrent Wormhole 加速器上做跨平台验证。

Result: 实验显示这些资源约束对性能影响显著：wave-aware clustering 相对基线将 FlashAttention 4 吞吐提升最高 5.30%；在 TDP 限制下，减少数据移动可通过 DVFS 提升 SM 频率，从而解释原本异常的吞吐提升；Wormhole 加速器上同样存在功耗约束限制吞吐扩展的现象。

Conclusion: 物理非理想性应被纳入 kernel 分析与优化框架；显式建模 floorsweeping 与功耗约束可带来实际性能收益，且该问题不局限于 GPU，在 Wormhole 等加速器上同样重要，具有普适性意义。

Abstract: Physical non-idealities in integrated circuit (IC) design and fabrication are concealed by conventional hardware abstractions, yet they can limit kernel performance and obscure optimization opportunities. Using distributed shared memory (DSMEM) on NVIDIA H100 GPUs as a case study, we show how floorsweeping restricts hardware resources available for clustered execution, potentially offsetting the benefits of reduced data movement enabled by DSMEM. Guided by these insights, we develop a wave-aware clustering strategy that accounts for these resource constraints to improve kernel performance. Evaluations using a global-load-and-broadcast microbenchmark, GEMM, and the Hopper version of FlashAttention 4 demonstrate the performance implications of these constraints, with wave-aware clustering improving FlashAttention 4 throughput by up to 5.30% over its baseline. We further show that, under thermal design power (TDP) limits, reduced data movement enables higher Streaming Multiprocessor (SM) frequencies through Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS), explaining otherwise unexpected throughput improvements. Extending this analysis beyond GPUs, we show that power constraints also limit throughput scaling on Tenstorrent's Wormhole accelerator, highlighting the broader importance of accounting for physical non-idealities when analyzing and optimizing kernel performance.

</details>


### [193] [SLICE-CiM: Selective Layer-wise Inference Control Engine with Confidence-Based Early Exit for SRAM based Digital Compute-in-Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37601)
*Pratham Sharma,Mohd Faisal Khan,Santosh Kumar Vishvakarma*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出四个可综合的外设模块消除数字SRAM存内计算宏的三类外设控制低效，在65nm下以328.96μW（系统功耗0.24%）实现MobileNetV2能效从31.35提升至454.91 TOPS/W（13.33倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字SRAM CIM宏虽免去片外权重传输，但外设控制逻辑存在三处低效：降低精度时的位切片过度激活（L1）、不必要的累加深度（L2）、精度切换时的空闲停顿（L3）。

Method: 设计四个可综合外设模块并协同优化：Flush-Merge Enable（FME）控制器、基于置信度的提前退出（EE）模块、带解码器的精度寄存器（PR/PD）、位串行周期控制器（CC），以降低开关活动、字线开销与漏电。TSMC 65nm实现，频率335MHz。

Result: 综合后面积1769.760μm²，PnR后1982.131μm²；门级VCD分析漏电6.0706μW，动态功耗288.2902μW（综合后）/322.8850μW（PnR后），合计328.9556μW（系统功耗0.2402%）。EE模块占动态功耗58.2%，字线门控（WLG）占面积58.1%。MobileNetV2（CIFAR-100）上能效由31.35 TOPS/W（8b/8b, 1.2V）扩展至454.91 TOPS/W（2b/8b, 0.8V），提升13.33倍，且无需修改位单元或重训练。

Conclusion: 该外设框架可有效消除位切片过度激活、累加深度冗余与精度切换停顿，在小幅系统功耗开销下实现精度自适应的显著能效增益；面向利用稀疏性的CNN负载，Transformer扩展为未来工作。

Abstract: Digital SRAM compute-in-memory (CIM) macros enable energy-efficient CNN inference by eliminating off-chip weight transfers; however, peripheral control logic introduces three inefficiencies: bit- slice over-activation at reduced precision (L1), unnecessary accumula- tion depth (L2), and idle precision-transition stalls (L3). To address these, we present four synthesizable peripheral blocks: a Flush-Merge Enable (FME) controller, a Confidence-Based Early-Exit (EE) module, a Precision Register with Decoder (PR/PD), and a Bit-Serial Cycle Controller (CC), co-designed to minimize switching activity, wordline overhead, and leakage. Implemented in TSMC 65-nm CMOS at 335 MHz, the peripheral framework occupies 1769.760 μm2 post-synthesis and 1982.131 μm2 post-PnR. Gate-level VCD analysis reports 6.0706 μW leakage and 288.2902 μW (post-synthesis) / 322.8850 μW (post-PnR) dynamic power, totaling 328.9556 μW (0.2402% of system power). The EE module dominates dynamic power (58.2%), while WLG dominates area (58.1%). System evaluation on MobileNetV2 (CIFAR-100) shows efficiency scaling from 31.35 TOPS/W (8b/8b, 1.2 V) to 454.91 TOPS/W (2b/8b, 0.8 V), achieving 13.33x improvement without bitcell modification or retraining. The framework targets CNN workloads exploiting sparsity, with Transformer extension as future work.

</details>


<div id='eess.SP'></div>

# eess.SP [[Back]](#toc)

### [194] [Acceleration data-based robust on-board monitoring of hunting proximity in railway vehicles under uncertainty: A feasibility study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36122)
*Kyriakos Kritikakos,Spilios D. Fassois,John S. Sakellariou*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文评估在车/轨及运营条件不确定性下，车载实时蛇行（hunting）起始邻近度评估的可行性，提出基于灰色非线性车辆模型与最大李雅普诺夫指数（MLE）估计的分类方法，将蛇行邻近度划分为若干速度邻近区间，蒙特卡洛仿真显示分类准确率达97.08%，对故障悬挂与空心磨耗车轮具有鲁棒性，但在磨耗轨道条件下性能有所下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛇行失稳是铁路车辆运行安全的关键问题，需要在车载、实时条件下提前评估蛇行起始邻近度；而实际中车辆/轨道参数及运营条件存在显著不确定性，使传统方法难以可靠判断，因此需要一种对不确定性具备鲁棒性的实时评估手段。

Method: 构建灰色非线性车辆模型，其参数由车载加速度测量数据估计；以基于模型的Maximum Lyapunov Exponent（MLE）作为蛇行邻近度度量；据此设计分类器，将蛇行邻近度归入若干预设的速度邻近区间；采用基于MATLAB的多体车辆模型在四种运营场景下开展蒙特卡洛仿真，评估性能与鲁棒性，并与一种潜在替代方法进行对比。

Result: 该方法分类准确率达到97.08%，显著优于替代方案；在故障悬挂与空心磨耗车轮条件下仍保持鲁棒性；但在磨耗轨道条件下出现一定性能折衷（下降）。

Conclusion: 车载实时蛇行起始邻近度评估在参数与运营不确定性下是可行的；基于灰色非线性模型与MLE的分类框架具有高精度与良好鲁棒性，具备工程应用潜力，后续需针对磨耗轨道等恶劣工况进一步提升性能。

Abstract: The feasibility of on-board, real-time proximity assessment to railway hunting initiation under uncertainty arising from vehicle/track and other operational conditions is assessed. In this context, a novel method that classifies hunting proximity into one of several prespecified speed proximity intervals is introduced, based on a grey nonlinear vehicle model with parameters estimated from on-board acceleration measurements and model-based estimation of the Maximum Lyapunov Exponent (MLE) as a hunting proximity measure. The method's performance and robustness are assessed via Monte Carlo simulations using a MATLAB-based multi-body vehicle model and four operating scenarios. The method is shown to achieve excellent performance achieving 97.08 % classification accuracy, which marks a significant improvement over a potential alternative. Its robustness to faulty suspensions and hollow-worn wheels is also demonstrated, although certain performance compromise is observed under worn-track conditions.

</details>


### [195] [Multichannel Sampling and Reconstruction in Multidimensional Shift-Invariant Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36142)
*Riya Ghosh,Satish Mulleti,Chandra Sekhar Seelamantula*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 基于有限维多相表示构建多维多通道采样与重构框架，涵盖周期非均匀位移与导数测量，并给出不规则导数测量的迭代重构方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多维主平移不变空间中的多通道采样（含位移与导数测量）缺乏统一的频域刻画与稳定性判据，尤其当测量非规则时经典多相结构失效，需要可证明收敛的重构方法。

Method: 将周期非均匀位移与导数测量建模为分析通道，导出联系测量值与系数序列多相分量的频域线性系统；以多相矩阵的一致奇异值界刻画稳定恢复，并由其Moore–Penrose左逆给出显式合成核；对非规则导数测量，采用局部双变量Hermite插值加正交投影到平移不变空间的迭代方案，推导保证几何收敛的压缩条件。

Result: 框架同时适用于可分离与真不可分离生成函数，并涵盖若干经典一维采样公式作为特例；数值实验展示两类生成函数的重构性能，并验证对加性测量噪声与采样位置扰动的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 多相频域系统为多维多通道采样提供了统一的稳定性分析与显式重构工具，迭代Hermite插值—投影方法在非规则导数测量下具有收敛保证且实用稳健。

Abstract: We develop a multichannel sampling and reconstruction framework for multidimensional principal shift-invariant spaces based on a finite-dimensional polyphase representation. Periodic nonuniform shifts and derivative measurements are modeled as analysis channels, leading to a frequency-domain linear system relating the measurements to the polyphase components of the underlying coefficient sequence. Stable recovery is characterized through uniform singular-value bounds on the associated polyphase matrix, and explicit synthesis kernels are obtained from its Moore Penrose left inverse. The formulation applies to both separable and genuinely non-separable generators and includes several classical one dimensional sampling formulas as special cases. For irregular derivative measurements, where the periodic polyphase structure is no longer directly available, we develop an iterative reconstruction method based on local bivariate Hermite interpolation followed by orthogonal projection onto the shift-invariant space. A sufficient contraction condition is derived to guarantee geometric convergence of the iteration. Numerical experiments demonstrate the reconstruction performance for separable and non-separable generators and illustrate robustness to additive measurement noise and sampling-location perturbations.

</details>


### [196] [MtReNIRS: A Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Transferable Neurovascular Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36159)
*Tony Chae,Kleanthis Avramidis,Dimitra Emmanouilidou,Ivan J. Tashev*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出蒙太奇感知掩码自编码器MtReNIRS，在12个公开fNIRS数据集上预训练，学习可跨被试、任务、设备与光极蒙太奇迁移的神经血管表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有fNIRS建模多局限于低采样率、单会话小规模数据，采集设备与光极蒙太奇高度异质，且信号时空结构复杂，限制了模型的可扩展性与跨场景可迁移性；尚不清楚单一fNIRS编码器能否学到跨被试、任务、设备与蒙太奇的通用表征。

Method: 构建蒙太奇感知的掩码自编码器（masked autoencoder），在涵盖268名被试、567小时记录的12个公开fNIRS数据集上预训练；通过将异质蒙太奇映射到共享解剖参考空间，联合编码fNIRS缓慢的血流动力学特性、生色团身份与皮层位置。

Result: 在三个外部数据集上实现迁移；跨被试性能与全监督基线相当或更优；在少样本被试内校准中优于此前SOTA fNIRS模型；对稀疏蒙太奇保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 蒙太奇感知自监督可产生具有生理依据、可迁移的fNIRS表征，为标签高效脑机接口提供可扩展基础模型。

Abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) offers a promising approach for monitoring the hemodynamic correlates of neural activity in naturalistic settings. However, existing modeling methods for fNIRS are largely confined to small-scale, single-session data with low sampling rates, driven by high heterogeneity in acquisition devices and optode montages. In addition, the complex spatiotemporal structure of fNIRS signals further restricts model scalability and transferability across settings. As a result, it remains unclear whether a single fNIRS encoder can learn representations that are usable across subjects, tasks, devices, and montages. Here, we show that a montage-aware masked autoencoder, pretrained on 12 public fNIRS datasets spanning 268 subjects and 567 recording hours, learns generalizable neurovascular representations that transfer across three external datasets. Our fNIRS foundation model, MtReNIRS, jointly encodes the slow hemodynamic nature of fNIRS, chromophore identity and cortical location by mapping heterogeneous montages onto a shared anatomical reference. MtReNIRS achieves cross-subject performance on par or better than fully supervised baselines and excels in few-shot within-subject calibration, where it outperforms prior state-of-the-art fNIRS models, while remaining robust to sparse montages. Our results indicate that montage-aware self-supervision yields physiologically grounded, transferable fNIRS representations, providing a scalable foundation for label-efficient brain-computer interfaces.

</details>


### [197] [Structured Wavenumber-Domain Channel Estimation for LoS XL-MIMO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36609)
*Nirosh Marthinu,Prathapasinghe Dharmawansa,Italo Atzeni*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种波数域结构化信道估计框架：先用经典估计器得到初始估计，再经加窗细化抑制带外噪声，最后通过凸约束优化利用波数域信道的稀疏与低秩结构提升估计精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: XL-MIMO近场LoS信道在波数域具有独特的结构特性（空间-频率功率分布局部化、稀疏性与低秩性），现有估计方法未充分利用这些先验，低信噪比下估计精度受限。

Method: 三步框架：1）以经典估计器获得初始信道估计；2）基于加窗的细化步骤，利用局部化空间-频率功率分布抑制带外噪声；3）将估计转化为凸约束优化问题，联合利用波数域信道的稀疏性与低秩结构；约束界通过对收发端相对位置的保守最坏情况刻画来选取。

Result: 数值结果表明该框架提升了估计精度，尤其在低信噪比条件下效果显著，验证了有效利用波数域信道结构特性的收益。

Conclusion: 波数域结构化信息可被系统性地嵌入信道估计流程，加窗去噪与凸约束稀疏-低秩联合优化相结合是提升XL-MIMO近场LoS信道估计性能的有效途径。

Abstract: Near-field line-of-sight (LoS) channels in extremely large-scale multiple-input multiple-output (XL-MIMO) systems exhibit distinctive structural properties in the wavenumber domain. In this paper, we develop a structured wavenumber-domain channel estimation framework that first obtains an initial channel estimate using classical estimators and then refines it through a windowing-based refinement step that suppresses out-of-band noise by exploiting the localized spatial-frequency power distribution. The resulting estimate is subsequently enhanced through a convex constrained formulation that exploits the sparsity and low-rank structure of the wavenumber-domain channel. The corresponding sparsity and rank constraint bounds are selected using a conservative worst-case characterization over the relative position of the transmitter and receiver. Numerical results show that the proposed framework improves estimation accuracy, particularly at low signal-to-noise ratio, by effectively leveraging the structural properties of the wavenumber-domain channel.

</details>


### [198] [Soft Temporal Alignment Distillation for Camera-to-mmWave Radar Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36637)
*Jiuqi Yan,Chengbo Zhu,Chengdong Xu,Qisong Wu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出跨模态知识蒸馏框架，用基于相机2D人体关键点训练的教师网络监督纯雷达学生网络，并设计软时序对齐蒸馏实现自适应特征迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 毫米波雷达人体活动识别具隐私保护优势，但点云稀疏、难以表达身体结构与运动；教师（逐时刻保留上下文状态）与学生（将序列压缩为少量片段）存在时间戳不对应，固定逐帧对应式特征迁移不适用。

Method: 教师网络使用相机2D人体关键点训练；学生网络仅用雷达，集成PointNet点集编码、双向时序建模、片段级聚合与轻量共享隐通道缩放。提出软时序对齐蒸馏（Soft Temporal Alignment Distillation），使每个学生片段自适应检索并聚合教师时序证据作为蒸馏目标，对齐指以学生为条件的表示空间匹配，而非时序或单调配准。

Result: 在MM-Fi数据集上，雷达单模态准确率由87.04%提升至89.17%，在评估的经典与近期蒸馏基线中平均准确率最高；在多数点/帧丢弃设置下平均准确率与macro-F1优于雷达学生。迁移至自采mmO-HAR数据集，准确率由80.33%提升至87.75%。

Conclusion: 训练后移除教师与对齐分支，实现无需额外传感或计算分支的隐私保护纯雷达推理；蒸馏所得雷达表示具良好可迁移性。

Abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides privacy?preserving human activity recognition (HAR), but sparse point clouds limit its representation of body structure and motion. We propose a cross-modal knowledge distillation framework in which a teacher trained on camera-derived two-dimensional (2D) human keypoints supervises a radar-only student. The stu?dent combines PointNet-based point-set encoding, bidirectional temporal modeling, segment-level aggregation, and lightweight shared latent-channel scaling. The teacher retains contextualized states at every time step, whereas the student summarizes the radar sequence into a small number of segments, making fixed timestamp correspondence unsuitable for feature transfer. Soft Temporal Alignment Distillation lets each student segment adaptively retrieve and aggregate teacher temporal evidence into its distillation target. Alignment denotes student-conditioned representation-space matching rather than chronological or monotonic registration. On the Multi-Modal Non-Intrusive 4D Human Dataset (MM-Fi), the method improves radar-only ac?curacy from 87.04% to 89.17%, achieving the highest mean accuracy among the evaluated established and recent distillation baselines. It also obtains higher mean accuracy and macro?averaged F1 score (macro-F1) than the radar student under most evaluated point- and frame-dropout settings. Adaptation to our independently collected millimeter-wave Office Human Ac?tivity Recognition Dataset (mmO-HAR) improves accuracy from 80.33% to 87.75%, supporting the transferability of the distilled radar representation. The teacher and alignment branch are removed after training, enabling privacy-preserving radar-only inference without additional sensing or computational branches.

</details>


### [199] [Static Multipath Suppression in Power Delay Profile of Time-Varying Channel at 28 GHz](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36792)
*Jarosław Wojtuń,Bartosz Czaja,Tomasz Grasza,Jan M. Kelner,Cezary Ziółkowski,Radek Zavorka,Josef Vychodil,Tomas Mikulasek,Jiri Blumenstein,Ales Prokes,Aniruddha Chandra*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文在28 GHz动态道路环境下用宽带测量研究时变信道的静态多径抑制，比较两种时域差分滤波与三种多普勒域陷波配置对PDP和RMS时延扩展的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态多径会掩盖车辆相关动态反射，需评估不同滤波方案对时变信道表征的影响。

Method: 基于28 GHz动态道路环境的宽带测量，对比两类时域差分滤波器与三种多普勒域陷波滤波配置，分析其对功率延迟谱（PDP）和RMS时延扩展的作用。

Result: 所有方法均能有效抑制静态多径成分、提升车辆相关反射的可见度；但滤波器频率响应的差异会影响动态多径分量的相对功率及RMS时延扩展分布。

Conclusion: 静态多径抑制与滤波器选择对时变传播信道表征至关重要。

Abstract: This paper investigates static multipath suppression in a time-varying radio channel at 28 GHz using wideband measurements conducted in a dynamic road environment. Two temporal differencing filters and three Doppler-domain notch filtering configurations are compared in terms of their effects on power delay profiles (PDPs) and root mean square (RMS) delay spread. The results demonstrate that all investigated methods effectively suppress stationary multipath components, improving the visibility of vehicle-related reflections. However, differences in filter frequency responses influence the relative powers of dynamic multipath components and the resulting RMS delay spread distributions. The findings highlight the importance of static multipath suppression and filter selection in characterizing time-varying propagation channels.

</details>


### [200] [Spatial MIMO Channel Rendering: A 3D Gaussian Splatting Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36880)
*Juntaek Han,Geonha Kim,Chaozheng Wen,Ahmed Alkhateeb,Jun Zhang,Jeonghun Park*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出 MIMO Gaussian splatting (MIMO-GS)，借鉴 3D 高斯泼溅思想，用收发 3D 高斯对表示波束空间信道场景，将用户与基站投影到对应波束域并累积波束关联，从稀疏观测重建未观测用户位置处的长期收发波束对功率图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MIMO 增益依赖 CSI，而每个用户在每个相干区间都需消耗导频与反馈资源获取 CSI；但成形信道的传播环境是持久的，利用该持久信息可大幅降低 CSI 获取开销，因此需要从稀疏观测学习空间信道场景并渲染未观测位置的波束功率图。

Method: 受视觉 3D 高斯泼溅启发，MIMO-GS 以成对的接收与发射 3D 高斯表示场景；将高斯分别从用户侧和基站侧投影到相应的波束域；通过 beam pair splatting 累积波束关联，从而渲染长期收发波束对功率图。

Result: 在仿真城市场景与实测室内信道上，MIMO-GS 渲染速度比未经标定副本的光线追踪快 5.5 倍；用于多用户波束管理时，可在无需探测的情况下调度用户与发射波束并考虑用户间干扰，净和速率达 genie-aided 基准的 98%，比基于位置的预测器高 19%。

Conclusion: 将视觉高斯泼溅迁移到波束空间信道渲染是可行且高效的，渲染出的信道地图可支撑免探测的多用户波束管理与调度，在显著降低 CSI 开销的同时接近理想基准性能。

Abstract: The achievable gains of multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems depend on channel state information (CSI), whose acquisition consumes pilot and feedback resources for every user in every coherence interval. Meanwhile, the propagation environment that shapes the channel persists. Exploiting such information will help to greatly reduce the overhead of CSI acquisition. This paper investigates the spatial MIMO channel rendering problem, which learns a latent beamspace channel scene from sparse observations and renders the long-term transmit and receive beam pair power map at unobserved user locations. Motivated by 3D Gaussian splatting in visual scene rendering, the proposed MIMO Gaussian splatting (MIMO-GS) represents the scene with pairs of receive and transmit 3D Gaussians, projects them from the user and base station onto the corresponding beam domains, and accumulates the beam associations through beam pair splatting. On a simulated urban scenario and measured indoor channels, MIMO-GS renders 5.5 times faster than ray tracing without a calibrated replica. Applied to multiuser beam management, the rendered maps allow users and transmit beams to be scheduled without sounding while accounting for the inter-user interference, and the net sum rate reaches 98% of the genie-aided benchmark, 19% above a position-based predictor.

</details>


### [201] [RAG-CSI: Global Local Retrieval via Joint State and Dynamics Matching for CSI Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36881)
*Xinyue Jiang,Tong Li,Shiceng Zhang,Ke Chen,Zhu Xiao*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: RAG-CSI：用检索增强Transformer预测CSI


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习CSI预测器主要将信道知识编码在模型参数中，难以表征跨场景多样化的信道动态模式。

Method: 构建全局-局部CSI知识库（跨场景代表性观测+当前服务场景历史观测）；提出联合状态-动态检索（JSDR），联合刻画信道状态、相位动态与幅度动态以检索相关CSI序列；Transformer预测器通过交叉注意力融合检索知识与当前CSI历史，以有限额外参数预测未来CSI。

Result: 多场景CSI数据集上五项评价指标相对各自最佳基线均提升超10%，NMSE降低15.42%。

Conclusion: 以检索增强方式注入显式历史信道知识，可有效弥补参数化知识在跨场景泛化上的不足。

Abstract: Channel state information (CSI) prediction forecasts future channel states from historical observations, supporting transceiver design and resource allocation with reduced measurement overhead. However, existing deep learning predictors mainly encode channel knowledge in model parameters, which can limit their ability to represent diverse patterns of channel dynamics across scenes. In this paper, we propose RAG-CSI, a retrieval-enhanced Transformer framework that augments prediction with relevant historical channel knowledge. Specifically, we construct a global--local CSI knowledge store containing representative observations across scenes and historical observations from the current serving scene. We further develop joint state--dynamics retrieval (JSDR), which jointly characterizes channel states, phase dynamics, and amplitude dynamics to retrieve relevant CSI sequences. A Transformer predictor then uses cross-attention to fuse the retrieved knowledge with the current CSI history and predict future CSI with limited additional model parameters. Experiments on a multi-scene CSI dataset show overall improvements exceeding 10\% across all five evaluation metrics over the best baseline for each metric, including a 15.42\% reduction in normalized mean squared error.

</details>


### [202] [A Wearable Sensor Array on Conductive Textiles for Body Surface Temperature Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37008)
*Amiri Onuki,Akihito Noda*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出以导电织物本身作为共享总线的无电池可穿戴温度传感系统，实现无需单独布线的多节点分布式温度实时映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体表温度分布连续监测对可穿戴健康与热状态监测有价值，但传统有线多点传感系统布线复杂、降低节点布置灵活性并损害衣物可穿戴性，需解决多节点的供电与数据采集难题。

Method: 以导电织物同时承担直流供电与数据通信的共享总线；每个传感节点为直径21 mm、重0.9 g的无电池圆形板，集成商用温度传感器与UART/DC叠加定制电路；采用基于地址的半双工UART主站轮询实现无冲突多节点通信；在服装上构建18节点阵列并开发实时温度映射可视化界面。

Result: 在假人穿着的18节点服装阵列上，用设定约50 °C热风枪进行热扫描演示，以99.2 Hz刷新率捕获服装表面的时空温度变化。

Conclusion: 导电织物总线可支撑实时、高刷新率的分布式温度映射，为衣物集成体表监测及未来多传感器可穿戴系统提供实用基础。

Abstract: Continuous monitoring of body-surface temperature distributions can provide useful information for wearable health and thermal-condition monitoring. However, practical daily-use wearable systems for distributed temperature sensing remain difficult to implement because multiple sensor nodes require power delivery and data collection across a garment. Conventional wiring increases system complexity, reduces placement flexibility, and can compromise the wearability of garment-integrated sensor arrays. To address this issue, we present a conductive-textile-based wearable temperature sensing system in which the textile itself serves as a shared bus for both DC power delivery and data communication. Each sensor node is implemented as a compact, battery-free circular board with a diameter of 21 mm and a weight of 0.9 g, integrating a commercial temperature sensor and custom circuitry for UART/DC superposition. The shared textile bus enables flexible node placement without individual wiring while supplying power to each node. Address-based half-duplex UART with master polling enables collision-free multi-node communication. To demonstrate the system-level capability, we implemented an 18-node sensor array on a garment worn by a mannequin and developed a real-time temperature mapping viewer. In a thermal scanning demonstration using warm air from a heat gun with a set temperature of approximately 50 °C, the 18-node array captured spatiotemporal temperature variations over the garment surface at a refresh rate of 99.2 Hz. These results show that the proposed conductive-textile bus can support real-time, high-refresh-rate distributed temperature mapping, providing a practical basis for garment-integrated body-surface monitoring and future multi-sensor wearable systems.

</details>


### [203] [Placing the Beamspace Window on a Hopping Carrier: Bin Drift, Exact Capture and the Cost of Rounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37067)
*Moris S. Mukwayi,Michael A. van Wyk,Andre M. McDonald*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 频跳数字阵列雷达中，波束空间自适应处理窗口应精确对准视向分数bin（需FFT前加一相位斜坡），而非取整到最近bin。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 频率捷变雷达每次换载频都会使视向的空间频率在空间FFT的各波束间漂移，波束空间处理器必须决策窗口位置；由于波束空间变换正交，输出仅取决于窗口张成的子空间，跳频只改变窗口位置，因此需要定量评估窗口放置策略的代价。

Method: 提出将窗口精确居中于视向的分数bin，代价仅为FFT前的一次相位斜坡操作；在32×32阵列、4–8 GHz、41个载频、三干扰源场景下，对比"精确窗口"、"最近bin取整"与"冻结在最低载频窗口"三种策略，考察3×3、5×5、7×7、9×9窗口。

Result: 视向从u=0.2到60°时视bin漂移1.6–6.9个bin；取整在3×3/5×5/7×7窗口下分别损失至多1.34/0.74/0.50 dB视向捕获。三干扰场景中，冻结窗口在u=0.55处最坏载频损失39–60 dB；精确窗口在该处比最近bin优0.31–0.65 dB；但在近正侧射的九波束窗口下优势反转，最近bin反而好0.61 dB。

Conclusion: 精确分数bin窗口几乎无成本且总体更优，但其优势依赖于窗口尺寸与视向：大窗口、近正侧射时最近bin取整可能更有利，窗口放置策略应按跳频与视向自适应选择。

Abstract: A frequency-agile radar with a large digital array moves the spatial frequency of its look direction across the beams of a spatial FFT every time it changes carrier, so a beamspace adaptive processor must decide where to put its window at each hop. Because the beamspace transform is orthonormal, the output of the processor depends only on the span of the window, and a hop changes nothing but where the window sits. Centring the window exactly on the fractional bin of the look direction keeps the look vector fully inside it at every carrier, for the price of one phase ramp before the FFT. On a 32 by 32 array over 4 to 8 GHz the look bin drifts by 1.6 to 6.9 bins for look directions from u=0.2 to 60 degrees. Rounding to the nearest bin costs up to 1.34, 0.74 and 0.50 dB of look-direction capture for 3 by 3, 5 by 5 and 7 by 7 windows. In a three-jammer scenario with 41 carriers, a window frozen at the lowest carrier loses 39 to 60 dB at the worst carrier for a look direction of u=0.55, the exact window beats nearest-bin placement by 0.31 to 0.65 dB there, and the advantage reverses for a nine-beam window near broadside, where nearest-bin was 0.61 dB better.

</details>


### [204] [Orthogonal Zadoff-Chu Based Pilot Design For Fractional Channel Estimation in MIMO-OTFS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37079)
*Omid Aghda,Prabhat Gupta,João Guerreiro,Nuno Souto,Michal Szczachor,Lukasz Krzymien,Rui Dinis*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于Zadoff-Chu(ZC)序列的导频设计，用于点对点多输入多输出(MIMO)OTFS系统的分数信道估计，接收端采用相关方案配合二维A&M频率估计，实现低PAPR且随发射天线数增加性能稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OTFS在MIMO场景下需要分数信道估计，同时导频设计需兼顾低峰均功率比(PAPR)与多天线扩展时的性能稳定性，现有方案在此方面存在不足。

Method: 利用ZC序列为每个发射天线分配正交导频序列；接收端采用基于相关的方法构造估计信号，并借助Aboutanios与Mulgrew(A&M)频率估计方法的二维扩展完成分数信道估计。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所提方法在保持低PAPR的同时，随着发射天线数量的增加仍能维持稳定的估计性能。

Conclusion: ZC序列导频设计结合二维A&M频率估计可有效支持MIMO-OTFS的分数信道估计，兼具低PAPR与良好的多天线可扩展性。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a Zadoff-Chu (ZC) sequence-based pilot design for fractional channel estimation in orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) modulation for point-to-point multi-input multi-output (MIMO) scenarios. Orthogonal pilot sequences are assigned to each transmit antenna using ZF sequences. At the receiver, a correlation-based scheme is used to construct the signal for estimation. The estimation relies on a two-dimensional extension of the Aboutanios and Mulgrew (A&M) frequency estimation method. Simulation results show that the proposed approach achieves low peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) while maintaining stable performance as the number of transmit antennas increases.

</details>


### [205] [Approximation of the Narrowband Velocity Ambiguity Function in Near-Field Sensing Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37084)
*Marcin Wachowiak,André Bourdoux,Sofie Pollin*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究均匀线阵辐射近场中的速度模糊函数，通过将速度分解为径向与切向分量分别分析并给出闭式近似，发现近场不能改善径向测速但可实现切向测速，且MIMO与多SISO阵列对切向速度估计优于SIMO/MISO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近场条件下的雷达参数估计机理尚不清晰，特别是速度（多普勒）模糊函数在辐射近场区域内的性质、以及近场是否带来测速增益，缺乏系统分析。

Method: 针对均匀线阵辐射近场建立一般化的速度模糊函数，取目标位置处的速度截面；将速度矢量分解为径向与切向分量分别分析；基于远场近似推导速度模糊函数的闭式近似并验证其精度；再对不同阵列构型（SIMO/MISO、MIMO、多SISO）的速度模糊函数与可达分辨率进行对比分析。

Result: 推导的闭式近似在依赖远场近似的前提下仍具有良好精度；近场区域对径向速度估计没有改善，但使切向速度估计成为可能；对于切向速度估计，MIMO与多SISO雷达集合相比SIMO/MISO配置具有更优的模糊函数和分辨率。

Conclusion: 近场的价值不在提升径向测速精度，而在于引入切向速度的可估计性；通过MIMO或多SISO阵列构型可获得更好的切向速度模糊函数与分辨率，为近场雷达速度估计的阵列设计提供依据。

Abstract: This work investigates the velocity ambiguity function in the radiative near-field of a uniform linear antenna array. First, the general ambiguity function is formulated and the velocity cross-section at a target position is considered. The velocity vector is decomposed into radial and tangential components, which are analyzed separately. Next, the closed-form approximations for the velocity ambiguity function are derived and shown to be accurate despite relying on far-field approximations. The results show that the near-field regime does not improve radial velocity estimation, but enables estimation of the tangential velocity. Finally, the velocity ambiguity functions and the achievable resolution are analyzed for different array configurations. For tangential velocity estimation, MIMO and a collection of SISO radars offer improved ambiguity function and resolution as compared to the SIMO/MISO configuration.

</details>


### [206] [Closed-Form Subspace Loss and Snapshot-Limited Dimension Selection for Beamspace MVDR Radar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37089)
*Moris S. Mukwayi,Michael A. van Wyk,Andre M. McDonald*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文给出DFT波束窗在点干扰下的子空间损失闭式解，结合SMI的scaled-Beta律得到最优窗尺寸B*(K)选取规则，并在32x32阵列仿真中验证其精度与有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 波束空间MVDR用B个波束替代N个阵元，存在子空间损失（随B下降）与协方差估计损失（随B上升）的权衡，需定量刻画以确定最优窗尺寸。

Method: 推导DFT波束窗在点干扰下的子空间损失闭式表达：任意干扰功率下精确，高INR极限下由阵列Dirichlet核表出；再与固定变换下SMI的scaled-Beta采样律结合，得到未加载SMI的窗尺寸B*(K)。在含4–8 GHz载波、噪声干扰机与Billingsley地杂波的32x32阵列仿真中检验。

Result: 25与49波束窗在10–50 dB干扰电平下，闭式解与clairvoyant子空间损失相差在0.04 dB内；9波束窗（三列被三干扰机占据）因遗漏杂波损失达5 dB；在30个存在多个可运行窗的算例中，B*(K)均选出最低损失窗；干扰方向0.25 bin rms误差带来平均0.04 dB损失；对角加载下最优窗更大。

Conclusion: 该窗尺寸选取规则为oracle型，需已知干扰参数或真实协方差；闭式子空间损失精确刻画波束窗性能，B*(K)可可靠选出近最优窗，对角加载下倾向更大窗。

Abstract: A beamspace minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) processor adapts a window of B beams instead of all N elements of a large array, trading a subspace loss that falls with B against a covariance estimation loss that rises with B for a fixed number K of training snapshots. We give the subspace loss of a DFT beam window in point jamming in closed form: exactly for any jammer power, and in the high interference-to-noise ratio (INR) limit through the Dirichlet kernel of the array. Combined with the known scaled-Beta law of sample matrix inversion (SMI) with a fixed transform, it gives a window size B*(K) for unloaded SMI. On a simulated 32x32 array with carriers from 4 to 8 GHz, noise jammers and Billingsley land clutter, the exact form is within 0.04 dB of the clairvoyant subspace loss for 25- and 49-beam windows at jammer levels from 10 to 50 dB. For a 9-beam window whose three columns are taken by three jammers near the target's elevation, the clutter that the form leaves out costs up to 5 dB. With the nominal K, B*(K) picks the lowest-loss window in all 30 cases with more than one runnable window. The rule is an oracle: it needs the jammer parameters or the true covariance, and errors of 0.25 bin rms in the jammer directions add a mean loss of 0.04 dB. With diagonal loading the best window was larger still wherever the rule chose more than the smallest window.

</details>


### [207] [Robust PPG-Exclusive Heart Rate Estimation During Maximal Exercise Using Population-Based Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37132)
*Elisabetta De Giovanni,Iñigo Urteaga,Matteo Croci,Tomas Teijeiro*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出无需辅助传感器的PPG心率估计框架：用DTW对齐并构造人群HR演化先验（重心平均），将先验与PPG功率谱密度融合成"后验PSD"，再由启发式搜索选取最可能的心率轨迹；在高强度运动下相对PPG+加速度计基准的中位MAE降幅达63.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPG是可穿戴心率监测的主流技术，但剧烈运动时的运动伪影与心信号频谱重叠，导致心率估计不可靠。作者希望验证：在不借助加速度计等辅助传感器的情况下，仅利用心率动态演化先验知识，能否从严重受污染的PPG中恢复可靠心率。

Method: 21名受试者在最大功率自行车测试中同步采集PPG与ECG。采用留一受试者交叉验证（LOSO），以ECG真值构建HR演化先验，用动态时间规整（DTW）对齐归一化HR曲线并计算重心平均（barycenter）作为人群先验。对每个测试对象，将PPG功率谱密度（PSD）与先验分布相乘得到"后验PSD"，在其中用启发式搜索枚举并排序候选HR轨迹，选取概率最高的路径作为估计。

Result: DTW能在所有受试者上以极小误差对齐归一化HR曲线，验证了基于人群的先验具有鲁棒性。相对于PPG+加速度计基准，该方法以ECG为真值，BPM的平均绝对误差（MAE）中位下降幅度为63.3%（IQR 47.3%–74.6%）。

Conclusion: 生理先验结合DTW对齐可使纯PPG心率监测在高强度运动中保持鲁棒与准确，说明辅助传感器并非必需；该框架为运动场景下的可穿戴心率监测提供了可推广的先验-谱融合范式。

Abstract: PPG is the main technology for wearable heart rate (HR) monitoring. However, motion artifacts during intense physical activity reduce its reliability due to spectral overlap with the cardiac signal. This study investigates whether severely contaminated PPG signals can yield reliable HR estimates without auxiliary sensors by leveraging prior knowledge of HR dynamics. We acquired simultaneous PPG and ECG signals from 21 subjects during a maximal cycloergometer test. Using Leave-One-Subject-Out cross-validation, we built HR evolution priors from the ground-truth ECG and applied Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) to align normalized HR curves and estimate a barycenter average. DTW aligns normalized HR curves with minimal error across all subjects, validating robust population-based priors. For each test subject, we combined the PPG Power Spectral Density (PSD) with the prior distribution to generate a "posterior PSD". We identified and ranked candidate HR trajectories using heuristic search within the "posterior PSD" and selected the most likely path. Our approach reduced mean absolute error (MAE) in BPM relative to the ground-truth ECG by a median of 63.3% (IQR: 47.3%-74.6%) compared to a PPG+accelerometer benchmark. These results show that physiological priors and DTW-based alignment enable robust, PPG-exclusive HR monitoring during high-intensity exercise.

</details>


### [208] [Negative Results for Reciprocity-Based Over-the-Air Split Learning Under Channel Aging: Stability, Alignment, and Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37188)
*Tianhao Guo,Xianzhong Li,Hao Luo*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文通过七项案例研究，检验 reciprocity-based over-the-air split learning 中信道老化（channel aging）对返回导数信号及训练预测的影响，区分有效的局部物理关系与未被支持的训练效果预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于互易性的空中分割学习中，信道老化会旋转并衰减回传给发射端的导数信号，但相关理论预测（如对齐增益、干扰导致精度崩溃、相位补偿增益等）缺乏系统检验，需辨别哪些局部物理关系成立、哪些训练层面预测不可靠。

Method: 结合数值预测、机制检查与竞争性预测对比，设计七个案例：相关零点附近对比 truncation 与 polar correction 的 SGD 交叉熵差异（配对区间）、二次代理比较、返回端口选择策略（最大接收功率 vs 随机）、幅相梯度局部反比关系检验、七项干扰致精度崩溃预测检验、零均值干扰下条件均值保持性检验、逐子载波及球面波前补偿、聚焦、端口分配对称性、定位误差预测，以及高斯轨道抖动 vs 固定偏差对比。

Result: 相关零点附近，truncated inversion 交叉熵比 polar correction 低 0.000813，配对95%区间 [-0.001853, 0.000060]，二次代理略偏向截断；最大接收功率端口选择增益至多0.97点，未达预测的五点优势，但幅相梯度局部反比关系成立；七项干扰致崩溃预测被否定，零均值干扰在固定线性链路下保持条件均值；逐子载波校正与球面波前补偿无预测增益，聚焦在单模模型近随机、含视距加散射模型无增益；非对称运动下成功端口分配否证精确对称要求，定位误差竞争预测成立；标准差0.383波长的抖动下终端测试精度高，而等幅固定偏差近乎随机。

Conclusion: 这些案例借助任务支撑、噪声注入与更新矩量，将有效的局部物理关系与缺乏支持的训练效果预测区分开来，表明许多理论上的物理修正并不能自动转化为分割学习中的精度收益。

Abstract: In reciprocity-based over-the-air split learning, channel aging rotates and attenuates the derivative signal returned to the transmitter. Seven case studies combine numerical forecasts, mechanism checks, and competing predictions. Near the correlation zero, an archived SGD comparison finds truncated inversion 0.000813 lower in cross-entropy than polar correction, with a paired 95% interval for the difference from -0.001853 to 0.000060, and a retained-mode quadratic proxy slightly favors truncation. Selecting the return port with the largest received power falls short of the predicted five-point alignment advantage over random selection at both tested spacings, gaining at most 0.97 points, while the local inverse relation between amplitude and phase gradient is supported. Seven specified interference-induced accuracy-collapse predictions are rejected, and independent zero-mean interference preserves the conditional mean under a fixed linear chain. Per-subcarrier correction and spherical-wavefront compensation do not deliver their predicted accuracy gains. Focusing leaves both methods near chance in a single-mode model and adds no observed gain in a model with a line-of-sight component plus scattering. A successful port assignment under nonsymmetric motion refutes an exact-symmetry requirement. The competing positioning-error prediction is supported. Gaussian rail jitter with a standard deviation of 0.383 wavelengths yields high terminal test accuracy, whereas a fixed bias of the same magnitude yields near-chance accuracy. These cases distinguish valid local physical relations from unsupported training forecasts through task support, noise injection, and update moments.

</details>


### [209] [JEPA-Inspired Latent Field Prediction for Sparse-Pilot MIMO-OFDM Channel Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37391)
*Yuzhi Yang,Brahim Mefgouda,Hang Zou,Lina Bariah,Anis Bara,Yuhuan Lu,Hao Zhang,Merouane Debbah*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种受JEPA启发的"场世界模型"——无线传播场的隐空间预测模型，用于稀疏导频信道重建；先在隐空间预测掩码/未来场状态，再与稀疏含噪导频融合重建完整MIMO-OFDM信道，射线追踪实验中NMSE优于仅导频与直接重建基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完整CSI对MIMO-OFDM至关重要，但密集导频开销大；而在原始CSI系数上直接最小化预测误差对衰落、移动性、局部散射与微小空间扰动敏感，相位变化剧烈导致预测脆弱。作者观察到信道在空间、时间、频域存在强相关性，在隐式传播场域中更可预测，因此希望以隐空间场预测作为先验。

Method: 构建JEPA式隐空间预测架构：（1）将CSI观测映射为时频隐token；（2）基于历史多频段上下文预测被掩码或未来的隐场状态；（3）将预测的隐先验与稀疏含噪当前导频融合，重建完整MIMO-OFDM信道。核心是在隐空间而非原始系数上做预测，规避相位敏感误差。

Result: 射线追踪（ray-tracing）仿真中，所提方法在NMSE指标上优于"仅导频估计"和"直接重建"两类基线，验证了隐式场预测可作为稀疏导频信道获取的有效先验。

Conclusion: 以隐式传播场预测作为先验、并与稀疏导频融合，是降低导频开销、提升信道重建精度的可行路径；隐空间建模比原始CSI直接预测更鲁棒。论文以ray-tracing结果为主，尚未给出实测或跨场景泛化验证。

Abstract: Accurate acquisition of full channel state information (CSI) is essential for multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) wireless systems, while dense pilot-based estimation incurs substantial overhead. Directly minimizing the prediction error over raw CSI coefficients is fragile in realistic propagation environments, since small-scale fading, mobility, local scattering, and small spatial perturbations can induce large phase-sensitive variations. Nevertheless, wireless channels contain strong spatial, temporal, and frequency-domain correlations that can be more predictably represented in a latent propagation-field domain. Motivated by this observation, we propose a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA)-inspired field world model, defined as a latent predictive model of the wireless propagation field, for sparse-pilot channel reconstruction. The model maps CSI observations into latent time-frequency tokens, predicts masked or future latent field states from historical multi-band context, and fuses the predicted latent prior with sparse noisy current pilots to reconstruct the full MIMO-OFDM channel. Ray-tracing experiments show that the proposed method improves normalized mean square error (NMSE) over pilot-only and direct reconstruction baselines, supporting latent field prediction as an effective prior for sparse-pilot channel acquisition.

</details>


### [210] [Assessing BIOMASS Radiometric Stability using Permanent Scatterers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37400)
*Marco Manzoni,Francesco Salvaterra,Claudio Maria Prati,Stefano Tebaldini*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于永久散射体(PSCal)的BIOMASS P波段SAR相对辐射定标框架，无需专用定标器即可估计残余辐射增益，并成功检测出约1 dB的射频干扰抑制缺陷异常。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监测ESA BIOMASS P波段SAR的相对辐射稳定性，需要将仪器与处理效应同地物后向散射的时间变化分离开来；而专用定标目标成本高、覆盖有限，因此希望利用场景中的永久散射体作为机会性参考。

Method: PSCal框架将基于幅度的散射体筛选与迭代最大似然增益估计相结合；通过仿真评估在BIOMASS栈有限采集次数下的检测与估计性能，分析严格筛选阈值、散射体丰度与信噪比的影响；并应用于肯尼亚内罗毕与阿根廷科尔多瓦数据，与澳大利亚New Norcia的BIOMASS定标转发器(BCT)测量结果比对。

Result: 仿真表明筛选阈值需严格、估计精度依赖散射体丰度与SNR；内罗毕数据识别出约1 dB辐射异常并溯源至射频干扰抑制缺陷，其余采集增益变化一般在0.1 dB以内；科尔多瓦12次跨两个任务相位（间隔约8个月）的采集在场景后向散射与几何显著变化下仍保持约0.1 dB的残余增益变化；结果与BCT测量一致。

Conclusion: 经严格筛选的P波段永久散射体可作为专用定标基础设施的补充，用于相对辐射监测与处理异常检测。

Abstract: Monitoring the relative radiometric stability of the European Space Agency's BIOMASS P-band synthetic aperture radar (SAR) requires separating instrumental and processing effects from temporal changes in the scene backscatter. This study investigates the use of permanent scatterers (PSs) as opportunistic references for estimating residual radiometric gains without dedicated calibration targets. The PS-based calibration (PSCal) framework combines amplitude-based scatterer selection with iterative maximum-likelihood gain estimation. Simulations assess detection and estimation performance under the limited number of acquisitions available in BIOMASS stacks, highlighting the importance of stringent selection thresholds and the dependence of estimation accuracy on scatterer abundance and signal-to-noise ratio. The approach is applied to datasets over Nairobi, Kenya, and Cordoba, Argentina. Over Nairobi, PSCal identifies an approximately 1 dB radiometric anomaly subsequently traced to a defect in radio-frequency interference mitigation, while the remaining acquisitions exhibit estimated gain variations generally within 0.1 dB. Over Cordoba, twelve acquisitions spanning two mission phases separated by approximately eight months yield residual gain variations on the order of 0.1 dB despite pronounced changes in the scene backscatter and acquisition geometry. Results were observed to be consistent with measurements from the BIOMASS Calibration Transponder (BCT) installed in New Norcia (Australia). These results demonstrate the potential of carefully selected P-band PSs to complement dedicated calibration infrastructure for relative radiometric monitoring and the detection of processing anomalies.

</details>


### [211] [5G Sensing for Human Pose Estimation with PRS-based CSI: An Experimental Demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37435)
*Zhaorui Yin,Pietro Morri,Mattia Brambilla,Monica Nicoli*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文基于5G下行PRS提取的CSI，结合幅值平滑与相位校准，用深度学习实现无设备2D人体姿态估计，并验证幅相联合训练优于仅幅值输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索标准化5G下行定位参考信号（PRS）所测CSI是否蕴含可用于无设备人体姿态估计的信息，并在简单射频配置与小规模数据集条件下验证可行性。

Method: gNB发送PRS，双接收天线UE测量信道；用最小二乘（LS）估计CSI，经幅值平滑与相位校准，构造幅值与相位表示作为深度学习模型输入；在20 MHz带宽下对比仅幅值输入与幅相联合训练。

Result: 幅相联合训练优于仅幅值方案，在左肩—右髋距离的10%、30%、50%阈值下PCK分别为32.2%、72.9%、84.2%。

Conclusion: 标准化5G下行PRS-based CSI在简单射频配置与小数据集下即含有效姿态信息，支持无设备2D人体姿态估计的可行性。

Abstract: This paper presents an experimental study of device- free 2D human pose estimation using Channel State Information (CSI) extracted from downlink Fifth Generation (5G) Positioning Reference Signal (PRS). The proposed system employs a Next Generation Node Base (gNB) transmitting PRS to a User Equipment (UE) equipped with two receive antennas to measure the radio channel. The CSI is estimated using a least-squares (LS) method, and processed through amplitude smoothing and phase calibration. The resulting amplitude and phase representations are used as inputs to a deep learning model for pose estimation. We compare amplitude-only input with joint amplitude-phase training at a bandwidth of 20 MHz. The joint training outperforms the amplitude-only solution and achieves Percentage of Correct Keypoints (PCK) equal to 32.2%, 72.9%, and 84.2% below 10%, 30%, and 50% of the distance between left shoulder and right hip, respectively. These results demonstrate that standardized downlink 5G PRS-based CSI contains useful information for human pose estimation, even with a simple radio configuration and a relatively small dataset.

</details>


### [212] [Coordinated and Uncoordinated Channel Tracking for High-Rate IoT in Distributed Massive MIMO With Low-Resolution ADCs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37508)
*Hediyeh Soltanizadeh,Ardavan Rahimian*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对低分辨率ADC的分布式大规模MIMO物联网高速场景，提出量化感知的联合协同卡尔曼滤波（Q-JCKF）与分布式概率数据关联滤波（Q-DPDAF），并给出上行UatF闭式表达式、导频复用上限及复杂度/前传扩展分析，仿真验证其谱效、移动性跟踪、4比特近理想性能与运行时优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高速IoT在分布式mMIMO中需要动态信道跟踪，而低分辨率ADC引入量化失真；同时导频与数据活动解耦、导频复用、跨接入时隙信道演化以及非协调接入等问题使传统JC-KF/PDAF框架失效，需要量化感知且可扩展的联合处理方案。

Method: 对已知导频活动设计量化感知联合协同卡尔曼滤波Q-JCKF；对非协调接入设计量化感知分布式概率数据关联滤波Q-DPDAF。上行分析推导Q-JCKF的闭式UatF统计表达式，以及Q-DPDAF的混合感知、导频条件化和长期统计UatF公式，并给出大规模N导频复用上限与跨AP关联项及其O(eps)后验集中界。复杂度方面采用Kronecker结构降低协方差处理复杂度，Q-DPDAF按组限制假设枚举由2^K降至2^{K_r}并支持AP本地并行处理。

Result: 所提框架在理想ADC与共址极限下退化为JC-KF/PDAF，并量化有限分辨率量化造成的卡尔曼测量信息条件损失；仿真验证了分析结果与复杂度结论，刻画ADC分辨率与导频接入效应，展示尾部谱效提升、鲁棒移动性跟踪、接近理想的4比特性能、可靠的Q-DPDAF活动推断以及相较传统实现与处理框架的显著运行时降低。

Conclusion: 量化感知的联合卡尔曼滤波与分布式概率数据关联滤波为低分辨率ADC分布式mMIMO高速IoT提供了统一的动态信道跟踪与接入推断框架，兼顾理论可分析性、计算/内存/前传可扩展性及近理想量化性能。

Abstract: This paper investigates dynamic channel tracking for high-rate Internet of things (IoT) in distributed massive multiple-input multiple-output (mMIMO) with low-resolution analog-to-digital converters (ADCs), where pilot and data activities are decoupled, pilots are reused, and mobile channels evolve across access slots. We hereby develop a quantization-aware joint coordinated Kalman filter (Q-JCKF) for known pilot activity and a quantization-aware distributed probabilistic data association filter (Q-DPDAF) for uncoordinated access. For uplink analysis, we derive a closed-form statistical use-and-then-forget (UatF) expression for Q-JCKF and mixture-aware, pilot-conditioned, and long-term statistical UatF formulations for Q-DPDAF, together with the large-N pilot-reuse ceiling and a cross-access point (AP) association term with an O(epsilon) posterior-concentration bound. The proposed framework recovers JC-KF/PDAF in the ideal-ADC co-located limit, and quantifies the conditional loss of Kalman measurement information caused by finite-resolution quantization. We further characterize computational, memory, and fronthaul scaling: Kronecker-structured Q-JCKF reduces covariance-processing complexity, while groupwise Q-DPDAF limits hypothesis enumeration from 2^K to 2^{K_r} and enables parallel AP-local processing. Simulations corroborate the analytical and complexity outcomes, quantify ADC-resolution and pilot-access effects, and demonstrate improved lower-tail spectral efficiency, robust mobility tracking, near-ideal 4-bit performance, reliable Q-DPDAF activity inference, and substantial runtime reductions over legacy implementations and processing frameworks.

</details>


### [213] [A Theory of Transmit-Receive-Manifold of Single-Photon Quantum-Dot Antenna Arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37542)
*Angeru Pavan Kumar,Sandip Ghosal*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文针对量子点阵列提出完整的"发射–信道–接收流形"模型，指出接收单光子的量子点阵列为集体耦合天线，其接收流形并非总是平面波流形，并用可通过经典阵列激励获得的参考目标方向图进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有阵列理论通常假设接收端对应平面波流形，但接收单个光子的量子点阵列是集体耦合天线，这一假设未必成立，缺少完整的发射–信道–接收流形描述框架。

Method: 构建量子点阵列的完整发射–信道–接收流形模型，将单光子接收态作为集体耦合天线的接收流形加以刻画；并选取一个可由经典阵列激励得到的参考目标方向图用于模型验证。

Result: 摘要未给出定量结果，仅说明以经典阵列激励获得的参考目标方向图完成验证，表明所建模型可与经典阵列激励结果对照。

Conclusion: 量子点阵列的接收流形不应默认等同平面波流形，需以发射–信道–接收一体的流形模型来描述；该框架为量子阵列天线的分析与设计提供参照基础。

Abstract: A quantum-dot array that receives a single photon is a collectively coupled antenna, and its receive manifold is not always the plane-wave manifold. So, this work aims to develop a complete transmit-channel-receive manifold model for quantum dot (QD) arrays. For the sake of validation, it considers a reference target pattern which can be obtained using classical array excitation.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [214] [KORA: Deterministic-First Execution Control for AI Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35869)
*Albert Heekwan Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KORA提出"确定性优先"的执行控制架构：在推理前将请求表示为任务路径，先尝试确定性/结构化路由并验证结果、记录遥测，仅在确定性处理不足时才升级到模型候选路径；在可复现的100任务确定性密集型基准中避免了80/100次模拟模型调用，确定性子集零不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI应用默认先调用模型、再判断推理是否必要。该默认对模糊的生成式任务有效，但与结构化、确定性、受策略约束、查找型或可直接验证的工作不匹配，造成不必要的模型调用。

Method: 提出KORA——推理前控制层（deterministic-first execution control）：1) 将请求表示为任务路径；2) 优先尝试确定性或结构化路由；3) 校验路由结果（validation）；4) 记录遥测；5) 仅当确定性处理不足时升级至模型候选路径。证据来自可复现基准与验证工作负载。

Result: 在可复现的100任务确定性密集型基准（含FAQ查找、策略/规则检查、schema或格式校验、确定性转换，以及少量需模型的模糊/生成任务）中，KORA受控执行相对于朴素直接调用基线避免了80/100次模拟模型调用，确定性子集零不一致。另有一项合成客服本地/无网络验证工作负载，展示应用形态下的路由测量与避免模型调用的核算。

Conclusion: 结果支持在文档化工作负载中的有界模型调用削减与验证可见性；但不构成对生产环境行为、真实提供商结果、能耗结果、API成本降低或广泛优越性的证明。

Abstract: AI applications often invoke a model before they determine whether inference is necessary. That default is useful for ambiguous generative tasks, but it is poorly matched to work that is structured, deterministic, policy-bound, lookup-oriented, or directly verifiable. KORA introduces deterministic-first execution control: a pre-inference control layer that represents requests as task paths, attempts deterministic or structured routes first, validates route outcomes, records telemetry, and escalates to a model-candidate path only when deterministic handling is insufficient. This paper presents KORA as a deterministic-first execution-control architecture and reports bounded evidence from reproducible benchmark and validation workloads. In a reproducible 100-task deterministic-heavy benchmark, KORA-controlled execution avoided 80 of 100 simulated model invocations versus a naive direct baseline, with zero mismatches in the deterministic subset. The workload is intentionally deterministic-heavy: it includes categories such as FAQ lookup, policy/rule checking, schema or format validation, deterministic transformation, and a smaller set of model-needed ambiguous or generative tasks. A separate synthetic customer-support local/no-network validation workload demonstrates route measurement and avoided model-call accounting in an application-shaped setting. These results support bounded model-invocation reduction and validation visibility in documented workloads. They do not establish production behavior, real-provider outcomes, energy outcomes, API-cost reduction, or broad superiority.

</details>


### [215] [Calibrated for Which Policy? Conformal Uncertainty for Fixed World Models Under Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35877)
*Ayush Mittal,Dhruv Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 部署策略变化会使世界模型的不确定性失效，但在条件机制不变时可被识别。论文用变化测度比 w(X)=dQ_X/dP_X 加权的共形校准把边际覆盖率迁移到目标分布，并用域分类器遗憾界控制比率误差，最后在 Franka 真机与 DINO 特征世界模型上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 更换部署策略会改变状态分布，从而使以源分布校准的世界模型不确定性（如共形预测集）在目标部署分布上失效；但物理转移机制与预测器本身并未改变，因此希望在不重训模型的前提下修复校准。

Method: 假设源与目标共享条件机制 P(Y|X)=Q(Y|X)，用结局前变化测度 w(X)=dQ_X/dP_X 识别干预；策略控制动力下该比值分解为状态占用项与动作倾向项。采用加权共形校准将覆盖率迁移到目标律，并用源-目标域分类器的总体对数损失遗憾 Δ(h) 界定比率误差：E_P|w-\hat w_h| ≤ (1/(ργ))√(Δ(h)/2)，实现 γ^{-2} 到 (ργ)^{-1} 的改进。另在 Lean 4 中机检相关代数与因果恒等式。

Result: 覆盖率下界为 1-α-TV(Q,\hat Q) ≥ 1-α-E_P|w-\hat w|。最强受控状态-动作偏移下，普通 90% 共形集覆盖 55.0%，oracle 与学习比率校准分别为 91.0% 与 90.9%；学习代理与目标律总变差在 0.9% 以内。

Conclusion: 校准是相对于部署律的：模型可保持不变，而校准随干预迁移；比率估计误差由分类器遗憾控制并经 Lean 4 形式化验证。

Abstract: Changing a deployment policy can invalidate a world model's uncertainty while leaving the physical transition mechanism and predictor unchanged. For one-step prediction, if source and target laws share the conditional mechanism $P(Y|X)=Q(Y|X)$, then the intervention is identified by the pre-outcome change of measure $w(X)=dQ_X/dP_X$. For policy-controlled dynamics this ratio factors into state-occupancy and action-propensity terms. Weighted conformal calibration transports marginal coverage to the target law; with an estimated ratio $\hat w$, $P_Q\{Y \in C_{\hat w}(X)\} \ge 1-α-TV(Q,\hat Q) \ge 1-α-E_P|w-\hat w|$. Population log-loss regret for a source-versus-target domain classifier bounds the same ratio error. If $h$ is its clipped target posterior, $ρ$ is the target-domain prior, and $Δ(h)$ is population log-loss regret, then $E_P|w-\hat w_h| \le (1/(ργ))\sqrt{Δ(h)/2}$. An exact cancellation improves the dependence from a generic odds-map bound of order $γ^{-2}$ to $(ργ)^{-1}$. Our experiments use a released DINO-feature world model and physical Franka trajectories. Under the strongest controlled state-action shift, ordinary 90% conformal sets cover 55.0%, whereas oracle and learned-ratio calibration cover 91.0% and 90.9%. The learned surrogate remains within 0.9% total variation of the target law. Calibration is relative to the deployment law: the model can remain fixed while calibration follows the intervention. We machine-check in Lean 4 the finite-support algebraic and causal identities used in the classifier-regret argument, including its coverage-composition step.

</details>


### [216] [Curriculum-Driven Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Far-Range Rocket Landing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35954)
*Atin Chowdhury,Piyush Joshi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出课程驱动的深度强化学习框架，用于可重复使用运载器的远距离导航与精确垂直软着陆，并重新设计奖励函数，在1000–1500单位初始水平距离下实现99.98%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主垂直着陆面临强非线性动力学、高精度要求与环境不确定性；已有RL方法多采用平坦训练范式与过度简化的初始条件，且早期奖励函数存在奖励分量标定不当与优化目标潜在冲突的问题，严重限制其实用性。

Method: 三段式课程学习 + critic warm-up 预热 + rehearsal 回放机制以防灾难性遗忘；采用含完整3×3旋转矩阵的高维观测向量；重新设计奖励函数，将单步奖励幅度约束为O(1)，其进度项累积轨迹上缩减的总距离，降低计算开销并缓解目标冲突。

Result: 10万回合评估下，所提策略成功率99.98%，基线68.31%；保留初始燃料容量的69.1%，最终距着陆台中心平均7.07单位，基线为13.10单位。

Conclusion: 课程驱动的RL框架配合改进奖励设计，可支撑远超既有基准的远距离导航与高精度软着陆，显著优于平坦训练基线，在成功率、燃料效率与着陆精度上均有提升。

Abstract: Autonomous vertical landing of reusable launch vehicles is a critical yet formidable challenge in aerospace engineering, primarily due to highly nonlinear dynamics, stringent precision require- ments, and inherent environmental uncertainties. While reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional model-based control, existing approaches frequently rely on flat training paradigms and highly simplified initial conditions, drastically limiting their real-world applicability. This paper proposes a comprehensive curriculum-driven deep reinforcement learning framework designed to master both far-range navigation and precision landing. By employing a three-stage curriculum augmented with a critic warm-up procedure and a rehearsal mechanism to prevent catastrophic forgetting, alongside a high-dimensional observation vector utilizing a full 3 X 3 rotation-matrix, the agent is trained to navigate from an initial horizontal distance of 1,000 to 1,500 units vastly farther than prior benchmarks before executing a soft touchdown. Crucially, we intro- duce a redesigned reward function that reduces unnecessary computational overhead and addresses limitations of earlier formulations, including poorly calibrated reward components and potentially conflicting optimization objectives. The redesigned function bounds the per-step reward magnitude by (O(1)), while its progress term accumulates the total distance closed over the trajectory. The available 100,000-episode results report a 99.98% success rate for the proposed policy and 68.31% for the baseline under the evaluation conditions. In the evaluation, the proposed policy retained 69.1% of its initial fuel capacity and achieved a mean final distance from the pad centre of 7.07 units, compared with 13.10 units for the baseline. Landing visualizations are available in Video 1 and Video 2.

</details>


### [217] [ResCom: Activation Residual Compensation for Large Language Model Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35955)
*Ning Yang,Bohan Cui,Zhuowen Liu,Yuting Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ResCom: 利用激活舍入残差做低秩校正，闭式求解补偿层输出误差，提升低比特W-A量化的LLM精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特权重-激活量化可降低大模型部署的显存与算力开销，但校准后激活舍入仍会损失精度；由于同一量化bin内的激活无法区分，仅从舍入后输入做重建无法恢复被丢弃的信息。

Method: 提出ResCom：以激活舍入残差为信号，学习一个低秩校正项来补偿由此产生的层输出误差。采用输出感知的校准流程，按对输出重构的贡献选择残差方向，并闭式求解校正矩阵，无需梯度训练，也不修改已校准权重；实现上包含FP32版本与紧凑存储版本。

Result: Llama-3-8B（4-bit权重与激活）上，rank-32注意力校正将WikiText-2困惑度从7.708降至7.147，MMLU提升2.89个百分点，五样本GSM8K从23.96%升至36.16%。在1B至70B模型及留出C4上验证了泛化性。FP32实现仅增加2.25%的4K prefill时间；紧凑存储版本相对FP16仍保留27.7%的峰值显存降低。

Conclusion: 激活舍入残差蕴含可被利用的信息；低秩、闭式的输出感知校正能在不改权重、不训练的前提下显著改善低比特量化LLM的精度，且额外开销与显存收益可控。

Abstract: Low-bit weight--activation quantization reduces the memory and computation needed to deploy large language models, but activation rounding can still degrade accuracy after calibration. Reconstruction from rounded inputs cannot distinguish activations within the same quantization bin. We propose ResCom, a low-rank correction that uses the activation rounding residual to compensate for the resulting layer-output error. An output-aware calibration procedure selects residual directions by their contribution to output reconstruction and computes the correction in closed form, without gradient training or updates to the calibrated weights. On Llama-3-8B with 4-bit weights and activations, rank-32 attention corrections reduce WikiText-2 perplexity from 7.708 to 7.147, improve MMLU by 2.89 percentage points, and raise five-shot GSM8K accuracy from 23.96 to 36.16 percent. Evaluations on models from 1B to 70B parameters and on held-out C4 test the method beyond this setting. The evaluated FP32 implementation adds 2.25 percent to 4K prefill time; a separate compact-storage implementation retains a 27.7 percent peak-memory reduction relative to FP16.

</details>


### [218] [Distributed LLM Inference via Communication-Efficient Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35957)
*Joohyun Shin,Byeonghyeon Park,Keumseo Ryum,Joonhyuk Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DISCO：通过在服务端部署草稿SLM副本，将分布式投机解码的通信量从词表级分布降为token索引与标量概率，在带宽受限下实现更高加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端-服务器协同LLM推理中，分布式投机解码的加速受限于词表规模的通信开销：精确拒绝采样需在设备与服务器间传输完整词表上的token分布，在带宽受限环境下代价高昂。

Method: 提出DISCO通信高效框架。核心是在服务器侧维护一个草稿小语言模型（SLM）副本，使服务器可本地获得拒绝采样所需的草稿侧分布，从而无需传输词表级分布，端-服务器间仅交换草稿token索引与标量概率值，同时保持精确的目标分布（无损）。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，DISCO相较现有分布式投机解码方法取得一致的更高解码加速，尤其在严格带宽约束条件下优势更明显。

Conclusion: 以服务端草稿模型副本替代词表级分布传输，可在保持精确采样分布的前提下显著降低通信开销，是带宽受限端-服务器协同推理的有效方案。

Abstract: Distributed speculative decoding has emerged as a promising approach for device--server collaborative large language model (LLM) inference, but its decoding speedup is often limited by the vocabulary-scale communication overhead. In existing distributed speculative decoding methods, exact rejection sampling requires transmitting full token distributions over the LLM vocabulary between the device and the server, which becomes costly in bandwidth-constrained environments. To address this issue, we propose DISCO, a communication-efficient framework for distributed speculative decoding, that eliminates vocabulary-scale distribution transfer while preserving the exact target distribution. DISCO achieves this by introducing a server-side replica of the draft small language model (SLM), which enables the server to locally obtain the draft-side distribution required for rejection sampling. As a result, DISCO exchanges only drafted token indices and scalar probability values between the device and the server. Experimental results on multiple datasets show that DISCO consistently achieves higher decoding speedup than existing distributed speculative decoding methods, particularly under stringent bandwidth constraints.

</details>


### [219] [Exponential Wake-Up Overshoot in Explicit Gaussian Point-Process Filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35958)
*Hanwu Qin,Dianhai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文分析了高斯点过程滤波器在长静默后事件恢复时首个更新的放大现象，给出其精确分布与可计算的"穿越指数"，并对比显式滤波与隐式后验众数滤波的静默渐近行为及损失特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件序列长时间静默后恢复时，显式高斯点过程滤波器的首个更新会随静默时长呈指数放大，这一失效模式缺乏理论刻画，也缺少预测何时会超调的可计算指标。

Method: 推导首个更新的精确分布，构造预测超调的穿越指数；对显式（单评分步）滤波及其隐式后验众数对应体，推导状态方差的二阶静默展开（对数修正项符号相反）；用连续时间反例界定一致性界；在73个穿越单元与交易所成交数据上做实验验证，并测试方差上限的影响。

Result: 显式与隐式滤波的方差二阶展开含符号相反的对数修正；穿越指数可区分"放大指数达到1的箱宽"与"真实速率被超调的更大箱宽"；固定箱宽下隐式滤波期望损失随静默时长对数增长，且不存在对箱宽与静默时长一致的界（连续时间反例）；实验在全部73个穿越单元及成交数据上验证了预测；方差上限减轻显式超调，但多数情况下损害隐式滤波。

Conclusion: 静默后首个更新的指数放大是显式高斯点过程滤波的结构性缺陷，可被穿越指数准确预测；隐式滤波虽在局部更稳健，但其损失随静默时长无界增长，方差上限并非通用的补救手段。

Abstract: When events resume after a long silence, explicit Gaussian point-process filters amplify the first update exponentially in the silence duration. We give the exact distribution of this update and a computable index that predicts when it overshoots. For the explicit (single-scoring-step) filter and its implicit posterior-mode counterpart, we derive second-order silence expansions of the state variance with opposite-sign logarithmic corrections. The crossing index determines when the post-wake prediction exceeds the resumed rate, separating the bin width at which the amplification exponent reaches one from the larger width at which the true rate is overshot. At fixed bin width, the implicit filter's expected loss grows logarithmically with silence duration, whereas a continuous-time counterexample rules out a bound uniform in bin width and silence duration. Experimental evaluation confirms these predictions in all 73 crossing cells and on exchange trade data, while variance caps reduce explicit overshoot but mostly hurt the implicit filter.

</details>


### [220] [From Slices to Volumes: Comparing 2D, 2.5D, and 3D Residual Networks for Pulmonary Nodule Malignancy-Risk Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35960)
*Bahodir Nazarov,Zineb Gharib,Fatima Zazoul*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究在LIDC-IDRI队列上系统比较2D、2.5D、3D残差网络对肺结节恶性风险分类的表现，并检验动量对比预训练、轻度数据增强及排除不确定评级结节的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺结节恶性风险分类中，输入维度（2D单层、2.5D相邻层、3D局部体数据）与训练策略（预训练、增强、标签筛选）的影响缺乏系统性对照，且已有结论常受预处理、优化、模型容量与重复实验设置差异的混杂。

Method: 回顾性构建LIDC-IDRI队列共2,654个结节，按放射科医师评级中位数标注为良性、不确定、恶性；按患者划分1,876训练/382验证/396测试。表征包括单轴位层、5层相邻层及局部CT体数据。每条轨道均评估随机初始化基线、动量对比预训练后微调、以及轻度增强的监督训练。以验证集Macro-F1选择检查点；2D实验使用3个随机种子，2.5D与3D为单次运行；另设排除不确定结节的二分类实验。

Result: 增强模型测试Macro-F1为2D 0.6134±0.0075（标准差跨种子）、2.5D 0.6537、3D 0.5403；对应准确率0.6128、0.6869、0.5455。增强在每条轨道内均提升Macro-F1，而所测试的预训练方案均使其下降。二分类Macro-F1分别为0.8227、0.8664、0.7554。

Conclusion: 增强的2.5D模型取得最高观测性能；但预处理、优化、容量与重复次数的差异限制了对"维度"贡献的归因。标签反映放射科医师评估的恶性风险而非病理确诊癌症。代码与实验结果已开源。

Abstract: Purpose: To compare 2D, 2.5D, and 3D residual networks for pulmonary nodule malignancy-risk classification and evaluate momentum-contrast pretraining, mild augmentation, and exclusion of indeterminate ratings.
  Methods: A retrospectively prepared LIDC-IDRI cohort contained 2,654 nodules labeled benign, indeterminate, or malignant using median radiologist ratings. Patient-disjoint splits comprised 1,876 training, 382 validation, and 396 test nodules. Representations included one axial slice, five neighboring slices, and a local CT volume. Each track evaluated a randomly initialized baseline, momentum-contrast pretraining followed by fine-tuning, and supervised training with mild augmentation. Checkpoints were selected by validation Macro-F1. The 2D experiments used three seeds; 2.5D and 3D results were single-run estimates. A separate binary experiment excluded indeterminate nodules.
  Results: Augmented models achieved test Macro-F1 values of $0.6134\pm0.0075$ for 2D, $0.6537$ for 2.5D, and $0.5403$ for 3D; the 2D uncertainty denotes population standard deviation across seeds. Corresponding accuracies were $0.6128$, $0.6869$, and $0.5455$. Augmentation improved Macro-F1 within every track, whereas the tested pretraining recipes reduced it. Binary Macro-F1 values were $0.8227$, $0.8664$, and $0.7554$, respectively.
  Conclusion: Augmented 2.5D achieved the highest observed performance. Differences in preprocessing, optimization, capacity, and replication limit attribution to dimensionality. Labels reflect radiologist-assessed malignancy risk rather than pathology-confirmed cancer. Code and experimental results are available at https://github.com/CT-DeepLearning-Team/CT-2D-2.5D-3D-DeepLearning.

</details>


### [221] [Knowledge distillation across teacher architectures for compact diabetic retinopathy grading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35961)
*Mossa Manisa,Habiba Jahan Priya,A. K. M. Fakhrul Hossain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在APTOS 2019五分类糖尿病视网膜病变分级任务上，系统评估离线基于响应的知识蒸馏，将ResNet-50、MobileNetV3-Large与Swin-T教师蒸馏至MobileNetV3-Small学生，学生仅1.52M参数、5.94MB，三随机种子QWK均值0.9024（基线0.8804），实现约18倍参数压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 糖尿病视网膜病变分级模型精度高但难以部署到资源受限硬件，需在保证性能的前提下压缩模型规模。

Method: 构建教师×温度×硬标签权重3×4×2网格（单种子筛选），选取6种配置与无蒸馏基线在3个随机种子上评估；教师在ResNet-50、MobileNetV3-Large、Swin-T中比较，学生统一为MobileNetV3-Small；指标为二次加权Kappa与macro-F1。

Result: 单种子最佳QWK为0.9093（macro-F1 0.6851），来自Swin-T教师、温度4、硬标签权重0.7；其三种子均值0.9024，基线为0.8804。学生1.52M参数、5.94MB，相对Swin-T参数减少18.07倍。温度与硬标签权重效应依赖教师与配置，小差异对随机种子敏感。

Conclusion: 知识蒸馏可在该评估协议下获得性能具竞争力的小型学生模型，但结论仍需独立外部验证。

Abstract: Diabetic retinopathy grading from retinal fundus photographs is important but difficult to deploy on resource-constrained hardware. We conducted a controlled study of offline response-based knowledge distillation for five-class diabetic retinopathy grading on APTOS 2019, comparing ResNet-50, MobileNetV3-Large, and Swin Transformer-Tiny (Swin-T) teachers distilled into a MobileNetV3-Small student. A 3 x 4 x 2 grid of teacher, temperature, and hard-label weight was screened at one seed, while six configurations and the no-distillation baseline were evaluated across three seeds. The highest observed single-seed quadratic weighted kappa was 0.9093 (macro-F1 0.6851) for Swin-T at temperature 4 and hard-label weight 0.7; the corresponding three-seed mean was 0.9024, compared with 0.8804 for the baseline. The student used 1.52 M parameters and 5.94 MB, representing an 18.07x parameter reduction relative to Swin-T. Temperature and hard-label weight effects were teacher- and configuration-dependent, while small performance differences were sensitive to random seed. Knowledge distillation produced a compact student with competitive performance under the evaluated protocol, but independent external validation remains necessary.

</details>


### [222] [h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35962)
*Skander Moalla,Ahmad Rammal,Niket Patel,Remi Munos,Julia Kempe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出h1——一个简单的、无分解/搜索结构的agentic循环harness，通过高效Lean 4接口与验证器反馈+自我反思迭代，在匹配模型下匹配或超越专门化证明工作流，并强调高效Lean接口是成本与解题率的关键决定因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非形式数学的进展主要来自scaling思维链与agentic推理，而形式定理证明越来越依赖人工设计的工作流（规划、分解、编排专用prover）。这些工作流的增益常与更强模型或更多算力混淆，难以判断其真实价值。核心问题：一个简单的、仅scale测试时算力的agentic循环能否匹敌这些复杂工作流？该问题对形式验证跟上前沿模型产出的研究数学至关重要。

Method: 提出h1：一个简洁harness，为模型提供高效的Lean 4交互接口，通过验证器反馈与自我反思循环持续工作，不施加分解或搜索结构。通过消融实验及与Claude Code、AxProverBase的匹配模型对比进行分析。

Result: 在PutnamBench、FATE-X、FormalConjectures100-Solved上达到SOTA；解决FormalConjectures中8个开放问题；在匹配模型下匹配或超越Goedel-Architect、AlphaProof Nexus等专门化工作流；单次尝试（pass@1）常可扩展以解决开放问题。

Conclusion: 简洁本身不够：高效的Lean接口在很大程度上决定成本与求解率。建议未来工作在用强模型规定工作流之前，先以高效执行反馈评估前沿模型，否则有遭遇"苦涩教训"（bitter lesson）的风险。

Abstract: While progress in informal mathematics has come largely from scaling the chain-of-thought and agentic reasoning of frontier language models, formal theorem proving has increasingly relied on human-designed workflows around these models, such as planning, decomposition, and orchestrating specialized provers. This raises a bitter-lesson question: can a simple agentic loop that scales test-time compute match these workflows? The answer matters as formal verification must scale to keep up with frontier models producing research mathematics, yet new workflows rarely settle it, as their gains are often confounded with stronger models or more compute. We study this question with h1, a simple harness that gives a model an efficient interface to Lean 4 and keeps it working through verifier feedback and self-reflection, without imposing a decomposition or search structure. h1 reaches state-of-the-art results on PutnamBench, FATE-X, and FormalConjectures100-Solved, settles eight open problems in FormalConjectures, and, at matched models, matches or outperforms specialized workflows such as Goedel-Architect and AlphaProof Nexus, surprisingly showing that a single attempt (pass@1) can often scale to solve open problems. Through ablations and matched-model comparisons with Claude Code and AxProverBase, we find that simplicity alone is not enough: an efficient Lean interface largely determines cost and solve rate. We thus recommend that future work evaluate frontier models with efficient execution feedback before prescribing workflows, at the risk of bitter lessons.

</details>


### [223] [Condition-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Network for Aerodynamic Configuration Design of Commercial Aircraft](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35963)
*Youzheng Yu,Jiaqing Kou,Weiwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出条件增强生成对抗网络CEGAN，将几何与气动信息嵌入生成过程，用于气动外形设计优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式机器学习可实现端到端气动设计优化，但生成的设计可能违反几何约束或偏离目标气动性能。

Method: 在生成过程中嵌入几何与气动信息，构建条件感知损失函数：几何引导的可行性惩罚与代理模型评估的气动性能惩罚相结合；并设输出过滤机制，用同一数据集训练的代理模型剔除不可行设计。

Result: 在类似Cessna Citation X的飞机构型上验证，每构型由28个形状参数表示，用OpenVSP评估气动性能；插值与外推测试表明，相比基线模型，插值条件下平均生成误差降低至少36%，极端外推条件下降低至少46%，并生成超越训练分布的多样且物理可行设计。

Conclusion: CEGAN为概念设计阶段的快速气动外形探索提供了稳健而准确的工具。

Abstract: Generative machine learning provides an end-to-end framework for aerodynamic design optimization by generating diverse aerodynamic configurations conditioned on target performance. However, the generated designs may violate geometric constraints or deviate from the prescribed aerodynamic performance. Therefore, we propose a Condition-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Network (CEGAN) that embeds geometric and aerodynamic information into the generative process. A condition-informed loss function is developed by combining a geometry-guided feasibility penalty with an aerodynamic performance penalty evaluated by surrogate models trained on the same dataset. Additionally, an output filtering mechanism discards infeasible designs using these surrogate models, ensuring compliance with prescribed conditions. The method is demonstrated on aircraft configurations similar to the Cessna Citation X. Each configuration is represented by 28 shape parameters, whose aerodynamic performance is evaluated using OpenVSP. Interpolation and extrapolation tests are conducted for different network architectures and conditioning strategies. Compared with the baseline model, CEGAN reduces the average generation error by at least 36% for interpolated conditions and by at least 46% under extreme extrapolation conditions, while successfully producing diverse and physically feasible designs that extend beyond the training distribution. Therefore, the proposed CEGAN framework offers a robust and accurate tool for rapid aerodynamic configuration exploration during the conceptual design phase.

</details>


### [224] [Generalization in Learning: Eyring Formula and Predator-prey Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35965)
*S. V. Kozyrev,I. A. Lopatin,Alexander Pechen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文借助捕食者-猎物模型研究机器学习泛化，并将其与随机梯度Langevin动力学、GAN的生化解释以及grokking现象的热力学解释相联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习泛化机制缺乏物理/生物层面的直观解释，作者希望引入生态学与热力学的建模视角来刻画训练动力学与泛化行为。

Method: 用捕食者-猎物模型描述学习动力学；综述随机梯度Langevin动力学与GAN的生物学、化学解释；在"用固定次数多项式从含噪数据中恢复未知函数"的具体算例中，将该模型与梯度下降法进行近似效果对比；并借助Eyring公式等热力学论证解释grokking（延迟泛化）。

Result: 在多项式拟合含噪数据的算例中，捕食者-猎物模型的近似效果优于梯度下降法；Eyring公式为grokking现象提供了热力学层面的解释框架。

Conclusion: 生态学与热力学模型可作为理解机器学习泛化与训练动力学的有效类比工具，但其结论主要建立在特定算例与类比论证之上，普适性仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: In this work, generalization in machine learning is investigated using a predator-prey model. We overview biological and chemical interpretation of the stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics and generative adversarial network. For a particular example of recovering an unknown function by a polynomial of fixed degree from a set of noisy data, the predator-prey model provides better approximation compared to the gradient descent method. Further, thermodynamical arguments, in particular Eyring formula, are used to explain grokking (delayed generalization) phenomenon in machine learning.

</details>


### [225] [Data-driven Discovery of Lie Symmetries and First Integrals with Latent ODEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35967)
*Matt L. Wiemman,Peter Melchior*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LatentLieODE，一种从时间序列（含视频）中联合学习线性 Lie 对称性与首次积分的神经 ODE 方法，在六个基准系统上发现的不变量与真值相关系数 |ρ| ≥ 0.978，并在球面上恢复出非阿贝尔 𝔰𝔬(3)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动的动力系统代理模型通常缺乏可解释的对称性结构与守恒量；作者希望从观测数据中自动发现动力学背后的 Lie 对称性（无穷小生成元）与首次积分，以提升神经代理模型的可解释性与物理一致性。

Method: 1) 自编码器学习系统低维表示，并将轨迹映射到去相关的潜坐标 z∈ℝ^d；2) 构建线性无穷小生成元库 A_k∈ℝ^{d×d}，与 MLP 参数化的潜 ODE f(z)=dz/dt 联合优化：以可微的 Lie 括号残差 J_f(z)A z − A f(z) 约束生成元，同时以重构观测空间时间序列为目标训练 f；3) 在确定生成元与 f 后，用第三个网络 H_φ 拟合系统的首次积分。

Result: 在六个基准系统（谐振子、单摆与双摆、Lotka-Volterra、像素单摆、球面测地线）上均找到相关对称性；发现的不变量与真值守恒量相关系数 |ρ| ≥ 0.978；球面情形恢复出非阿贝尔 𝔰𝔬(3)，并以其恢复的结构常数的负定 Killing 型予以验证。

Conclusion: 该方法推进了数据驱动的对称性发现，为动力系统的神经代理模型提供了一条新途径：可联合辨识对称性生成元、潜动力学与守恒量，并能识别非阿贝尔结构。

Abstract: We present LatentLieODE, a novel neural ODE method to discover linear Lie symmetries and first integrals of the learned dynamics from timeseries observations such as video inputs. It starts with an autoencoder, which learns a low dimensional representation of the observed system and then maps trajectories to decorrelated latent coordinates $z \in \mathbb{R}^d$. A bank of linear infinitesimal generators $\mathbf{A}_k \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$ is fitted jointly against a differentiable Lie-bracket residual $\mathbf{J}_f(z)\mathbf{A}z - \mathbf{A} f(z)$, while an MLP optimises the latent ODE $f(z) = \mathrm{d}z/\mathrm{d}t$ to reconstruct the observation-space timeseries. After suitable generators and $f$ are found, we fit a third network $H_φ$ to generate the first integral of the system. Across six benchmark systems (harmonic oscillator, simple and twin pendulums, Lotka-Volterra, pixel pendulum, sphere geodesics) we find each system's relevant symmetries, and the discovered invariants match ground-truth conserved quantities at $|ρ| \geq 0.978$. On the sphere, the pipeline recovers a non-abelian $\mathfrak{so}(3)$, certified by the negative-definite Killing form of its recovered structure constants. This work presents significant advances in data-driven discovery of symmetries and provides a new pathway for neural surrogates of dynamical systems.

</details>


### [226] [Multiple Leak Localization in Water Distribution Networks through Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35972)
*Arvin Ajoodani,Sara Nazif,Pouria Ramazi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种图神经网络（GNN）模型，可在不预设泄漏数量、不穷举泄漏位置组合的情况下，实现供水管网中多漏点同时发生时的泄漏定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多漏点同时发生时，在稀疏监测条件下定位困难；现有数据驱动方法通常假设单一或预设数量的泄漏，或需大量穷举泄漏组合，泛化与计算效率受限。

Method: 构建基于管网拓扑的GNN分类模型，训练时无需指定泄漏数量或穷举所有泄漏位置组合；在31节点Hanoi网与92节点NET3网两个基准网络上评估，考虑变需求、稀疏压力传感器覆盖、变泄漏量级及不同同时泄漏数量等工况；与MLP、SVM、KNN、随机森林对比。

Result: GNN在Hanoi网与NET3网上分别较对比方法最高提升约12%与20%的准确率；在两个规模不同的网络上表现一致。

Conclusion: GNN可有效处理变数量同时泄漏的定位问题，且跨网络性能一致，支持该方法在更大规模管网上的可扩展性。

Abstract: Leak localization in water distribution networks is challenging when multiple leaks occur simultaneously, particularly under sparse monitoring. Existing data-driven methods often assume a single or predefined number of leaks or require extensive enumeration of leak combinations. This study proposes a graph neural network (GNN) model that localizes a variable number of simultaneous leaks without specifying the leak count in advance or exhaustively generating every possible combination of leak locations for training. The model is evaluated on two benchmark networks of different sizes, the 31-node Hanoi network and the larger 92-node NET3 network, under variable demand, sparse pressure-sensor coverage, variable leak magnitudes, and varying numbers of simultaneous leaks. The GNN outperforms multilayer perceptron, support vector machine, K-nearest neighbors, and random forest classifiers by up to 12% and 20% in accuracy respectively in Hanoi and NET3 networks. Consistent performance across both networks supports the scalability of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [227] [A Graph-informed Kriging model for sample-efficient Bayesian optimization of wind farm layouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35975)
*Zhen-Fan Wang,Kai Zhang,Xianping Du,Zhaolong Han,Dai Zhou,Onur Bilgen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Graph-informed Kriging代理模型，将可复用的气动交互信息以有向气动图结构嵌入Kriging均值函数，使GP只建模残差与不确定性；在稀疏数据下提升AEP预测精度与贝叶斯优化样本效率，并可扩展至48台风机的大规模CFD布局优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风场布局优化随风机数量增加而变难，尤其使用高保真气动模型时计算昂贵。传统Kriging贝叶斯优化在高维布局空间中样本效率低，因为稀疏训练数据对设计空间覆盖有限，代理模型难以捕捉AEP的主要变化。

Method: 构建Graph-informed Kriging框架：将风场表示为有向气动图，在低维相对坐标空间中定义成对风机交互，再组装为场级均值函数（结构化先验均值），用以刻画AEP主导变化；高斯过程仅对残差结构和不确定性建模。随后嵌入贝叶斯优化进行布局搜索。

Result: 稀疏数据条件下AEP预测精度稳定优于普通Kriging与generic-trend Kriging，且随布局维度与尾流交互强度增加收益更明显；嵌入贝叶斯优化后样本效率显著提升，在IEA Wind Task 37基准上约280次AEP评估即获得有竞争力解；16风机受控算例中同等高保真评估预算下优于普通与多保真Kriging；进一步扩展至48风机风场验证可行性。

Conclusion: 图信息代理建模能更高效地利用高保真气动模型，为可靠的大规模风场布局设计提供支持，并具备向CFD级大规模优化推广的潜力。

Abstract: Wind farm layout optimization becomes increasingly difficult as turbine count grows, especially when high-fidelity aerodynamic models are used. Conventional Kriging-based Bayesian optimization often suffers from low sample efficiency in high-dimensional layout spaces because sparse training data provide limited domain coverage. We develop a Graph-informed Kriging framework that embeds reusable aerodynamic interaction information into the surrogate mean function. The wind farm is represented as a directed aerodynamic graph, where pairwise turbine interactions defined in a low-dimensional relative-coordinate space are assembled into a farm-scale mean. This structured mean captures the dominant variation in annual energy production (AEP), allowing the Gaussian process to model only the residual structure and uncertainty.
