COGNAC evaluations run at a cost comparable to UNIFAC, thereby unlocking the potential of machine-learning models for process simulations.

</details>


### [262] [High-Fidelity Aerostructural Dataset of Transonic Wings in Cruise Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36442)
*Pavankumar Koratikere,Abhijnan Dikshit,Leifur Leifsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发布了一个跨声速机翼静态气动-结构耦合分析的高保真多学科数据集（2471 个样本 + 3 个分布外样本），用于 ML 机翼设计的基准评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开机翼设计数据集多聚焦气动性能，缺乏高保真的气动-结构耦合行为数据，而实际机翼设计需同时兼顾气动性能与结构完整性。

Method: 构建高保真多学科数据集：平面形状由展长、后掠、上反、梢弦、梢扭参数化，翼型截面用 CST 方法参数化；分析条件包括马赫数、攻角、高度、结构载荷系数；并通过训练先进 ML 模型预测气动表面量、积分气动性能量与翼盒失效分布来验证数据集效用。

Result: 气动量预测的 NRMSE 最优达 0.0309，翼盒失效分布预测的 NRMSE 最优达 0.1189。

Conclusion: 该数据集为多样跨声速机翼提供耦合气动与结构响应，建立了多物理场 ML 模型的基准，并鼓励在各类工程领域构建类似高保真多物理场基准数据集。

Abstract: Recent advances in machine learning (ML) have the potential to substantially accelerate aircraft wing design, a process that has traditionally required extensive high-fidelity simulation and design iteration. Existing public datasets for ML-based wing design have focused primarily on aerodynamic performance, with limited consideration of the multidisciplinary interactions that govern practical aircraft design. In particular, efficient wing design requires simultaneous consideration of aerodynamic performance and structural integrity, yet no publicly available datasets capture this coupled aerostructural behavior at high-fidelity. To address this need, a high-fidelity multidisciplinary dataset for static aerostructural analysis of transonic wings is introduced. The dataset includes 2471 samples, along with three out-of-distribution samples. The wing planform geometry is parameterized by span, sweep, dihedral, tip chord, and tip twist, while the airfoil cross-sections are parameterized using the class-shape transformation method. The analysis is further parameterized by Mach number, angle of attack, altitude, and structural load factor. The utility of the dataset is demonstrated by training state-of-the-art ML models to predict aerodynamic surface quantities, integrated aerodynamic performance quantities, and the failure distribution of the wingbox. ML models achieve at most 0.0309 normalized root mean squared error (NRMSE) in the prediction of aerodynamic quantities and at most 0.1189 NRMSE in the prediction of failure distribution of the wingbox. By providing coupled aerodynamic and structural responses for a diverse set of transonic wings, this dataset establishes a benchmark for developing, evaluating, and comparing multi-physics ML models for wing design. Broadly, it is intended to encourage creation of similar high-fidelity multi-physics benchmark datasets across engineering domains.

</details>


### [263] [Split Federated Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36465)
*Jia Chen,Yecheng Lv,Xinrong Hu,Mingdi Huang,Jun Bai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文首次系统提出分割联邦遗忘（SFU）问题，理论刻画历史影响传播与分区相关遗忘可行性，并提出SURE方案（双重重要性估计+选择性参数扰动+重要性引导恢复），在适中开销下接近模式匹配重训练的遗忘-效用平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分割联邦学习（SFL）结合分区模型执行与联邦聚合，支持分布式Web/边缘协同学习；但由于跨分区耦合与双侧聚合中的历史影响传播，移除已学习贡献十分困难，现有研究缺乏对该问题的系统定义与理论分析。

Method: 1）首次系统形式化SFU，涵盖客户端级与类别级移除、反事实重训练、分区特定更新约束；2）理论刻画历史影响传播与模式相关的遗忘可行性，揭示受限模型更新的结构性局限；3）提出SURE初始方案，集成双重重要性估计、选择性参数扰动与重要性引导恢复。

Result: 将现有遗忘方法适配至SFL的大量实验显示，在不同模型架构、数据分布与更新模式下存在显著的遗忘-效用权衡；SURE以适度额外开销实现与模式匹配重训练相当的遗忘一致性；进一步分析揭示分割位置与更新约束对遗忘行为的影响。

Conclusion: SFU构成一个独立的研究问题，本文为其提供问题定义、理论表征与基线方案，为分区联邦系统中的遗忘研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Split federated learning (SFL) combines partitioned model execution with federated aggregation to support collaborative learning across distributed Web and edge environments. However, removing learned contributions in SFL is challenging due to cross-partition coupling and historical influence propagation through dual-side aggregation. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first systematic formulation of Split Federated Unlearning (SFU), encompassing client-wise and class-wise removal, counterfactual retraining, and partition-specific update constraints. We theoretically characterize historical influence propagation and mode-dependent unlearning feasibility, revealing structural limitations of restricted model updates. As an initial solution, we propose SURE, integrating dual-importance estimation, selective parameter perturbation, and importance-guided recovery. Extensive experiments with existing unlearning methods adapted to SFL reveal substantial forgetting-utility trade-offs across model architectures, data distributions, and update modes. SURE achieves competitive agreement with mode-matched retraining at modest additional cost, while further analyses highlight the impact of split position and update constraints on unlearning behavior. These findings establish SFU as a distinct research problem and provide a foundation for unlearning in partitioned federated systems.

</details>


### [264] [CoHARL: Co-Evolving Agent Policies and Executable Harnesses with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36469)
*Jianwen Chen,Peng Xia,Kaide Zeng,Siwei Han,Zhen-Yu Zhang,Charles Fleming,Xinyu Ye,Huaxiu Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CoHARL，一个基于群体的强化学习框架，在策略训练过程中共同演化共享策略与一组可执行harness。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定策略下优化harness忽略了策略在学习过程中行为的变化；而固定harness训练策略则使生成训练经验的接口保持不变。二者割裂，因此需要在训练过程中自适应调整harness。

Method: CoHARL让共享策略在一组harness群体的rollout上学习；同时由proposer利用执行轨迹在训练中修改harness代码，实现策略与harness群体的协同演化。

Result: 在SWE-rebench上达到27.6%的平均解决率，较仅搜索harness提升6.4个百分点；在SWE-bench Verified与Terminal-Bench 2.0上于软件工程和终端任务中均有增益。在相同训练预算下，优于RL前一次性搜索harness以及交替更新策略与单一harness两种基线。

Conclusion: harness应与策略训练同步共同演化，CoHARL在匹配预算下优于一次性搜索与单一harness交替修订方案，验证了协同演化的有效性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents interact with their environments through executable harnesses that govern tool use and feedback. Optimizing a harness for a fixed policy overlooks how its behavior changes during learning, while training a policy under a fixed harness leaves the interface that generates its training experience unchanged. This motivates adapting the harness throughout policy training. We introduce CoHARL, a population-based reinforcement learning framework that co-evolves a shared policy and a population of executable harnesses. The policy learns from rollouts across the population, and a proposer uses its execution traces to revise harness code during training. CoHARL achieves a 27.6% mean resolved rate on SWE-rebench, improving over harness-only search by 6.4 percentage points. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show gains in software engineering and terminal-based tasks. Under matched training budgets, CoHARL also outperforms searching for a harness once before RL and alternating policy updates with revisions to a single active harness.

</details>


### [265] [Underdamped Anchored Langevin Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36470)
*Qi Feng,Hoang M. Nguyen,Lingjiong Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于欠阻尼动量动力学的锚定Langevin算法UALMC，首次为不可微与重尾目标提供无渐近偏差的动量型采样方法，并给出2-Wasserstein距离下的非渐近复杂度（对维度和精度依赖优于过阻尼锚定算法）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典ULA类算法依赖可微对数密度，且对重尾分布采样效率低；已有针对不可微、重尾目标的锚定方法均只在过阻尼框架下发展，缺少动量（动能）型方案。

Method: 构造欠阻尼锚定Langevin动力学（UALD）：用光滑参考势替换原始势，并在漂移项中引入乘性缩放，再基于该动力学的离散化格式得到UALMC算法。

Result: 建立了到目标分布在2-Wasserstein距离下的非渐近收敛保证，所得迭代复杂度在维度与精度依赖上优于过阻尼锚定Langevin算法；数值实验验证了理论与实际性能。

Conclusion: 动量型锚定Langevin框架可在无渐近偏差下处理不可微与重尾目标，并带来更优的复杂度缩放，为欠阻尼采样在非光滑场景的推广提供了理论与实证支持。

Abstract: Classical Langevin Monte Carlo algorithms, such as the unadjusted Langevin algorithm (ULA), are based on discretization schemes of the overdamped Langevin dynamics and are widely used for sampling in machine learning because they scale to high dimensions and large datasets. However, they require differentiable log-densities, and are less efficient for sampling heavy-tailed distributions. Although various approaches have been proposed in the literature for sampling non-differentiable and heavy-tailed targets, all of them are developed in the overdamped setting only. We propose a novel momentum-based underdamped anchored Langevin dynamics (UALD), and underdamped anchored Langevin Monte Carlo (UALMC) algorithm based on a discretization scheme of UALD. Our paper is the first to provide a kinetic (momentum-based) Langevin algorithm for non-differentiable and heavy-tailed targets that is free of asymptotic bias. The method replaces the original potential with a smooth reference potential and modifies the underdamped Langevin dynamics via multiplicative scaling in the drift term. We establish non-asymptotic guarantees in the 2-Wasserstein distance to the target distribution and show that the resulting iteration complexity has better dependence on dimension and accuracy level compared to overdamped-based anchored Langevin algorithms. We provide numerical experiments to illustrate the theory and practical performance of our proposed approach.

</details>


### [266] [Proposing Better Rollouts for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36477)
*Sirui Chen,Yunzhe Qi,Haobo Xu,Jiaru Zou,Mengting Ai,Zihao Li,Jingrui He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出 on-policy distillation（OPD）中固定使用学生策略采样会导致教师-学生失配的累积，提出将 rollout 策略本身作为优化对象，通过局部信赖域目标导出学生锚定、教师引导的几何混合分布，并用 proposal policy 单次前向近似该混合分布进行采样，在 16 个基准上稳定优于 OPD 及其变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD 中每轮直接从当前学生采样轨迹，要求教师对学生在任意轨迹上（包括教师自身难以到达的轨迹）都给出有效监督，容易产生噪声甚至误导性信号，诱发重复等不良模式；且更新后的学生又定义下一轮 rollout 策略，使该失配在训练中持续并放大。故问题根源在于 rollout 策略的选择，而非仅蒸馏目标。

Method: 提出 Mixture Proposal On-Policy Distillation（MPOPD）：以相对教师支持度构造局部信赖域目标，推导出学生锚定、教师引导的 rollout 分布，其解为学生策略与教师策略的几何混合；并引入 proposal policy 近似该混合分布，实现单次前向即可完成 rollout 生成。

Result: 在 16 个数学、知识、医学推理基准上一致优于 OPD 及近期变体；在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上数学推理平均准确率较 OPD 提升 6.91，同时平均生成长度减少 41%。

Conclusion: rollout 策略设计是改进 OPD 的有效抓手，将采样分布纳入优化可缓解教师-学生失配，并同时提升准确率与生成效率。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model post-training by letting the student learn from its own sampled trajectories under teacher supervision, aligning the training process with inference-time behavior. However, the rollout policy in OPD is usually treated as fixed: each round samples directly from the current student. We show that this choice can create a compounding teacher--student mismatch, because it requires the teacher to provide effective supervision on whichever trajectories the student samples, including ones less reachable by the teacher itself. On such trajectories, teacher supervision can become noisy or even misleading, leading to undesirable student patterns such as repetition. Moreover, since the updated student in turn defines the rollout policy of subsequent rounds, these patterns persist and potentially amplify over training. This failure mode suggests that improving OPD requires treating the rollout policy itself as an optimization target, rather than only modifying the distillation objective. We propose Mixture Proposal On-Policy Distillation (MPOPD), which derives a student-anchored, teacher-guided rollout distribution from a local trust-region objective based on relative teacher support. The resulting target is a geometric mixture of the student and teacher policies, and we introduce a proposal policy that approximates this mixture, enabling rollout generation in a single forward pass. Experiments on 16 math, knowledge, and medical reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over OPD and recent variants. On math reasoning, our method improves average accuracy by 6.91 over OPD on Qwen3-4B-Base while reducing average generation length by 41%, suggesting that rollout policy design provides an effective way to improve OPD.

</details>


### [267] [PRISM: Pathology Reliability In Scarce-label Medicine. A Tile-level Benchmark of Pathology Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36517)
*Alicem Koyun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISM 是一个瓦片级病理基础模型可靠性基准，联合评估模型选择、标签比例、校准与跨机构分布偏移四个维度，共 288 个实验单元与 20 个有向迁移对，并揭示多项校准与迁移失效现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理基础模型评测通常只关注全标签量下的分类性能与同分布测试集，校准、低标签预算下的行为以及跨机构偏移下的鲁棒性很少被联合评估，导致模型可靠性认知不完整。

Method: 构建 PRISM 瓦片级基准：8 个基础模型（CLIP、PLIP、CONCH、UNI、Virchow2、GigaPath、H-Optimus-0、Midnight）× 6 个数据集 × 6 个标签比例（1%–100%）× 3 个随机种子，共 864 次线性探测（合 288 个单元）；并扩展 Camelyon17 五家医院、20 个有向迁移对研究；采用温度缩放、ECE 与 Spearman 相关及 I² 异质性分析。

Result: 发现四点：(i) 全监督下 AUROC 排名可稳定预测校准排名（rho=0.52，I²=0%），1% 标签时关系转为数据集特定（rho=-0.24，I²=67%）；(ii) 困难数据集在低于某数据集特定标签比例时线性探测坍缩为单一预测类；(iii) 源域额外标签是否有益取决于迁移质量，迁移 AUROC 低于约 0.85 时，86–88% 组合的目标准 ECE 反而变差；(iv) 288 个单元中 49 个温度缩放未能降低 ECE，误校准以欠自信为主，迁移失败时源域拟合温度有害。

Conclusion: 病理基础模型的可靠性不能由全标签同分布 AUROC 单一推断，低标签与跨机构场景下校准行为显著退化；基准以 pip 可安装包形式发布并提供全部 288 单元参考结果，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Pathology foundation models are typically benchmarked on classification performance at full label availability and on in-distribution test sets, while calibration, behavior at low label budgets, and robustness under cross-institutional shift are seldom evaluated jointly. We introduce PRISM, a tile-level benchmark that measures the reliability of pathology foundation models along four axes: model choice, label fraction, calibration, and out-of-distribution transfer. PRISM evaluates eight foundation models (CLIP, PLIP, CONCH, UNI, Virchow2, GigaPath, H-Optimus-0, Midnight) on six tile-level datasets at six label fractions (1% to 100%) with three seeds (864 linear probe runs), extended with a five-hospital Camelyon17 study of 20 directed transfer pairs. Four phenomena emerge. (i) Under full supervision, AUROC rank predicts post-temperature calibration rank consistently across datasets (Spearman rho = 0.52, I^2 = 0%), whereas at 1% labels the relationship becomes dataset-specific (rho = -0.24, I^2 = 67%). (ii) On harder datasets the linear probe collapses to a single predicted class below a dataset-specific label fraction. (iii) Whether additional source-domain labels help or harm target calibration tracks how well the probe transfers: below a transfer AUROC of roughly 0.85, more labels worsen target ECE in 86-88% of combinations. (iv) Temperature scaling fails to reduce ECE in 49 of 288 cells, miscalibration is predominantly under-confidence, and a source-fitted temperature is harmful under failing transfer. PRISM is released as a pip-installable package with reference results for all 288 cells. Code and data: https://github.com/alicemkyn/prism-benchmark

</details>


### [268] [Folding Attention Biases into Keys Makes Compacted KV Caches Run on Standard Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36520)
*Utkarsh Kanwat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出将Attention Matching（AM）中的逐键logit偏置折叠进键向量（head内单一闭式方向，用上下文query拟合），得到尺寸与head维度均为常规形式的KV cache，可直接由未修改的FlashAttention和vLLM paged cache服务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AM通过对每头保留的键做重拟合值并给每个保留键的logit加偏置来压缩KV cache，但FlashAttention与vLLM的paged cache均没有接纳该偏置的接口，无法部署。

Method: 每头沿一个闭式求解的方向，将偏置折叠进键中，该方向由上下文query拟合；折叠后得到普通cache，规模与AM相同、head维度与模型一致，沿用模型自身query路径；输出误差由每个query在该方向上的投影偏离1的程度界定。等每头预算下通过KV connector用未修改的vLLM服务折叠cache。

Result: Qwen3-4B上51题全部与Hugging Face答案一致；Qwen3-14B LongBench 200样本中180个greedy输出一致。等预算下QuALITY（Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B、Llama-3.1-8B）与LongHealth（三个Qwen3模型）共14设置中13个与AM精度无显著差异；12个可比设置中KL到全cache均低于丢弃偏置。按发布预算时，Qwen3-4B、其Instruct-2507变体与Llama-3.1-8B共10设置中9个与AM无差异，KL不再优于丢弃偏置，精度上二者各胜一次。

Conclusion: 闭式折叠可把AM的偏置吸收进键，从而在标准FlashAttention/vLLM栈上无损部署，等预算下保持AM精度并降低KL；但按发布的不等预算时优势减弱，折叠与删除偏置的KL差异消失，说明折叠收益依赖每头预算分配。

Abstract: Attention Matching (AM) compacts a KV cache by keeping some keys per head, refitting their values and adding a bias to each kept key's logit. FlashAttention and vLLM's paged caches have no input for it. We fold the bias into the keys along one closed-form direction per head, fitted on context queries, giving a plain cache with AM's size and head dimension and the model's own query path; the output error is bounded by how far each query's projection on that direction is from 1. With equal per-head budgets, unmodified vLLM serves folded caches through a KV connector, matching Hugging Face's answers on all 51 Qwen3-4B questions and its greedy output on 180 of 200 Qwen3-14B LongBench samples. With equal budgets on QuALITY (Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and LongHealth (three Qwen3 models), the fold is within noise of AM's accuracy in 13 of 14 settings, with lower KL to the full cache than dropping the bias in all 12 where both ran. Under the published per-head budgets, on Qwen3-4B, its Instruct-2507 variant and Llama-3.1-8B, it is within noise of AM in 9 of 10, no longer beats dropping the bias in KL, and the two each win once in accuracy.

</details>


### [269] [NextEval: An Agent-Based Solver and Benchmark for Derivative-Free Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36553)
*Shuo Chen,Li Cui,Cunxin Huang,Ya-Feng Liu,Minghang Xie,Meng Xu,Zaikun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于LLM智能体的无导数优化求解器NextEval及其基准协议NextEval Bench，通过智能体在共享评估历史与方法状态支持下调度多种数值方法，实现评估预算的高效利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无导数优化中导数不可得或获取代价高，且黑箱目标函数评估本身昂贵，因此在有限预算下如何利用已积累的观测来选择信息量大的评估点，是DFO的核心难题。

Method: 构建由LLM智能体与数值环境组成的系统：环境提供分析历史评估与执行数值方法的工具，并维护共享评估历史与方法特定状态以支持跨方法切换的持续运行；LLM智能体依据观测与工具反馈选择工具、配置参数并分配评估预算，候选点由数值方法计算与评估。同时提出NextEval Bench基准协议，在相同数值工具、匹配评估预算与信息约束下比较不同智能体配置。

Result: 在低维DFO问题上的数值实验表明，NextEval在函数评估效率上优于当前最先进的DFO基线方法。

Conclusion: 将LLM智能体与数值优化方法结合、并借助共享历史与状态机制实现方法间自适应切换，可有效提升有限预算下的DFO评估效率；NextEval Bench为智能体式DFO配置提供了可控、可比的评测协议。

Abstract: Derivative-free optimization (DFO) addresses problems where derivatives are unavailable or costly to obtain. This setting often arises in simulation-based and experimental applications, where evaluating the black-box objective can itself be costly. Thus, it remains a central challenge in DFO to effectively exploit accumulated observations to select informative evaluation points under a limited budget. In this light, we introduce the NextEval solver, an agent-based DFO solver, which integrates the capabilities of a large language model (LLM) to guide the sequential selection of evaluation points. Specifically, we establish a system that combines an LLM agent with a numerical environment. The environment provides tools for analyzing past evaluations and executing numerical methods, while maintaining a shared evaluation history and method-specific state to support continuation across method switches. Using observations and tool feedback, the LLM agent selects tools, configures their parameters, and allocates the evaluation budget, while numerical methods compute and evaluate candidate points. Building on this system, we also introduce NextEval Bench, a benchmark protocol for comparing agent configurations on shared DFO tasks using the same numerical tools under matched evaluation budgets and information constraints. Numerical results on low-dimensional DFO problems demonstrate that the NextEval solver outperforms the state-of-the-art DFO baselines in function-evaluation efficiency.

</details>


### [270] [Holomorphic Cauchy Networks for Efficient Stationary Tail Computation in High-Dimensional Reflected Brownian Motions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36558)
*Kehan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Holomorphic Cauchy Networks (HCNs)，用复值有理Cauchy子网在无极点域上强制全纯性，实现高维反射布朗运动(RBM)稳态尾概率的高效精确计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维反射布朗运动(RBM)的稳态尾计算在计算上极具挑战性；现有NN4MGF方法依赖采样Cauchy-Riemann惩罚项及其输入导数图，带来额外计算与内存开销，需要更高效的结构化表示。

Method: 在NN4MGF的共享坐标basic-adjoint-relationship (BAR)框架上构建HCN：原生复值有理Cauchy子网在无极点域上天然满足全纯性，去除采样的Cauchy-Riemann惩罚与输入导数图；通过精确原点锚定与边界坐标排除来强制结构恒等式；用锚定交互表示依赖变换。理论上在全纯对数假设下给出值/一阶导数同时逼近性，以及非零互协方差下仅坐标表示的混合导数下界；并用实轴导数闭式与顺序反向传播控制显存。

Result: 在相同NVIDIA H100 NVL上，30维HCN配置峰值显存约为NN4MGF的1/10，平均更新时间为1/9.7，按计划更新次数外推ratio为58.2；高维每次运行采样6400万基础输入，HCN在笔记本GPU上达到50维，阈值1–8的平均相对误差6.367%；同次数对比在主评价区间误差更低，2D Harrison非乘积基准为1.422% vs 6.684%；探索性10维相关算例验证了交互扩展。

Conclusion: HCN通过内嵌全纯结构显著提升RBM稳态尾计算的精度与效率，具备可扩展至高维的能力，并提供理论逼近与下界保障。

Abstract: Stationary tail computation for high-dimensional reflected Brownian motions (RBMs) remains computationally challenging. Building on NN4MGF's shared-coordinate basic-adjoint-relationship (BAR) framework, we develop Holomorphic Cauchy Networks (HCNs). Native complex-valued rational Cauchy subnetworks enforce holomorphicity on pole-free domains, removing sampled Cauchy-Riemann penalties and their input-derivative graphs. Exact origin anchoring and boundary-coordinate exclusion enforce structural identities, while anchored interactions represent dependent transforms. Under holomorphic-log assumptions, we establish simultaneous value and first-derivative approximation for the constrained architectures and a mixed-derivative lower bound for coordinate-only representations under nonzero cross-covariance. Closed-form real-axis derivatives and sequential backpropagation further control memory. On the same NVIDIA H100 NVL, the tested 30D HCN configuration uses approximately tenfold less peak allocated memory and has 9.7-fold lower mean update time than NN4MGF; extrapolation to the respective scheduled update counts gives a projected full-schedule update-time ratio of 58.2. With 64 million sampled base inputs per high-dimensional run, HCN reaches 50 dimensions on a laptop GPU with 6.367% mean relative error over thresholds 1 through 8. Degree-matched comparisons yield lower reported mean relative errors over the primary evaluation ranges, including 1.422% versus 6.684% on the 2D Harrison non-product benchmark. An exploratory 10D correlated example illustrates the interaction extension.

</details>


### [271] [Learning from Points and Patches: A Pre-trained Hybrid Attention Transformer for Time Series Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36572)
*Peiwang Tang,Cheng HE,Yupeng Ye,Weitai Zhang,Qinghua Sun,Defu Lian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出通用时间序列预训练框架TimeHAT，以统一点-片段掩码策略（UPPMS）解决"学什么"，以混合注意力编码器（HAE）解决"怎么学"，在分类、长期预测、插补、异常检测四类任务及微调/少样本/零样本设置下取得有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web服务与互联系统产生的时间序列支撑用户活动分析、服务监控与资源管理等应用，但从异构时间序列中学习可迁移表示仍面临三大挑战：时序模式多样、序列长度可变、高质量标注稀缺。NLP与CV中预训练虽成功，但时间序列预训练需要针对时序数据定制的策略，需回答"学什么"与"怎么学"两个互补问题。

Method: 框架包含两部分：(1) UPPMS（Unified Point-Patch Masking Strategy）：在统一框架内整合点级与片段级监督，结合上下文重建与因果外推，兼顾细粒度时序变化与宏观时序模式；(2) HAE（Hybrid Attention Encoder）：浅层采用前缀约束的双向注意力，深层采用方向性混合注意力，在保留有效上下文交互的同时缓解秩退化（rank degeneration）问题。

Result: 在真实数据集与四类下游任务（分类、长期预测、插补、异常检测）上评估，覆盖微调、少样本与零样本迁移设置，在多样化时序分析任务中表现出有竞争力的性能；代码已开源。

Conclusion: TimeHAT作为通用时间序列预训练框架，通过UPPMS与HAE分别解决监督信号设计与注意力结构设计问题，验证了针对时序特性定制预训练策略的有效性与跨任务、跨数据集的迁移能力。

Abstract: Time-series data generated by Web services and connected systems support applications such as user activity analysis, service monitoring, and resource management. However, learning transferable representations from heterogeneous time series remains challenging due to diverse temporal patterns, variable sequence lengths, and limited high-quality annotations. Despite the success of pre-training in natural language processing and computer vision, effective time-series pre-training requires strategies tailored to temporal data.
  We propose TimeHAT (Hybrid Attention Transformer), a general-purpose pre-training framework for time-series analysis that addresses two complementary questions: what to learn and how to learn. For what to learn, we introduce a Unified Point-Patch Masking Strategy (UPPMS) that integrates point-level and patch-level supervision within a unified framework for contextual reconstruction and causal extrapolation, enabling the model to capture both fine-grained temporal variations and broader temporal patterns. For how to learn, we develop a Hybrid Attention Encoder (HAE) that combines prefix-constrained bidirectional attention in initial layers with directional hybrid attention in deeper layers, aiming to preserve effective contextual interactions while mitigating rank degeneration.
  We evaluate TimeHAT across real-world datasets and four downstream tasks: classification, long-term forecasting, imputation, and anomaly detection. Experiments cover fine-tuning, few-shot, and zero-shot transfer settings, demonstrating competitive performance across diverse time-series analysis tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/TangPeiwang/TimeHAT.

</details>


### [272] [Less is more: learning what to profile for GPU kernel optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36576)
*Yihan Wang,Peiyu Liu,Runyu Chen,Wei Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AutoProfiler：从优化反馈中学习确定性的profiling决策树，实现按kernel自适应的硬件信息采集；仅需一次LLM重写即可完成优化，在受限profiling预算下优于固定配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GPU kernel自动优化系统依赖预定义的profiling策略，把“采集哪些硬件信息”排除在优化过程之外；作者指出更多metric并非单调增益，且最优profiling信息因kernel而异，因此需要kernel-conditioned的自适应profiling。

Method: 理论分析表明在profiling效用异质时，按kernel条件选择的收益优于任何单一固定配置。据此提出反馈驱动的AutoProfiler：通过REWRITE与SPLIT操作迭代构建确定性profiling树，由LLM生成候选修改、以实测评估决定是否接受；树构建完成后可快速为任意kernel采集所需信息，使LLM rewriter只需调用一次。

Result: 在KernelBench上，于受限profiling预算条件下，AutoProfiler的kernel优化效果优于固定profiling配置。

Conclusion: 硬件profiling应从静态指标采集转向“profiling推理”，把profiling本身作为提升kernel优化的新维度。

Abstract: Large language models have recently shown strong potential for automatically optimizing GPU kernels, yet their effectiveness depends critically on the hardware information available to the kernel optimization model. Existing systems typically rely on predefined profiling strategies, leaving what to profile largely outside the optimization process. We show that effective profiling is not simply about collecting more information: increasing the number of profiling metrics does not monotonically improve kernel optimization, while the most useful profiling information varies across kernels. Our theoretical analysis further shows that, under such heterogeneous profiling utility, kernel-conditioned selection can outperform any single fixed profiling configuration. Motivated by this observation, we propose AutoProfiler, a feedback-driven framework for learning a deterministic profiling tree from optimization feedback. The tree is iteratively refined through REWRITE and SPLIT operations, with an LLM generating candidate modifications and empirical evaluation determining their acceptance. Once constructed, the tree quickly gathers the required profiling information for any kernel, allowing the LLM rewriter to be invoked only once. Experiments on KernelBench show that our approach improves kernel optimization over fixed profiling configurations under constrained profiling budgets. These results suggest that hardware profiling should evolve from static metric collection toward profiling reasoning, making profiling itself a new dimension for improving kernel optimization. The codes are available at https://github.com/Satissss/AutoProfiler.

</details>


### [273] [Recall or Relearn? A Mixture of In-Context Experts for Recurring Concept Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36585)
*Zhangkai Wu,Xu Zhang,Zhihong Cui,Yiqi Wang,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练学习器 MICE（Mixture of In-Context Experts），在概念回归时于"恢复存储行"与"重新学习"间做决策，用扰动检测分段、容量受限存储上下文，并以快/慢双层混合加权预测，在合成与真实数据流上取得最高平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）通过更新上下文中带标签行来适配 Web 数据流而无需重训练。当过去的概念在离开上下文后重新出现时，TFM 面临"召回还是重学"的决策：是恢复该概念已存储的行，还是用新标签重新学习。已有方法缺乏对上下文存储与回退机制的系统设计。

Method: MICE 在检测到的变化点处分段：当 TFM 在该段上的估计额外误差在容差内时，将闭合段合并入存储上下文，且受存储上下文容量上限约束。快层按各存储上下文与 FIFO 窗口在最近一批标签上的 log-loss 进行加权；慢层将快层预测与最近标签行的 FIFO 窗口预测混合，并给出对后者折扣半 Brier 遗憾的界。

Result: 理论：在纯存储上下文与间隔条件下，快层相对重学在期望准确率上获得存储上下文准确率与 TFM 学习曲线之间归一化正面积（差一个首批项）；慢层在每个时刻约束对 FIFO 窗口的折扣半 Brier 遗憾。实验：预先测得的学习曲线可预测召回增益的排序；在随机边界相位的网格流上优于 reset（漂移时清空上下文）；合并保留更少专家；固定分段下时间匹配快照池可与之持平；真实流上平均准确率在所有对比策略中最高。

Conclusion: MICE 以分段合并+容量约束+双时间尺度混合的免训练机制，为 TFM 的召回-重学权衡提供理论上可解释、实践中高效的解决方案，在合成与真实数据流上均优于重置与快照池基线。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are being applied to Web data streams such as network intrusion detection, where they adapt by updating the labelled rows of their context without retraining. When a past concept returns after leaving the context, a TFM faces a recall-or-relearn decision between restoring stored rows of the concept and relearning it from new labels. We propose MICE (Mixture of In-Context Experts), a training-free learner that cuts the stream into segments at detected changes. It merges a closed segment into a stored context when the TFM's estimated additional error on the segment is within a tolerance, under a capacity limit on stored contexts. A fast level weights the stored contexts and first-in-first-out (FIFO) windows by the log-loss of their predictions on the last labelled batch. We show that, with pure stored contexts and a margin condition, this fast level gains over relearning, in expected accuracy, the normalised positive area between the stored context's accuracy and the TFM's learning curve, up to a first-batch term. A slow level mixes the fast level's prediction with that of the FIFO window of the last labelled rows and bounds the discounted half-Brier regret of MICE against this window at every time. Learning curves measured beforehand predict the ordering of the observed recall gains. MICE outperforms reset, which empties the context at detected drifts, on grid streams with random boundary phases. Merging keeps fewer experts than pools that store every segment, and with fixed segmentation a time-matched snapshot pool matches MICE on the shifted grid. On real streams, MICE has the highest mean accuracy of all policies we compare.

</details>


### [274] [Efficient Quantization Training with Stochastic Rounding via Structured Subspace Randomness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36587)
*Zeyu Wang,Yiheng Duan,Tao Chen,Donghyun Koo,Sihan Liu,Wenbo Zhang,Chuan He,Liang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出结构化子空间随机舍入S3R及其误差校正S3R-EC，在共享随机阈值以降低向量单元开销的同时消除由此引入的舍入误差偏移，实现INT8训练加速且不损失收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准随机舍入(SR)为每个梯度元素独立采样阈值，而加速器在向量单元上生成随机数的吞吐远低于矩阵单元，逐元素采样会饱和向量单元，导致INT8+SR训练甚至慢于BF16。跨元素共享阈值虽可降低成本，但会强制同方向舍入并产生公共偏移，该偏移主要经激活梯度反向传播，早期层无法用自身局部舍入误差抵消，因此必须在误差产生的层处消除。

Method: 提出S3R：对上游梯度只量化一次，同时用于激活梯度与权重梯度两个矩阵乘，并在隐藏维度上对每个token共享单一阈值；配套S3R-EC在激活梯度与权重梯度中减去结构化平均舍入误差，且不改变优化器。

Result: LLM预训练中，未校正的阈值共享会损害收敛；S3R-EC消除该退化，验证损失与独立SR持平；在TPU v5p上使稠密LLM的完整INT8训练步相比BF16加速1.24x–1.32x，相比独立SR加速1.11x。

Conclusion: 通过结构化共享阈值并做显式误差补偿，可在保持SR无偏性与收敛质量的前提下显著降低随机数生成开销，实现INT8训练对BF16的实用加速。

Abstract: Low-precision training often relies on stochastic rounding (SR) to keep quantized gradients unbiased and prevent small updates from rounding to zero. Standard SR draws an independent random threshold for every gradient element. However, accelerators generate random numbers on vector units whose throughput lags far behind their matrix units. Drawing one threshold per element saturates the vector unit and can make INT8 training with SR slower than BF16 training. Sharing random thresholds across tensor elements removes this cost but forces those elements to round in the same direction and shifts their rounding errors by a common offset. We find that this offset degrades training primarily through the activation gradient, which propagates the error backward into earlier layers. Because earlier layers cannot cancel an incoming offset using their own local rounding errors, the offset must be removed at the layer where it originates. We propose Structured Subspace Stochastic Rounding (S3R), which quantizes each upstream gradient once for both the activation and weight gradient matrix multiplications and shares a single threshold per token across the hidden dimension. Its error correction, S3R-EC, subtracts the structured mean rounding error from the activation and weight gradients while leaving the optimizer unchanged. In LLM pre-training experiments, uncorrected threshold sharing degrades convergence, whereas S3R-EC eliminates this degradation and matches the validation loss of independent SR. Furthermore, S3R-EC accelerates full INT8 training steps of dense LLMs on TPU v5p by 1.24x to 1.32x over BF16 and by 1.11x over independent SR.

</details>


### [275] [Balanced State Subspaces for Mamba-2 State Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36617)
*Shang Tingyu,Cao Wenfei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于平衡截断的Mamba-2状态压缩后训练变换，配合HARP按层分配秩，在保持低困惑度增量的同时将状态维度减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mamba-2将全部上下文压入固定大小的循环状态，该状态主导解码的内存与带宽。现有压缩方法（量化状态值或剪枝状态坐标）在原生基底上逐通道独立打分。作者分析发现：能量近似秩一但集中于循环累积的偏置类方向，而输出实际读取的内容位于与状态坐标不对齐的低维子空间，因此逐坐标打分（即便输出感知）会遗漏决定输入–输出映射的方向。

Method: 指出压缩目标应是写–读子空间而非单个坐标；提出一种后训练变换，以完整可控性/可观性Gramian实现平衡截断，并借助Mamba-2的标量恒等转移精确施加旋转；进一步提出HARP，依据Hankel谱为各层分配秩并保护检索敏感层。校准仅需单次前向传播。

Result: 校准开销比GHOST已发布协议快一个数量级且峰值内存更低。配合HARP，在130M–2.7B规模上平均WikiText-2困惑度仅上升0.3点（1.8%）即把状态维度减半，而GHOST为1.6点（9.3%）；在25%保留率下差距进一步扩大，检索性能也优于统一预算。

Conclusion: 面向写–读子空间的子空间级压缩显著优于逐坐标方法，平衡截断加分层秩分配可在低预算下兼顾困惑度与检索，且校准成本低。

Abstract: Mamba-2 compresses all context into a fixed-size recurrent state that dominates decoding memory and bandwidth. Existing compressors quantize state values or prune state coordinates, scoring each channel independently in the native basis. We examine trained Mamba-2 states and find that energy is almost rank-one, but the output does not read the energetic directions: energy concentrates in a bias-like direction accumulated by the recurrence, while the content the output reads lives in a low-dimensional subspace that is not aligned with the state's coordinates. Even output-aware scores are computed coordinate by coordinate, so they miss the directions that determine the input--output map. Compression should therefore target the write--read subspace rather than individual coordinates. We propose \method{}, a post-training transform that instantiates balanced truncation with full controllability and observability Gramians and applies the rotation exactly via Mamba-2's scalar-identity transition. Because the useful rank varies widely across layers, we further introduce HARP, which allocates ranks per layer from the Hankel spectrum and protects retrieval-sensitive layers, improving both perplexity and retrieval over uniform budgets. Calibration takes a single forward pass, an order of magnitude faster than GHOST's released protocol, with lower peak memory. With HARP, \method{} halves the state dimension at an average WikiText-2 perplexity increase of $0.3$ points ($1.8\%$) across 130M--2.7B, versus $1.6$ ($9.3\%$) for GHOST, and the gap widens at 25\% retention.

</details>


### [276] [Dream-COP: Guiding Algorithm Discovery for Combinatorial Optimization Problems in an Experience World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36618)
*Kuan Xu,Jianming Wang,Ni Zhang,Yaoxin Wu,Yong Wang,Zhiguang Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Dream-COP利用历史搜索轨迹构成的"经验世界"进行策略回放（dreaming），训练策略智能体以指导算法发现智能体的程序生成与精炼，从而在有限预算下更高效地为组合优化问题发现更优算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可通过迭代程序生成与评估实现组合优化问题的算法发现，但在有限预算内如何组织搜索以发现更优算法是核心挑战。作者洞察到：历史搜索轨迹及其记录结果构成一个"经验世界"，可通过回放利用来促进COP求解。

Method: 提出Dream-COP框架，包含策略智能体（policy agent）与发现智能体（discovery agent）。策略智能体在经验世界中通过"dreaming"回放学习可执行策略，用于引导发现智能体生成与精炼COP程序；策略回放基于所揭示程序的质量与所用搜索步骤提供反馈，从而更有效地指导策略选择。

Result: 在五类COP上，Dream在启发式部件设计与完整求解器生成两方面均优于固定探索策略；在KP上匹配最优值，将OBPP的差距从2.112%降至1.199%，同时减少42.5%的搜索请求。

Conclusion: 基于经验世界的回放式策略学习能显著提升LLM驱动算法发现的效率与效果，且学到的探索策略在经验世界辅助下可有效跨COP迁移。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable algorithm discovery for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) through iterative program generation and evaluation. A central challenge is how to organize search to discover better algorithms within a limited budget. Our key insight is that past search trajectories and their recorded outcomes form an experience world, which can be used to facilitate the COP solving through replay. We introduce Dream-COP, in which a \emph{policy agent} learns executable policies through \emph{dreaming} in this experience world to guide a \emph{discovery agent} in generating and refining COP programs. Specifically, policy replay provides feedback on the quality of the programs revealed and the search steps used, to guide policy selection more effectively. Across five COPs, \textsc{Dream} discovers better algorithms than fixed exploration in both heuristic component design and complete solver generation. Particularly, it matches the optimal values on KP and reduces the gap on OBPP from 2.112\% to 1.199\% while using 42.5\% fewer search requests. Moreover, the learned exploration policies transfer effectively across different COPs with the assitance of the experience world.

</details>


### [277] [The Batch Size Can Be One: Test-Time Adaptation from Classifier Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36628)
*Jaeho Hwang,Yujin Oh,Juhyeon Shin,Juhye Lee,Sungroh Yoon,Uiwon Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 OriTTA：用源模型构建固定的几何目标（原点、类轴、理想点），在无标签单样本流上把选中特征朝预测类轴对齐并惩罚过大半径，配合按预测类保存一个样本的记忆与崩塌检测重置，实现免调参的测试时自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际测试流常逐样本到达且类别顺序无规律：单样本信息不足以估计分布级统计量，基于置信度的样本选择会引入"高置信但错误"的预测。观察到损坏只平移特征而冻结分类器的决策区域不变，因此可利用源模型的稳定几何结构作为自适应目标。

Method: 1) 重设原点：在特征空间中各类朝共同方向倾斜，选取新原点使类分数更接近，并保持其靠近每类一个合成原型的均值特征；由此各类原型方向分布更均匀，测试前即为每类确定一条类轴与一个理想点。2) 自适应：将选中特征与预测类轴对齐，并惩罚过大半径（半径约束）。3) 记忆：每个预测类保留一个输入样本，限制流中缺失类的特征漂移。4) 重置：对记忆样本重分类，若显示崩塌则重置模型。

Result: 无需针对各设置调参，在 CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C、ImageNet-C 上、batch size 为 1 时，于 4 种骨干网络×2 种协议×2 种流顺序共 16 种组合中均取得最高平均准确率。ImageNet-C fog 上近期方法在 100 次运行中最多有三分之二出现崩塌，OriTTA 从未崩塌。

Conclusion: 以源模型导出的固定几何目标替代分布统计估计，可在单样本、乱序流下稳健地进行测试时自适应，兼具精度优势与抗崩塌稳定性，且无需逐设置调参。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation updates a deployed model on an unlabeled test stream. In practice this stream often arrives one sample at a time, with the classes in no particular order. A single sample then provides limited information for estimating distribution-level statistics, and selecting samples by confidence can admit predictions that are wrong yet confident. A corruption, however, shifts the features while leaving the decision regions of the frozen classifier unchanged. We therefore propose Origin-recentered Test-Time Adaptation (OriTTA), which constructs fixed geometric targets from the source model and adapts selected features toward them. Seen from the origin of the feature space, the classes lean toward a common direction. We choose a new origin to bring class scores closer together while keeping it near the mean feature of one synthetic prototype per class. From this origin, prototype directions spread more evenly, and each class obtains an axis and an ideal point before any test data arrives. During adaptation, OriTTA aligns selected features with their predicted class axis and penalizes excessive radius, keeps one input per predicted class in memory to limit feature changes for classes absent from the stream, and resets the model when re-classifying this memory reveals collapse. Without tuning for each setting, OriTTA achieves the highest mean accuracy at batch size 1 on CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C and ImageNet-C in all sixteen combinations of four backbones, two protocols and two stream orders. On ImageNet-C fog, recent methods collapse in up to two thirds of one hundred runs, while OriTTA never does.

</details>


### [278] [Deep Bayesian Approaches for Interpretable Nonlinear Structural System Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36633)
*Wei Liu,Konstantinos Vlachas,Eleni Chatzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该教程系统介绍深度贝叶斯滤波用于非线性结构系统辨识，以Deep Markov Model为数据驱动基线，对比物理引导的PgDMM与Neural EKF两类互补方法，并在含Bouc-Wen迟滞连接的三维剪切框架基准上考察动态状态估计及状态-参数联合估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯滤波依赖预先给定的转移与观测模型，难以应对未知动力学；而工程诊断、预测与决策又需要兼具物理结构与不确定性量化的数据驱动辨识方法，故需系统梳理深度贝叶斯滤波的建模范式与实用要点。

Method: 教程聚焦学习动力学、物理归纳偏置与后验推断三者的交互：Deep Markov Model作为数据驱动参照；Physics-guided Deep Markov Model采用摊销变分推断嵌入物理结构；Neural Extended Kalman Filter采用可微分卡尔曼滤波。三者在三维剪切框架（迟滞Bouc-Wen连接、稀疏加速度测量）上开展动态状态估计与状态-参数联合估计对比实验。

Result: 结果揭示了以测量为条件的重构与开环预测之间的本质差异；表明物理结构可提升潜状态可解释性，但并不必然保证预测精度；并显示各方法在响应估计与参数估计鲁棒性上的差异。

Conclusion: 论文给出模型构建、训练、评估与部署的实用指南，并展望不确定性校准、可辨识性及真实场景验证等剩余挑战。

Abstract: System identification, namely the inference of mathematical representations of dynamical systems from measured data, is fundamental to engineering diagnostics, prognostics, and decision-making. Bayesian filtering offers a principled framework for probabilistic state estimation but traditionally relies on prescribed transition and observation models. Recent advances in deep Bayesian filtering address this limitation by embedding learnable representations within probabilistic state-space formulations, enabling data-driven identification of unknown dynamics while retaining physical structure and uncertainty-aware inference.
  This tutorial provides a systematic introduction to deep Bayesian filtering for nonlinear structural system identification, focusing on the interplay between learned dynamics, physical inductive biases, and posterior inference. The Deep Markov Model serves as a data-driven reference, while the Physics-guided Deep Markov Model (PgDMM) and Neural Extended Kalman Filter (Neural EKF) illustrate complementary approaches based on amortized variational inference and differentiable Kalman filtering, respectively. Their capabilities are examined through dynamic state estimation and joint dynamic state and parameter estimation on a three-dimensional shear-frame benchmark with hysteretic Bouc-Wen connections and sparse acceleration measurements. The results highlight important distinctions between measurement-conditioned reconstruction and open-loop forecasting, demonstrate how physical structure can improve latent-state interpretability without necessarily ensuring predictive fidelity, and reveal differences in the robustness of response and parameter estimation. Practical guidelines for model construction, training, evaluation, and deployment are provided, together with an outlook on remaining challenges in uncertainty calibration, identifiability, and real-world validation.

</details>


### [279] [When Does Perturbation Consistency Add Information Beyond Softmax Confidence? Theory and Evidence for the Decision Consistency Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36640)
*Amit Kalitaa,Moirangthem Tiken Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出决策一致性框架（DCF），用标签稳定性与置信度偏差构造一致性评分，系统检验其在干净数据、噪声与对抗扰动下相对softmax置信度的信息增益，并给出标签翻转的理论界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扰动一致性分数常被用来判断预测是否稳健，但尚不清楚它是否提供了干净softmax输出之外的额外信息，以及其计算代价是否值得。作者希望明确一致性评分的适用边界与失效条件。

Method: DCF在六种轻度算子下对每张图像计算标签稳定性（LS）与置信度偏差（CD），合成一致性分数（CS），并用准确率与平均一致性之差（CAG）概括模型；共进行201组评估、每组3个种子。理论分析推导标签翻转所需的logit margin上界（≤√2倍logit位移），并据此构造无标签的split-conformal无翻转证书；在CIFAR-10-C噪声与PGD攻击（2/255预算，预先设定）下与MSP、margin对比。

Result: CS在所有模型族上检测干净数据误分类的能力均弱于MSP；冻结CNN上AUROC低0.057（95% CI 0.043–0.073），计算量高8–15倍。固定margin时，位移对错误的预测AUROC仅0.515；无翻转证书在84次运行中从未被违反。噪声腐蚀下CS优于margin，PGD下CS区分干净与受攻击输入的AUROC为0.83，而MSP为0.37。噪声下的增益未能迁移到未见过的分布偏移族。OCTMNIST上大幅负CAG在全微调与域内训练下依然存在，纠正类别先验可回收约40%的差距。

Conclusion: 一致性评分并非干净置信度的替代品，而是一种补充分数：它在置信度被误导（噪声腐蚀、对抗攻击）时提供额外信息，但代价高、不能泛化到未见偏移，且部分模型级一致性差距源于类别先验。logit-margin不等式同时给出可用的无标签无翻转证书。

Abstract: Perturbation consistency scores judge whether a prediction survives small input changes. The Decision Consistency Framework (DCF) scores each image by label stability (LS) and confidence deviation (CD) under six mild operators, combines them into a consistency score (CS), and summarises a model by the gap between accuracy and mean consistency (CAG). We ask when these scores carry information that the clean softmax output lacks. Across 201 evaluations with three seeds per configuration, CS detected misclassifications on clean data less well than the maximum softmax probability (MSP) in every model family. For frozen CNNs, the deficit was 0.057 in area under the ROC curve (AUROC; 95% CI 0.043 to 0.073), at 8 to 15 times the compute. A label flip requires the logit margin to be at most the square root of two times the logit displacement, and at a fixed margin, the displacement predicted errors at AUROC 0.515. The same inequality gives a label-free split-conformal no-flip certificate, never violated in 84 runs. Consistency did add information where confidence is misled: under noise corruptions of CIFAR-10-C, it beat the margin, and under projected gradient attacks, it separated clean from attacked inputs with AUROC 0.83 against 0.37 for MSP at a budget of 2/255, as pre-specified. The gain under noise did not transfer to unseen shift families. The large negative CAG on OCTMNIST persists under full fine-tuning and in-domain training and is partly a class-prior effect: correcting the prior recovers about 40% of the gap.

</details>


### [280] [When Is a Cheap Fairness Edit Safe? Screening Post-Hoc Edits in Two-Sided Matching Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36649)
*Moirangthem Tiken Singha,Rabinder Kumar Prasada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在推理阶段用闭式线性投影器降低受保护属性影响的两边匹配系统，并给出福利变化的理论界与部署前筛查框架（PASS/KILL/OUT-OF-SCOPE）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两边匹配系统（如招生管道）联合分配机会；降低受保护属性影响通常需重训练编码器，作者希望在推理阶段以闭式投影完成编辑，并判断编辑的福利影响是否可控、何时可被允许。

Method: 构建闭式线性投影器在推理时编辑表征；针对编辑前后保持垂直序的市场，用编辑诱导的吸引力偏移加显式余项界定平均福利变化；提出概率化改进，以数据依赖的偏差项替代最坏情形常数；设计预部署筛查，结合垂直性检验与福利扫描，输出PASS/KILL/OUT-OF-SCOPE；区分精确层级（所有机会按吸引力排序申请人）与分级层级（容许近垂直市场）。

Result: 30个留出合成市场上筛查与所有预设判定一致，无误报PASS；60个精确垂直市场上无界被违反，概率界在69%–87%配置中有信息量；三个真实市场的2700个配置（未达精确层级）无任何插入式界表达式被违反；闭式因子化在90%–100%实例中处于分级范围，而two-tower与图神经网络编码器在所有实例中均落在范围外。

Conclusion: 事后编辑是否可采纳受编码器架构选择影响：闭式因子化结构较易满足分级适用范围，two-tower与GNN编码器则不适配；该筛查为部署前的可采纳性判定提供了可操作工具。

Abstract: Two-sided matching systems, such as admissions pipelines, allocate opportunities jointly. Reducing a protected at tribute's influence usually requires encoder retraining. We study a closed-form linear projector that does this at inference time. For markets that stay vertically ordered before and after the edit, we bound the mean welfare change by the edit-induced appeal shift and an explicit remainder. A probabilistic refinement replaces worst-case constants with a data-dependent deviation term. A pre-deployment screen combines a verticality test with a welfare sweep and returns PASS, KILL, or OUT-OF-SCOPE. An exact tier requires every opportunity to rank applicants by appeal, and a graded tier admits near-vertical markets. On 30 held-out synthetic markets, the screen agrees with every pre-specified regime verdict, with no observed false PASS. On 60 exactly vertical markets, no bound is violated, and the probabilistic bound is informative in 69% to 87% of configurations. On 2700 configurations from three realistic markets, which do not reach the exact tier, no plug-in bound expression is violated. A closed-form factorization stays within graded scope in 90% to 100% of instances, whereas two-tower and graph neural network encoders fall outside it in every instance. Architecture choice thus appears to affect whether a post-hoc edit is admissible.

</details>


### [281] [TACO-Graph: Automated Construction of Text-Atributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36650)
*Amiri Hayes,Kristina Wicke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TACO-Graph，用决策树学习"如何从表格数据构建文本属性图"这一选择，快速代理评分后在未见样本上预测构图质量（节点分类 Spearman ρ>0.9，GraphRAG 检索 ρ>0.8），并开源实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本数据的图结构表示已广泛使用，但缺乏系统性方法决定哪些实体作节点、哪些关系作边、节点携带何种文本；这些构图选择显著影响下游性能，通常依赖专家知识或人工试错。

Method: 面向多属性表格数据构建的文本属性图（TAG）：枚举所有合法的 TAG 表示；在小规模代表性子集上做快速代理评估并为每种构图打分；以这些分数训练可解释决策树，从而将构图选择映射到预期质量。

Result: 在引文网络、产品评论、文献关系等五个数据集上，决策树在独立抽取的评估样本上预测构图质量，节点分类平均 Spearman ρ>0.9，GraphRAG 检索 ρ>0.8；并能系统识别在 GNN 与 GraphRAG 任务上表现更优的构图方式。

Conclusion: TACO-Graph 提供了系统化、可解释的表格数据到文本属性图转换指南，并以开源库形式发布以支持新任务与新数据集的评估。

Abstract: Graph-structured representations of text data have become foundational across machine learning, yet it remains unclear how to systematically construct a graph from a given dataset for a target task. Choices about which entities become nodes, which relationships become edges, and what text each node contains can substantially affect downstream performance. In practice, finding optimal constructions often requires expert knowledge or manual trial and error. We introduce TACO-Graph, a decision tree framework for learning which graph construction choices are most effective for a given dataset and task. Specifically, we focus on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) constructed from multi-attribute tabular data. TACO-Graph enumerates valid TAG representations, scores each using fast proxy evaluation on small representative subsets, and trains an interpretable decision tree on those scores. Across five datasets spanning citation networks, product reviews, and bibliographic relationships, our decision trees predict construction quality on separately drawn evaluation samples with mean Spearman $ρ$ above $0.9$ for node classification and above $0.8$ for GraphRAG retrieval. Our trees systematically identify which constructions perform better across both GNN and GraphRAG tasks, and the full pipeline is released as an open-source library to support evaluation on new tasks and datasets at https://github.com/AmiriHayes/text_attributed_graphs. TACO-Graph provides a systematic and interpretable guide for determining how to convert tabular data to text-attributed graphs for downstream tasks.

</details>


### [282] [Log-Derivative Trick for Parametric Markov Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36655)
*Arthur Gall,Ichiro Hasuo,Thomas Seiller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于测度论推广的对数导数技巧（log-derivative trick）的可扩展蒙特卡洛梯度估计器，用于参数化马尔可夫链（pMC）中期望奖励与可达概率的优化；该方法仅在采样轨迹上操作、无需全局状态空间物化和线性系统求解，可在几乎必然终止与正则条件下给出无偏梯度估计，并自然扩展到连续及一般σ-有限状态空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: pMC中期望奖励与可达概率的优化是含环概率系统分析与综合的核心任务。传统符号化综合方法（如parameter lifting、有理函数生成）面临可扩展性瓶颈；现有基于梯度的技术虽为有效替代，但仍依赖在全局状态空间上求解大规模线性系统等符号化梯度计算，继承了可扩展性限制；有限时域近似虽可行却引入不可控偏差。作者因此希望获得一种既无偏又可扩展的梯度估计手段。

Method: 核心是基于测度论推广的对数导数技巧构造蒙特卡洛梯度估计器。估计器完全沿采样轨迹计算，仅需对局部转移概率（或密度）及其导数做黑盒评估，从而避免全局状态空间的物化与线性系统求解。理论上，在几乎必然终止及标准正则性条件下证明该估计器具有无偏性。由于采用测度论框架，方法不再受限于有限离散系统，可直接处理连续与一般σ-有限状态空间。

Result: 在合成离散pMC与连续状态案例上进行了实证评估：方法可扩展到远超现有求解器能力的状态空间规模，显著缩短执行时间，且不引入偏差。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，沿轨迹的、基于测度的蒙特卡洛梯度估计为pMC优化提供了可扩展且无偏的新范式：它摆脱了全局状态空间物化与线性系统求解的依赖，仅需局部黑盒导数信息，并将适用域从有限离散系统拓展至连续与σ-有限状态空间。

Abstract: Optimizing expected rewards and reachability probabilities in parametric Markov chains (pMCs) is central to the analysis and synthesis of probabilistic systems with loops. While traditional symbolic synthesis approaches--such as parameter lifting and rational function generation--suffer from scalability bottlenecks, gradient-based optimization emerges as an effective alternative. However, existing gradient-based techniques still rely on symbolic gradient computation--such as solving large linear systems--over the global state space, inheriting scalability limits. Finite-horizon approximation is possible but introduces uncontrollable bias.
  In this paper, we introduce a scalable Monte Carlo gradient estimator based on a measure-theoretic generalization of the log-derivative trick. We prove that our estimator provides unbiased gradient estimates under almost-sure termination and standard regularity conditions. Crucially, our method avoids global state-space materialization and linear system solving entirely: it operates purely along sampled trajectories, requiring only black-box evaluations of local transition probabilities (or densities) and their derivatives. Unlike existing pMC techniques that are fundamentally restricted to finite discrete systems, our measure-theoretic framework naturally extends to continuous and general $σ$-finite state spaces. Empirical evaluations on synthetic discrete pMCs and continuous-state case studies demonstrate that our method scales to state spaces far beyond the reach of existing solvers, significantly reducing execution time without introducing bias.

</details>


### [283] [HeteGCD: Statistics-Aware Dual-Prototype Learning for Generalized Category Discovery on Heterophilous Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36696)
*Xuanzhi Xi,Tongze Zhang,Zhili Qin,Yulin Tao,Hongliang Wang,Zhong Zhang,Qinli Yang,Junming Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对异质图上的广义类别发现（GCD），提出HeteGCD，从局部属性差异统计与邻域类别分布两个角度进行双原型学习，在特征空间与概率空间同时挖掘判别信息，无需新类监督即可实现类别发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实图常为异质图（相连节点属性不同或类别不同），而现有图GCD方法依赖同质性归纳偏置，难以适用；现有异质图学习方法在选择与融合邻域信号时依赖覆盖所有类别（包括GCD中标签缺失的新类）的监督信号，因此核心问题是如何在无新类监督下有效利用异质邻域信息进行类别发现。

Method: 提出统计感知的双原型学习框架HeteGCD：(1) 门控双流编码器，同时建模节点属性与局部属性差异统计，学习有信息量的节点表示；(2) 双原型分类器，融合基于特征的相似度与基于分布的类别分布一致性来支持类别发现。

Result: 在五个异质图数据集上，与24种基线组合相比，HeteGCD取得具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 通过同时利用局部属性差异统计与邻域类别分布，在特征空间和概率空间联合建模，可在不依赖新类监督的情况下有效利用异质邻域信息，为异质图上的广义类别发现提供了新的双原型学习视角。

Abstract: Heterophilous graphs are prevalent in real-world applications, where connected nodes often exhibit dissimilar attributes or belong to different classes, posing significant challenges to conventional graph learning methods based on homophily. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced in generalized category discovery (GCD), which requires models to recognize known classes and discover novel ones using labels from known classes only. However, existing graph GCD methods typically rely on aforementioned homophily-based inductive biases, which are ill-suited to heterophilous graphs. Meanwhile, although current heterophilous graph learning methods exploit diverse neighborhood signals, their selection and fusion are often guided by supervision across all classes, including novel classes whose labels are unavailable in GCD. These limitations raise a key question: how can heterogeneous neighborhood information be effectively leveraged for category discovery without any novel-class supervision? To answer this question, in this study we propose HeteGCD, a new statistics-aware dual-prototype learning perspective for generalized category discovery on heterophilous graphs. The key idea is to examine both statistics of local attribute differences and neighborhood class distribution to extract discriminative information in feature and probability spaces simultaneously. Specifically, a gated dual-stream encoder integrates both node attributes and local attribute-difference statistics to learn informative node representations. Afterwards, a dual-prototype classifier combines feature-based similarity with distribution-based consistency to support category discovery. Experiments on five heterophilous graphs show that HeteGCD achieves competitive performance against 24 baseline combinations.

</details>


### [284] [RankFormer: Rethinking Time Series Transformers through Representation Capacity Analysis and Progressive Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36703)
*Peiwang Tang,Cheng HE,Xijie Liang,Defu Lian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出RankFormer，一种面向多变量时间序列预测的编码器-解码器架构，并建立基于秩（rank）的分析框架来解释时间序列Transformer的表达能力来源，据此设计秩增强编码器（Hourglass Attention）与交互式渐进解码器（IPD）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer类模型在Web与信息物理系统的大规模时序预测中经验表现良好，但其表示能力的理论机制尚不清楚；同时许多模型采用通道独立建模与直接投影头等简化解码策略，难以刻画复杂的多变量动态。

Method: 1）构建基于秩的分析框架，考察tokenization、embedding与attention设计如何影响时序Transformer的表示容量；2）据此提出秩增强编码器，采用Hourglass Attention提升信息交互中的秩稳定性；3）提出Interactive Progressive Decoder（IPD），通过全局引导的跨通道交互与渐进式精化改进未来轨迹建模。

Result: 基于秩的分析表明：patchification通过将多个时间观测聚合到单个token中提升了潜在表示容量，而后续编码操作决定这一容量被实际实现的程度。在真实世界长期预测基准上的大量实验显示，RankFormer相较当前最优方法取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: RankFormer通过秩视角的理论分析与相应架构设计，打破通道独立与直接投影解码的局限，验证了秩增强编码与跨通道渐进解码在多变量长期预测中的有效性。

Abstract: Multivariate time series forecasting plays a critical role in Web and cyber-physical systems, where large-scale services and IoT infrastructures generate complex temporal data. Transformer-based models have achieved strong empirical performance in this domain, yet the principles governing the expressive capacity of their learned representations remain insufficiently understood. Moreover, many existing models rely on simplified decoding strategies, including channel-independent modeling and direct projection heads, which limit their ability to capture complex multivariate dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose RankFormer, a novel encoder-decoder architecture for multivariate time series forecasting. We establish a rank-based analysis framework to investigate how tokenization, embedding, and attention designs affect the representation capacity of time series Transformers. Our analysis reveals that patchification increases the potential representation capacity by aggregating multiple temporal observations into each token, while subsequent encoding operations determine how much of this capacity is realized. Guided by these insights, we develop a rank-enhancing encoder with Hourglass Attention to improve rank stability during information interaction. Furthermore, we introduce the Interactive Progressive Decoder (IPD), which improves future trajectory modeling through global-guided cross-channel interaction and progressive refinement. Extensive experiments on real-world long-term forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that RankFormer achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art methods. Code repository: https://github.com/TangPeiwang/Rankformer.

</details>


### [285] [Select-TTT: Query-Conditioned Selective Fast Weight Updates for In-Place Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36794)
*Yue Wu,Yang Zhang,Weinan Gan,Chongming Gao,Xinsen Guo,Xiaoyuan Li,Fuli Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Select-TTT：用查询条件化规则按相关性调节In-Place TTT各chunk的写入强度，无需监督与新参数，在长上下文QA上稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: In-Place TTT在真实网页长上下文问答中收益基本消失。作者归因于其均匀写入调度：每个chunk以相同强度写入，无关内容稀释了快权重记忆中与查询相关的信息。

Method: 模型无关、查询条件化的In-Place TTT写入规则。相关性信号无需监督、不引入新参数，直接取自模型冻结输出头，以chunk隐状态分配给查询token的概率质量衡量；经温度缩放softmax转为学习率乘子，保留原有的chunk级上下文并行计算。

Result: 在两个长上下文问答基准与两个骨干模型上均取得一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 查询条件化的快权重写入对实用化长上下文QA的测试时训练有价值，并有望用于涉及多次用户查询、上下文持续演化的长程智能体任务。

Abstract: Test-time training (TTT) enables a deployed language model to internalize incoming context on-the-fly into a small set of fast-weight parameters, rather than merely treating it as transient context for attention. In-Place TTT recently made this idea practical for large language models by repurposing the down-projection of standard MLP blocks as fast weights. However, we find that its benefit largely disappears on realistic web long-context question answering. We attribute this to In-Place TTT's uniform write schedule: every chunk is written with equal strength, so irrelevant content dilutes query-relevant information in fast-weight memory. Building on this insight, we propose Select-TTT, a model-agnostic, query-conditioned rule for In-Place TTT that scales each chunk's write strength by its relevance to the user query. This relevance signal requires no supervision and no new parameters: it is read directly from the model's frozen output head, as the probability mass that a chunk's hidden states assign to the query tokens. A temperature-scaled softmax turns these scores into learning-rate multipliers, leaving the chunk-wise, context-parallel computation of In-Place TTT intact. Select-TTT consistently improves long-context question answering on two benchmarks and two backbones. These findings highlight the value of query-conditioned fast weight writes for practical test-time training on long-context question answering, which is also potentially promising for long-horizon agent tasks involving multiple user queries over evolving contexts.

</details>


### [286] [Conservative Dueling Bandits: Preference Learning under Baseline Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36708)
*Rohan Deb,Mohammad Ghavamzadeh,Arindam Banerjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究保守型上下文对决老虎机（conservative contextual dueling bandits），提出需保证每轮更优展示项的累计得分不低于可信基线得分的 (1-α) 比例。作者证明直接套用 CLUCB 的安全检验会导致线性遗憾，进而提出 MaxInP-BC（线性效用）与 BTIGW-BC（一般效用类）两个算法，在全程高概率安全的前提下实现次线性遗憾，且保守性带来的附加代价不随horizon增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对决反馈（pairwise comparisons）正是从人类偏好微调语言模型所用的信号，但标准上下文对决老虎机算法探索过于激进，可能向用户同时展示两个差选项。作者希望在保留学习能力的同时，引入仅依赖效用差（无需绝对奖励）的保守性约束，并重新审视这种约束下安全认证的方式——因为直接沿用现有保守算法 CLUCB 的安全检验并不可靠。

Method: 1）给出安全问题实例：证明将 CLUCB 的安全检验原样迁移到对决场景，即使基线效用已知精确，也会产生线性遗憾。2）线性效用下提出 MaxInP-BC：通过效用差（utility gaps）认证得分；当必须回退时，将基线与一个信息量大的对手配对，使回退轮仍能驱动学习。3）一般效用类下提出 BTIGW-BC：把在线逻辑回归 oracle 的保证转化为累计安全证书。

Result: MaxInP-BC 在所有时刻以高概率保持安全，遗憾为 Õ(d√T/κ) 加上一个不随horizon增长的保守性附加代价。BTIGW-BC 全程安全、回退次数有限，只要 oracle 的逻辑遗憾为次线性，其遗憾亦为次线性。实验中两个算法均满足约束（无约束对照算法常违反），遗憾代价适中。

Conclusion: 在上下文对决老虎机中实现保守性需要专门的安全认证机制，不能直接复用基于绝对奖励的检验；以效用差认证得分、并让回退轮兼具信息性，可在几乎不损失遗憾的前提下获得全程安全保证，为基于成对偏好反馈的谨慎式学习提供了理论与实证基础。

Abstract: Contextual dueling bandits learn from pairwise comparisons, the same feedback used to fine-tune language models from human preferences. Standard algorithms explore aggressively and can show users two poor options. We study conservative contextual dueling bandits, which require that, at every round, the cumulative score of the better displayed item stay above a $(1-α)$ fraction of a trusted baseline's. An item's score is its probability of beating the best available item, so the constraint depends only on utility differences and needs no absolute rewards. This also changes how safety can be certified: we show that transferring the safety test of the conservative bandit algorithm CLUCB unchanged can incur linear regret, even when the baseline's utilities are known exactly. For linear utilities, we develop MaxInP-BC, which certifies scores through utility gaps and, when it must fall back, pairs the baseline with an informative partner so that fallback rounds still drive learning. It is safe with high probability at all times, with regret $\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{T}/κ)$ plus an additive cost of conservatism that does not grow with the horizon. For general utility classes, we develop BTIGW-BC, which turns the guarantee of an online logistic-regression oracle into cumulative safety certificates. It is safe at all times, makes finitely many fallbacks, and has sublinear regret whenever the oracle's logistic regret is sublinear. In experiments, both satisfy the constraint, which their unconstrained counterparts often violate, at a moderate cost in regret.

</details>


### [287] [API-TAIL: Detecting Model Substitution in LLM APIs through Temperature-Aligned Likelihood Tails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36801)
*Haocheng Mei,Yuchuan Tian,Ye Yuan,Chao Xu,Allen Chen,Kai Han,Yunhe Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出API-TAIL，一种典型性审计方法，通过在批次级对齐有效温度吸收合法解码/服务配置带来的分布偏移，再基于尾部异常响应数量阈值检测商业LLM API的"部分替换"行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商业语言模型API仅返回文本，提供商可通过将部分用户请求悄悄路由到更便宜的替代模型、却按宣称模型计费来降低成本。检测此类部分替换的难点在于：诚实提供商也会通过未公开的解码与服务选择（温度缩放、采样截断、重复与存在惩罚、默认系统提示）改变输出分布，因此审计需针对"合法配置构成的复合零假设"而非单一参考模型进行检验。

Method: 核心洞察：合法变化主要造成全批次范围内响应典型性的整体平移，而部分替换则注入在宣称模型下仍显异常的单个响应。据此设计API-TAIL典型性审计：(1) 批次级对齐——拟合单一有效温度，使标准化惊奇度（surprisal）分数在受审批次上居中，从而吸收整体平移；(2) 尾部检验——若残余尾部响应数量超过在多种合法配置下校准的阈值，则判定该端点存在问题。

Result: 在真实商业API上评估：API-TAIL在不同诚实提供商下能可靠控制误报率，且在小查询预算下即可检测出低比例部分替换，显著优于在相同复合校准下丧失检测能力的现有基于秩（rank）和MMD的审计方法。

Conclusion: API-TAIL通过区分"批次级典型性平移"与"个体级异常注入"，在复合零假设下实现了对商业LLM API部分模型替换的有效审计，兼顾低误报控制与高检测灵敏度，为黑盒API的可信度验证提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Commercial language model APIs return only text, allowing a provider to cut costs by quietly routing a fraction of user requests to a cheaper substitute model while billing for the advertised one. Detecting such partial substitution is challenging because honest providers also alter the output distribution through undocumented decoding and serving choices, such as temperature scaling, sampling truncation, repetition and presence penalties, and default system prompts, forcing an audit to test against a composite null of legitimate configurations rather than a single reference. Our key insight is that these legitimate variations primarily shift response typicality across the entire batch, whereas partial substitution injects individual responses that remain anomalous under the claimed model. Building on this, we introduce API-TAIL, a typicality audit that first absorbs batch-level shifts by aligning a single effective temperature to center standardized surprisal scores across the audited batch, and then flags the endpoint if the number of remaining tail responses exceeds a threshold calibrated across legitimate configurations. Evaluated on real-world commercial APIs, API-TAIL reliably controls false alarms across diverse honest providers while detecting even low-rate partial substitution with a small query budget, substantially outperforming existing rank- and MMD-based audits that lose detection power under the same composite calibration.

</details>


### [288] [Nonlinear Direct Feedback Alignment for Scalable Backpropagation-Free Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36718)
*Wu Lin,Yan Fan,Chenxiang Ma,Yinglan Feng,Jia Wang,Ka-Chun Wong,Qiuzhen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出非线性直接反馈对齐（NDFA），用轻量非线性代理子网络构建各隐层反馈，并设计代理网络更新策略，在保持并行训练的同时显著缩小与BP的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BP生物不可解释且存在反向锁定，限制层间并行；DFA虽用固定反馈矩阵直接传播全局误差，但固定矩阵难以刻画从隐表示到输出的非线性变换，导致与BP仍有明显性能差距。

Method: NDFA为每个隐层用一个轻量非线性代理子网络生成反馈；并引入学习策略在训练中更新该子网络，使其更好地逼近真实的非线性变换。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SVHN、ImageNet上，于残差网络与视觉Transformer上一致优于现有DFA类方法，显著缩小与BP的差距，并保持高效并行训练。

Conclusion: 用可学习的非线性代理替代固定反馈矩阵是提升DFA有效性的关键，为兼顾生物合理性与并行训练提供了可行方向。

Abstract: Backpropagation (BP) remains the predominant algorithm for training deep neural networks, but it is biologically implausible and suffers from the backward locking problem, constraining parallelization across layers. Direct Feedback Alignment~(DFA), which propagates the global output error directly to each hidden layer via fixed feedback matrices, has emerged as a promising alternative for addressing these limitations. However, a significant performance gap persists between DFA and BP, which we attribute to the limited ability of fixed feedback matrices to capture the nonlinear transformation from hidden representations to the network output. To address this limitation, we propose Nonlinear Direct Feedback Alignment (NDFA), which constructs each hidden-layer feedback using a lightweight nonlinear surrogate subnetwork. To enhance the effectiveness of the feedback throughout training, we further propose a learning strategy to update the surrogate subnetwork, thereby better approximating the underlying nonlinear transformation. Extensive experiments across residual networks and vision transformers on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, and ImageNet datasets demonstrate that NDFA consistently outperforms existing DFA-based methods and substantially narrows the performance gap to BP, while maintaining efficient parallel training. The code is available at https://github.com/YanFan321/NDFA.

</details>


### [289] [Generative Refinement Learning for Temporal Interpolation in Scientific Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36751)
*Pu Ren,Michael W. Mahoney,N. Benjamin Erichson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: iFLEX 通过学习“残差”而非直接生成场来实现科学数据的时域超分辨率：先用时间加权平均做数值插值估计，再由条件扩散模型生成残差项加回，从而在湍流、雷达降水与海表温度数据上取得更低重建误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学仿真与观测数据的时间分辨率常低于下游任务需求；固定网格点平均会引入误差，而仅用运动/光流估计也无法确定物理场数值本身如何变化。因此需要研究“学习修正简单数值插值”能否改善中间时刻场的重建。

Method: 构造插值流专家（interpolative FLow EXpert, iFLEX）：1）在每个网格点对两个观测做时间加权平均，权重偏向目标时刻更近的观测，得到初始估计；2）训练时用真实中间场减去该估计得到残差，条件扩散模型学习生成该残差；3）模型以两个观测、目标时刻、观测间隔以及可用物理参数为条件；4）推理时将生成的残差与加权平均相加，得到未观测中间场。

Result: 在 Navier–Stokes Kraichnan 湍流、上海雷达降水与海表温度三套数据上，iFLEX 的重建误差均低于对比基线（含光流法与面向视频帧插值的扩散模型）。在 Reynolds 数 36,000 的受控湍流实验中，固定扩散骨干与训练设置，学习残差将相对 Frobenius 范数误差由直接生成场的约 13.7 降至 10.5。

Conclusion: 学习对简单时间插值结果的残差修正，比直接生成物理场更有效且更稳定，可作为科学数据时间插值的一种通用范式；代码已开源。

Abstract: Computationally expensive simulations and real-world observations often provide data at a lower temporal resolution than downstream tasks require. Averaging observations at fixed grid points can introduce errors, and motion estimates alone do not determine how the physical field values change. In this work, we study whether learning to correct a simple numerical interpolation improves the reconstruction of intermediate scientific fields. Our model, interpolative FLow EXpert (iFLEX), first estimates the missing field by taking a weighted average of the two observations at each grid point, giving more weight to the observation closer to the requested time. During training, subtracting this estimate from an observed intermediate field gives the residual that a conditional diffusion model learns to generate. Both observations condition the model, together with the target time, the interval between observations, and available physical parameters. To reconstruct an unobserved intermediate field, the generated residual is added to the weighted average. We evaluate iFLEX on Navier-Stokes Kraichnan turbulence, Shanghai radar precipitation, and sea surface temperature. Across these datasets, iFLEX achieves lower reconstruction error than the evaluated baselines, including optical-flow and diffusion models developed for video frame interpolation in computer vision. In a controlled turbulence comparison at a Reynolds number of 36,000, learning the residual reduces relative Frobenius norm error from about 13.7 for direct field generation to 10.5, with the diffusion backbone and training setup held fixed. Code is available at https://github.com/paulpuren/iflex.

</details>


### [290] [Robust LLM Data Selection via Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36755)
*Jia Gu,Liang Pang,Huawei Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出内容不变性梯度归因（CIGA）框架，缓解指令微调数据选择中梯度归因对表层形式（措辞、格式）的偏置，提升归因稳定性、下游性能并降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于梯度的数据归因被广泛用于LLM指令微调的高质量数据选择，通过样本对模型优化的影响力估计贡献。但现有全局梯度归因方法存在表层形式偏置：语义无关细节（措辞、格式）的微小改动会导致归因分数高度不一致，尽管内容实质未变。

Method: CIGA包含两步：(1) 识别既对归因有影响力、又在保语义表层扰动下梯度稳定的层，以削减梯度特征中的格式噪声；(2) 将上述归因信号与输入的语义表示动态融合，结合优化层影响力与内容层信息。

Result: 在多个基准上，CIGA在表层形式扰动下给出更稳定的排序，同时保持下游能力并提升平均性能；并降低了归因成本。

Conclusion: CIGA为LLM指令微调数据选择提供了一种鲁棒且高效的方法，兼顾归因稳定性、下游效果与计算开销。

Abstract: Gradient-based data attribution has become an important tool for high-quality data selection in the instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), as it estimates the contribution of training examples through their influence on model optimization. However, we find that existing global gradient attribution methods suffer from surface-form bias: minor changes to semantically irrelevant details, such as wording or formatting, can produce highly inconsistent attribution scores even when the underlying content remains unchanged. To address this issue, we propose Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution (CIGA), a robust framework for instruction data selection. CIGA first identifies layers whose gradients are both influential for attribution and stable under semantics-preserving surface-form perturbations, thereby reducing formatting noise in gradient features. It then dynamically fuses these attribution signals with semantic representations of the input, combining optimization-level influence with content-level information. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that CIGA produces more stable rankings under surface-form perturbations while preserving downstream capabilities and improving average performance. CIGA also reduces attribution cost, offering a robust and efficient approach to data selection for LLM instruction tuning.

</details>


### [291] [Does LLM Pre-Training Typically Occur at the Edge of Stability?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36778)
*Yuhang Cai,Haodong Wen,Haofeng Huang,Deyi Liu,Yiyuan Ma,Kaifeng Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视二次近似作为神经网络训练动力学模型的保真度，重点关注其在LLM训练中的失效模式，提出"凸性边缘"(EoC)现象并给出自适应优化器下EoS的推广定义，实验表明EoC普遍存在而EoS普遍但非普适。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二次近似是研究神经网络优化的常用视角，但近期证据（如全批量梯度下降中的Edge of Stability，最大Hessian特征值集中于2/η）与经典稳定性预测相矛盾，其预测有效性受到质疑；尤其在LLM训练中二次近似的失效模式尚缺乏系统刻画。

Method: 以二次近似为模型对比真实训练动力学：(1) 识别一种与学习率无关的失效模式——持续负曲率导致二次动力学发散而真实动力学稳定，命名为Edge of Convexity (EoC)；(2) 在剔除该LR无关不稳定性影响后，针对随机训练与自适应优化器提出EoS的推广定义：增大LR使二次动力学显著发散而真实动力学基本不变；(3) 在模型规模至787M的多组LLM预训练实验中验证。

Result: 在多种模型规模（至787M）的LLM预训练中：(1) EoC在所有预训练中均被观察到；(2) EoS普遍存在但非普适——当学习率足够小（如衰减后）或批量大小低于与临界批量大小正相关的阈值时，EoS消失。

Conclusion: 研究刻画了二次近似在何时以及如何失效：EoC是LLM预训练中普遍存在的LR无关失效模式，EoS则依赖LR与批量大小条件；这为理解真实训练动力学奠定了基础。

Abstract: Quadratic approximations provide a common lens for studying neural network optimization, but recent evidence challenges their predictive validity. In full-batch gradient descent with learning rate (LR) $η$, Cohen et al. (2021) observed the Edge of Stability (EoS), where the largest Hessian eigenvalue concentrates near $2/η$, seemingly at odds with classical stability conditions predicted by quadratic approximations. In this work, we revisit the fidelity of quadratic approximations as a model of neural network training dynamics, with a particular focus on their failure modes in LLM training. We first highlight a distinct failure mode of the quadratic approximation, where persistent negative curvature causes the quadratic dynamics to diverge regardless of the LR, even though the real dynamics remain stable. We term this phenomenon the Edge of Convexity (EoC). After removing the effect of this LR-independent instability, we then propose a generalized definition of Edge of Stability (EoS) for stochastic training with adaptive optimizers, based on whether increasing the LR induces significant divergence in the quadratic dynamics while leaving the real dynamics largely unchanged. Across different LLM pretraining runs with various model sizes up to 787M, we find that (1) EoC is always observed across LLM pretraining, and (2) EoS is also prevalent but not universal: it disappears when the LR becomes sufficiently small (e.g., after decay) or when the batch size falls below a critical threshold that has a positive correlation with the critical batch size. Together, these findings characterize when and how quadratic approximations fail and provide a foundation for future work on understanding training dynamics.

</details>


### [292] [HiLo-RD: Cross-Budget Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36901)
*Xiang Li,Chengting Yu,Jungang Li,Yilun Zheng,Junzhuo Li,Xingyao Zhang,Wenbo Su,Xuming Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 HiLo-RD，将同一模型大窗口下的教师状态与裁剪后的小窗口视图配对，并在已提交位置对齐隐表示，从而在不借助外部教师的情况下改善掩码扩散语言模型在有限生成预算下的准确率与提交顺序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）需同时决定"生成什么"与"在哪里提交"，由此产生两个耦合难题：推理尚未完成时就要预测有用内容，以及在何时固定会影响后续预测的答案 token。作者指出预算受限引发的"过早提交"（budget-induced premature commitment）：即便正确解在容量上可行，模型也会在窗口边界附近、中间步骤尚未解出前固定答案片段，这些片段成为后续预测的上下文并改写后续推理。现有后训练方法无法直接迁移同一模型在大窗口下所走的更优轨迹。

Method: HiLo-RD（High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation）：(1) 将大窗口教师状态与裁剪得到的小窗口视图配对；(2) 在所提交位置上匹配二者的隐藏表示。该监督无需外部教师，同时引导 token 预测与提交顺序。

Result: 在数学基准上提升低预算准确率并缩短回答；增益可迁移至代码生成且无需代码域训练。GSM8K 上准确率提升 9.4 个百分点，平均可读长度下降约 25%。注意力诊断与固定预算下的顺序干预实验支持所提出的机制。

Conclusion: 大窗口推理可改进小窗口解码；预算受限下的性能瓶颈可归因于提交顺序而非容量不足，表示层蒸馏是纠正过早提交的有效手段。

Abstract: We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget. Unlike autoregressive models, MDLMs choose both what to generate and where to commit it. This creates two coupled challenges: predicting useful content before reasoning is complete, and deciding when to fix answer tokens that shape later predictions. We identify budget-induced premature commitment: even when a correct solution fits, the model can fix answer fragments near the window boundary before resolving intermediate steps. These fragments become context for later predictions and redirect subsequent reasoning. Existing post-training methods do not directly transfer the stronger trajectories that the same model follows with a larger window. HiLo-RD addresses this gap by (1) pairing large-window teacher states with cropped small-window views and (2) matching their hidden representations at committed positions. This supervision guides both token prediction and commitment order without an external teacher. Across mathematics benchmarks, HiLo-RD improves low-budget accuracy and shortens responses; these gains extend to code generation without code-domain training. On GSM8K, accuracy rises by 9.4 percentage points as mean readable length falls by about 25%. Attention diagnostics and fixed-budget order interventions support the proposed mechanism. Together, these results show that large-window reasoning can improve small-window decoding.

</details>


### [293] [LLM knowledge for improved Out-of-Distribution Tabular Prediction - A Cross-Validated Regularisation Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36806)
*Sølve Langseth,Kristoffer Herland Hellton,Hugo L. Hammer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将大语言模型(LLM)诱导的系数先验作为正则化回归的收缩目标（替代零），可在部分表格数据集上改善分布外(OOD)预测，但收益主要体现为更好的正则化而非真正的迁移校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测模型在部署总体与训练总体不同时性能退化，而训练数据本身无法判断哪些特征-响应关系可迁移；专家诱导先验缓慢且难以规模化。因此探索LLM诱导的系数先验能否作为可扩展的替代方案。

Method: 在五个按真实协变量划分的表格数据集上，用LLM诱导的系数先验替代零作为正则化回归的收缩目标；仅通过源域交叉验证选择供应商与先验结构；并用损坏先验的对照实验归因收益来源。

Result: 五个数据集中有四个获益，OOD均方误差最多降低7.9%；24个先验结果中10个在常规置信水平下显著；单次部署的区间则宽得多。分类任务上收益体现在概率精度而非排序。候选先验间差异大于平均收益，交叉验证边际低于其自身噪声，选择只能避开最差先验而非找到最佳。三个数据集上域内精度提升与域外相当。

Conclusion: 仅在训练数据足够大、域内增益消失时，诱导知识才能确证改善迁移；总体而言先验的作用更接近更好的正则化而非偏移校正。

Abstract: Prediction models degrade when the deployment population differs from the one used to train them, and training data cannot say which feature-response relationships will transfer. Expert elicitation is slow and unscalable. We ask whether coefficient priors elicited from large language models (LLMs) improve out-of-distribution (OOD) prediction as the shrinkage target of a regularised regression instead of zero, across five tabular datasets split on real covariates, selecting providers and prior structures by source-domain cross-validation alone. The priors help on four of five datasets, by up to 7.9% OOD mean squared error, and ten of twenty-four prior-informed results resolve the mean improvement at conventional confidence; single-deployment intervals are much wider. On classification the gain is in probabilistic accuracy, not ranking, and control tests with corrupted priors attribute the benefit to feature-specific content rather than scale. Two findings temper this. Variation across candidate priors exceeds the average benefit, yet cross-validation margins fall below their own noise, so selection avoids the worst prior rather than finding the best. On three datasets the prior improves in-domain accuracy as much as out-of-domain, making it better regularisation than shift correction. Only where the training data are large enough that the in-domain gain disappears does elicited knowledge demonstrably improve transfer. Code, priors and results: https://github.com/hugohammer/llm-priors-ood.

</details>


### [294] [SetGRPO: Calibrating Grader-Induced Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36807)
*Jiale Huang,Zixu Li,Zhiwei Chen,Zhiheng Fu,Jinhe Bi,Yupeng Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SetGRPO，通过联合奖励集校准、几何引导安全恢复与选择性风险门控，控制评分器随机性导致的GRPO更新偏移与方向反转风险，在十个开放式基准上取得最高宏平均。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于评分规则的强化学习（rubric-based RL）利用细粒度评分器反馈训练大语言模型处理开放式任务，但评分器的随机性会改变GRPO更新，而这种影响无法仅由分数差异刻画。由于GRPO在响应组内联合归一化奖励，并将由此得到的训练系数与响应级梯度相乘，一个评分偏差会移动整组的系数，并引起依赖策略的更新变化；选择性执行还会进一步影响被保留更新的方向反转风险。

Method: SetGRPO包含三个模块：(a) 联合奖励集校准（Joint Reward Set Calibration），为训练系数构建联合不确定性集合；(b) 几何引导安全恢复（Geometry-Guided Safe Recovery），将候选系数映射到当前策略的局部更新几何中，并为每个响应组确定最大安全恢复比例；(c) 选择性风险门控优化（Selective Risk-Gated Optimization），通过独立风险校准选取全局阈值，在保持原始GRPO目标不变的前提下控制被接受更新的条件方向反转风险。

Result: 在可交换性假设下，SetGRPO为联合系数集提供有限样本边际覆盖，并在候选阈值间实现同时风险控制。在跨三个领域的十个开放式基准上，SetGRPO在Qwen3.5与Llama3.2两个模型族上均取得所有对比训练方法中最高的宏平均。

Conclusion: SetGRPO将评分器随机性建模为组级系数的联合不确定性，并从更新几何与选择性风险控制两个层面加以约束，为基于评分规则的GRPO训练提供了带统计保证的稳健性方案，且在多项开放式基准上验证了其优越性能。

Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning uses fine-grained grader feedback to train large language models on open-ended tasks, but grader randomness can alter GRPO updates in ways that score discrepancies alone cannot characterize. Because GRPO jointly normalizes rewards within each response group and combines the resulting training coefficients with response-level gradients, a scoring discrepancy can shift the coefficients of the entire group and induce policy-dependent update changes.
