Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Timestral系列（5M/28M/123M/209M）时间序列基础模型，通过三项设计在GIFT-Eval、TIME、fev-bench上取得SOTA，最大两模型各指标均列前二，权重与代码开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型在长horizon预测时需掩码上下文，且难以在因果架构下原生支持已知未来协变量；同时真实数据规模与多样性受限，制约预训练效果。

Method: 三个关键组件：(1) Decoupled Horizon Forecasting (DHF)，将预测token与因果编码的上下文解耦，长horizon训练无需掩码上下文，且每个观测值既是预测目标又是后续预测的上下文；(2) 协变量框架，在因果架构内原生支持已知未来协变量；(3) 两阶段流水线，先在大规模多样化合成语料上专门预训练，再在真实与合成混合数据上用扩展上下文做后训练。

Result: 在GIFT-Eval、TIME和fev-bench三个基准上刷新SOTA；Timestral-209M与Timestral-123M在所有指标上占据前两名。

Conclusion: 验证了解耦式horizon建模、因果原生协变量支持与合成优先的两阶段训练对概率预测的有效性；四个模型权重发布于Hugging Face，推理代码发布于GitHub。

Abstract: We introduce Timestral, a family of four time series foundation models for probabilistic forecasting, with 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameters. Timestral sets a new state of the art on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, where Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M take the top two places on every metric. We achieve this with three ingredients: Decoupled Horizon Forecasting (DHF), which separates prediction tokens from the causally encoded context, so that longer horizons are trained without masking context and each observed value is both a forecast target and context for later forecasts; a covariate framework that natively supports known-future covariates within a causal architecture; and a two-stage pipeline that pretrains exclusively on a diverse, large-scale synthetic corpus before post-training on a mix of real and synthetic data with extended context. This report describes the model design and its benchmark results. Weights for all four models are available on Hugging Face and inference code on GitHub.

</details>


### [455] [Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37624)
*Anouar Imel,Imad Charradi,Abderrahman Sghir,Khalil El Khammar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 CrossProfile 基准（60 模板、480 任务），将支持性、干扰性与无关事实的"归属"与"文本"解耦，检验 LLM 群体讨论压缩为短记忆时两种启发式（保稀 vs. 保相关）的有效性。实验表明二者均在意料之处失效：保相关会重新引入干扰项，保稀平均而言不优于随机；准确率取决于记忆保留的证据平衡而非选择策略，且决策模型存在"社会证明"偏置。更根本地，自然讨论中完整转录的准确率甚至低于无笔记。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 群体讨论需压缩为短记忆以供最终决策者使用，但"记忆该保留什么"缺乏可控诊断手段。hidden-profile 任务中"事实持有广度"与"是否有用"相互混淆，使得"保最稀有"和"保与决策标准相关"两种启发式看似都合理却无法区分其真实效用。

Method: 构建 CrossProfile 诊断基准：60 个模板、自动校验答案键；将支持性、干扰性、无关事实的归属关系与文本内容交叉（文本固定），共 480 个任务。在 Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B 及两个 DeepSeek 模型上对比保相关、保稀、随机选择等策略，并做归因标签移除/随机重分配与固定行序的消融。

Result: 保相关策略因干扰项在主题上相关而被重新引入，在经典 hidden-profile 配置下即使理想相关过滤器也落后保稀策略 23–31 分；保稀平均不优于随机，仅当稀有事实恰好有用时占优。准确率跟随记忆所保留的证据平衡，而非保留策略。决策模型对归属给多智能体的事实赋予额外权重：移除标签或在固定行序下随机重分配，使经典配置准确率提升 13–24 分。自然讨论中完整转录的准确率低于无笔记。

Conclusion: 记忆选择启发式的优劣取决于证据结构而非策略本身；决策阶段存在社会证明偏置，应削弱归属标签；且自然讨论中的证据在记忆介入前已丢失，说明瓶颈在于讨论生成端而非压缩环节。

Abstract: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average and wins only where the rare facts happen to be the useful ones. In both cases accuracy follows the balance of evidence the memory keeps, not the policy that kept it. The decision model adds a third failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to facts attributed to many agents. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random with line order fixed, raises accuracy in the classic configuration by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions the evidence is lost before any memory acts: the complete transcript yields lower accuracy than no notes at all.

</details>


### [456] [What Improves During Pretraining? Tracking Knowledge Acquisition with Point-in-Time Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37631)
*Chang Su,Bin Wu,Emine Yilmaz,Yao Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出时间变异性分数（TVS），用不同年份网页快照训练的时点模型度量知识在时间上的表示一致性，发现高TVS条目在预训练后期提升更快、最终表现反超低TVS条目（36个设置中34个胜出，平均高7.3个chance-normalized准确率）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于多年网页语料预训练的模型同时学到通用与领域知识，但这些知识在预训练过程中如何被习得尚不清楚；跨年份网页快照训练的"时点模型"为探测知识流行度随时间变化提供了手段，作者希望借此刻画不同时间稳定性知识的学习动态，超越聚合基准分数的局限。

Method: 定义TVS为某条目在多个时点模型上负对数似然（NLL）的变异系数；使用来自多个开源模型家族的6个模型、覆盖多样主题的6个基准进行评估，比较低/高TVS条目在预训练各阶段的chance-normalized准确率变化轨迹。

Result: 低TVS与高TVS条目在训练早期学习速度相近，但高TVS条目在后期提升更快；预训练结束时，高TVS条目在36个模型-基准设置中的34个优于低TVS条目，平均优势为7.3个chance-normalized准确率点；该模式在知识密集型任务上最稳健，即使控制条目难度相近仍成立。

Conclusion: 不同时间稳定性的知识在预训练中呈现不同的学习动态，时间变异性可作为诊断学习轨迹的指标，提供聚合基准分数之外的细粒度信息。

Abstract: Language models pretrained on web corpora collected over multiple years learn both general and domain-specific knowledge. How these different kinds of knowledge are learned as pretraining progresses remains unclear. Recent point-in-time models trained on web snapshots from different years provide a way to probe how knowledge prevalence varies over time. Using these models, we propose a temporal variability score (TVS), defined as the coefficient of variation of an item's negative log-likelihood across models. A higher score suggests that the knowledge may be less consistently represented across years of web text. We evaluate six benchmarks covering diverse topics using six models from multiple open-source model families. We find that low- and high-TVS items are learned similarly early in training, but high-TVS items improve faster later on. At the end of the pretraining run, high-TVS items outperform low-TVS items in 34 of 36 model-benchmark settings, with an average advantage of 7.3 points of chance-normalized accuracy. This pattern is most robust on knowledge-intensive tasks, even when comparing items of similar difficulty. Our findings reveal differences in how knowledge is learned over the course of pretraining, with temporal variability providing a diagnostic of these learning dynamics beyond aggregate benchmark scores.

</details>


### [457] [KPPax: preprocess differentiable kinetic ODE for machine learning in atmospheric chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37655)
*Wenqing Peng,Michael Boy,Zhi-Song Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KPPax 是一个将 KPP 语言化学机理转换为可微分、即时编译、可向量化 JAX 代码的动力学预处理器，实现了无需手写伴随代码的精确敏感性计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 KPP 生成的 Fortran/C 代码高效但无法融入机器学习所用的可微分编程框架，导致化学机理难以直接用于参数估计与物理—机器学习混合建模。

Method: 在 JAX 中实现 KPP 语言预处理器，以对数空间的稀疏运算计算速率定律以保持可微性，并借助 diffrax 的隐式求解器及前向/反向模式伴随积分刚性系统，从而获得精确敏感性。

Result: 基于 POLLU 基准机理的两项应用：一是由自动微分雅可比得到 Fisher 信息矩阵，在拟合前预测 25 个速率系数中哪些可辨识，含噪合成估计在约 30% 内验证了 9 个可辨识系数的预测不确定度，并揭示仅能约束比值的一类快速反应簇；二是神经网络排放清单订正，先离线用逐情景 4D-Var 反演训练，再通过化学模型在线微调，使生物源订正误差降低 2.4–5 倍，并恢复了单个反演所丢失的低温排放信息。

Conclusion: KPPax 使 KPP 机理可直接用于参数估计与物理—机器学习混合建模。

Abstract: Atmospheric chemical mechanisms are commonly distributed in the language of the Kinetic PreProcessor (KPP), which generates efficient Fortran or C code but does not fit into the differentiable programming frameworks in which machine-learning models are developed. We present KPPax, a kinetic preprocessor that generates differentiable, just-in-time compiled, and vectorisable chemistry code in JAX from mechanisms written in the KPP language. KPPax evaluates the rate law with sparse operations in log space, which keeps it differentiable, and integrates the stiff system with the implicit solvers and the forward- and reverse-mode adjoints of the \texttt{diffrax} library, so that exact sensitivities are obtained without hand-derived adjoint code. We demonstrate two applications with the POLLU benchmark mechanism. In the first, the Fisher information matrix computed from an automatically differentiated Jacobian predicts, before any fit, which of the 25 rate coefficients a flow-tube-like design can identify, and noisy synthetic estimation confirms the predicted uncertainties of the nine identifiable rate coefficients to within about 30\% while revealing clusters of fast reactions of which only ratios are constrained. In the second, a neural-network correction of an emission inventory is trained offline on per-scenario 4D-Var retrievals and then fine-tuned online through the chemical model, which reduces the error of the biogenic correction by a factor of 2.4--5 and recovers information on low-temperature emissions that the individual retrievals lose. KPPax makes KPP mechanisms directly usable for parameter estimation and hybrid physics--machine-learning modelling.

</details>


<div id='physics.optics'></div>

# physics.optics [[Back]](#toc)

### [458] [Theoretical study of high-order harmonic generation in solids based on deep-learning methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35991)
*Wen-Feng Huang,Jia-Qi Liu,Xue-Bin Bian*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作将分子动力学与基于深度学习的紧束缚电子哈密顿量相结合，构建了可处理大规模非晶体系且具从头算精度的高次谐波产生（HHG）计算方法，并揭示了体硅中随谐波阶数变化的反向热响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固体HHG可提供紧凑相干的极紫外辐射，但现有激光—晶体相互作用理论方法难以兼顾大规模非晶体系的处理能力与从头算精度，主要受限于巨大计算开销。

Method: 将分子动力学与基于深度学习构建的紧束缚电子哈密顿量耦合，实现高效的多尺度模拟；先在单层六方氮化硼（h-BN）上以现有方法所得HHG谱为基准验证精度，随后用于研究体硅中温度依赖的HHG。

Result: 发现谐波阶数依赖的热响应：随温度升高，低阶谐波增强而高阶谐波被抑制。低阶增强源于体系格点间跃迁积分的改变，高阶抑制主要源于热效应引起的结构无序，且与实验观测一致。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了可扩展的固体HHG计算策略，并为晶格涨落与超快电子动力学之间相互作用提供了新认识。

Abstract: High-order harmonic generation (HHG) in solids provides a compact and coherent EUV radiation, which has attracted considerable attention. Many theoretical methods for laser-crystal interactions are developed. However, an approach to treat large-scale amorphous systems with ab-initio accuracy is still lacking because of the enormous computational cost. Here, we incorporate molecular dynamics and tight-binding electron Hamiltonians based on deep-learning methods to solve the problem efficiently. Its accuracy is validated by comparing the HHG spectra of monolayer hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) with those obtained using existing methods. Then we use it to study the temperature-dependent HHG in bulk Si. We uncover a distinct harmonic-order-dependent thermal response: low-order harmonics are enhanced with increasing temperature, whereas high-order harmonics are suppressed. The former is caused by the modification of the inter-site hopping in the system, while the latter is mainly influenced by the structural disorder induced by the thermal effects, in agreement with experimental observations. This work establishes a scalable computational strategy for investigating HHG in solids and provides new insights into the interplay between lattice fluctuations and ultrafast electron dynamics.

</details>


### [459] [Parameter-Decoupled Superresolution with Airy-Disk-Informed Learning: Application to NGC 4486B](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36021)
*James Qu,Isabella L. Lee,Gang Zhang,Abdelali Sajia,Yashashree Jadhav,Xiao-Feng Qian*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该论文基于艾里振幅的Hermite–Gaussian (HG) 投影，证明了在对称双源模型下等纵向宇称模概率之比可精确消去亮度、相干性与相位等干扰参数，并据此设计"艾里信息CNN"实现亚分辨双源间距估计，在一维切线上给出解析多比值反演、二维圆瞳获得精确有限瞳重叠积分，合成图像上误差比高斯PSF近似小10倍，并应用于NGC 4486B双核的HST存档图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当源亮度、相互相干性、相位均未知，且点扩散函数(PSF)偏离高斯时，从强度图像估计两个未分辨或近未分辨源的间距非常困难；现有高斯PSF近似在真实艾里衍射受限系统下建模失配，导致间距估计偏差大。

Method: 对一维与二维艾里振幅做Hermite–Gaussian投影，证明在对称双源模型下等纵向宇称模概率比与亮度、相干性、相位无关（解析不变量）；对一维艾里切片导出显式多比值间距反演公式；对二维圆瞳PSF推导精确有限瞳重叠积分并给出局部可逆的间距响应；进而以这些解析不变量为物理先验构建艾里信息卷积神经网络(Airy-informed CNN)，在已知间距的合成艾里图像上训练评估，并应用于HST存档的NGC 4486B双核图像。

Result: 在150,000张训练图像下，平均绝对误差约0.018（图示间距单位），比非艾里高斯PSF近似的0.18好约10倍；对NGC 4486B双核的HST图像，训练集100,000–150,000时估计约9.6–12.0 pc，与历史约12 pc结果大致一致。

Conclusion: 论文区分了"精确的光学模式干扰参数消去"与"仅图像学习估计器的经验鲁棒性"，并指出PSF失配与延展星系结构所施加的精度极限。

Abstract: Estimating the separation of two unresolved or nearly unresolved sources from recorded intensity images is difficult when source brightness, mutual coherence, and phase are unknown and the point-spread function (PSF) departs from a Gaussian. We formulate Hermite--Gaussian (HG) projections of one- and two-dimensional Airy amplitudes and prove that ratios of mode probabilities with equal longitudinal parity exactly cancel the brightness, coherence, and phase nuisance parameters under a symmetric two-source model. For a one-dimensional Airy slice we achieve an explicit multi-ratio separation inversion. For the physical two-dimensional circular-pupil PSF we obtain exact finite-pupil overlap integrals and locally invertible separation responses. Motivated by these analytical invariants, we examine Airy-informed convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on synthetic Airy images with known separations. At 150,000 training images, the approximate mean absolute errors are 0.018 in plotted separation units, 10 times better comparing to 0.18 for non-Airy Gaussian PSF approximation. Applied to an archival Hubble Space Telescope image of the double nucleus of NGC 4486B, the Airy-informed CNN gives estimates of approximately 9.6--12.0 pc for training sets of 100,000--150,000 images, broadly consistent with the historical approximately 12 pc value. We distinguish exact optical-mode nuisance cancellation from empirical robustness of an image-only learned estimator and identify the limits imposed by PSF mismatch and extended galaxy structure.

</details>


### [460] [Ultrafast light-electron modulation for free-electron quantum optics: fundamentals and applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36182)
*Zirui Zhao,Ruoyu Chen,Changying Li,Yongcheng Ding,Zhaopin Chen,Xinbing Song,Shuaishuai Sun,Ye Tian,Kangpeng Wang,Yiming Pan*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出统一的"光-电子调制"(LEM)框架，将光学近场视为自由电子波包的可编程相位调制器，把PINEM、Raman-Nath/Bragg衍射、DLA类加速与反常PINEM统一为同一调制图像的极限情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PINEM、KDE、DLA等技术已实现强光-电子耦合，但纵向能量调制、横向动量转移与波包相关衍射通常由彼此独立的模型描述，缺乏统一图景，难以支撑器件级设计。

Method: 构建LEM统一框架，将光学近场建模为自由电子波包的相位调制器，据此区分纵向与横向调制通道，分别类比电光相位调制与声光衍射，并分析其依赖波包尺寸、反冲、相位匹配与光场几何的规律。

Result: 在该框架下，PINEM、Raman-Nath与Bragg衍射、DLA类加速及反常PINEM被组织为共同调制图像的极限区域，纵向/横向通道分别对应电光相位调制和声光衍射类比。

Conclusion: LEM框架为可调控能谱、时间密度、横向波前及电子-光子量子界面的自由电子调制器提供设计原则，确立其为可编程飞秒至阿秒物质波控制的器件级平台。

Abstract: Coherent optical modulation of free-electron wavepackets offers a route to ultrafast beam steering, energy exchange, temporal compression, and quantum-state shaping. Recent advances in photon-induced near-field electron microscopy (PINEM), ultrafast Kapitza-Dirac effect (KDE) and dielectric laser acceleration (DLA) have demonstrated strong light-electron coupling, but longitudinal energy modulation, transverse momentum transfer, and wavepacket-dependent diffraction are still commonly described with separate models. Here, we develop a unified Light-Electron Modulation (LEM) framework that treats optical near fields as programmable phase modulators for free-electron wavepackets. Within this framework, we identify longitudinal and transverse modulation channels, analogous to electro-optic phase modulation and acousto-optic diffraction of light, respectively, and show how their operation depends on wavepacket extent, recoil, phase matching, and optical-field geometry. This formulation organizes PINEM, Raman-Nath and Bragg diffraction, DLA-like acceleration, and anomalous PINEM as limiting regimes of a common modulation picture. The resulting framework provides design principles for free-electron modulators that can control energy spectra, temporal density, transverse wavefronts, and electron-photon quantum interfaces, establishing LEM as a device-level platform for programmable femtosecond-to-attosecond matter-wave control.

</details>


### [461] [Multi-day single-cell magnetic imaging of living cancer cells using Quantum Cell Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36359)
*Andre Pointner,Sarah Belasi,Regine Schneider-Stock,Roland Nagy*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出量子细胞监测（QCM）——一种宽场氮空位（NV）磁测量平台，将单细胞信息编码于杂散磁场而非发射光子，在亚细胞分辨率下读出，实现对磁标记活癌细胞的长达72小时连续追踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学显微（荧光、共聚焦、多光子）依赖发射光子承载细胞信息，但光子在生物样品中散射与衰减限制深度分辨率，且激发光引起光损伤，扰动被观测的生物学过程本身。磁场在细胞尺度可无衰减穿透生物样品，然而传统MRI无法分辨单个细胞。因此需要一个兼具磁学穿透优势与单细胞分辨能力的成像手段。

Method: 构建宽场NV金刚石磁测量平台QCM，以杂散磁场作为单细胞信息的载体，在亚细胞分辨率下读出；与专用活细胞培养箱集成，对磁标记的活癌细胞进行长时间成像追踪。

Result: 实现长达72小时的活癌细胞连续追踪，依据个体磁场特征识别单细胞；可捕捉单细胞有丝分裂与形态重塑，以及细胞簇形成、分裂与迁移，包括明场对比度失效的密集区域。

Conclusion: 将单细胞信息载体由传播光光子转为静态杂散磁场，使细胞监测摆脱光学可及性与自发荧光的限制，可在光学显微无法胜任的条件下实现持续活细胞观测。

Abstract: Live-cell imaging of cellular and tissue samples relies predominantly on optical modalities, such as fluorescence, confocal, and multiphoton microscopy, in which cellular information is encoded in emitted photons. Photons scatter and attenuate in biological samples, restricting depth resolution, while the excitation light required to produce them induces photodamage that perturbs the very biology under observation. Magnetic fields, by contrast, traverse biological samples without attenuation at cellular length scales, but the imaging modality that extracts the encoded information, magnetic resonance imaging, cannot resolve individual cells. Here we present Quantum Cell Monitoring (QCM), a widefield nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry platform that encodes single-cell information in stray magnetic fields rather than emitted photons and reads it out at subcellular resolution. Integrated with a specialized live-cell incubator, QCM tracks magnetically labeled living cancer for up to 72 h through their individual magnetic field signatures. It captures single-cell mitosis and morphological remodeling, as well as cell cluster formation, splitting, and migration even within dense regions where brightfield contrast collapses. By shifting the carrier of single-cell information from propagating optical photons to static magnetic stray fields, QCM decouples cell from cellular optical accessibility and auto-fluorescence, enabling sustained live-cell observation in regimes inaccessible to optical microscopy.

</details>


### [462] [High-Efficiency Graphene Oxide Moiré Lenses Enabled by Cyclic Self-Assembly and Laser Nanoprinting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36373)
*Guiyuan Cao,Xinyuan Du,Han Lin,Baohua Jia,Shibiao Wei*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种循环、无掩模制备策略，将GO/PDDA层层自组装与飞秒激光纳米打印结合，实现多级相位GO透镜，聚焦效率随相位级数由22.4%（2级）提升至54.8%（6级），并制成可实现10–90 mm连续焦距调谐、1X–9X全彩成像的GO莫尔透镜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑型连续可调焦光学系统在机器视觉、生物医学成像与微型相机中需求强烈。旋转莫尔透镜提供平面化调焦途径，但基于超表面的实现依赖复杂纳米加工，难以大面积制备，因此需要一种低成本、可扩展的替代工艺。

Method: 采用循环式无掩模工艺流程：二维氧化石墨烯（GO）与聚二甲基二烯丙基氯化铵（PDDA）逐层自组装，配合飞秒激光空间选择性烧蚀；通过重复组装—烧蚀实现原子级厚度控制与精确多级相位轮廓构建，降低相位量化误差。

Result: 单元GO透镜聚焦效率由2级相位的22.4%提升至6级相位的54.8%；基于六级调制制备的GO莫尔透镜实现约10–90 mm的连续焦距调谐，并实验演示1X至9X放大倍率的全彩成像。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了面向高效多级GO平面光学元件的循环无掩模制备策略，展示了其在紧凑、可重构成像系统中的潜力。

Abstract: Compact optical systems with continuously tunable focal lengths are highly desirable for machine vision, biomedical imaging, and miniaturized cameras. Rotational Moiré lenses offer a planar approach to focal-length tuning, but metasurface-based implementations typically require complex nanofabrication processes that complicate large-area production. Here, we present a cyclic, mask-free fabrication strategy that combines layer-by-layer self-assembly of two-dimensional graphene oxide (GO) and poly(diallyldimethylammonium chloride) (PDDA) with femtosecond laser nanoprinting. Repeated GO-PDDA assembly and spatially selective ablation enable atomic-scale thickness control and the construction of precise multilevel phase profiles, reducing phase-quantization errors and improving focusing efficiency. The measured focusing efficiencies of individual GO lenses increase from 22.4% for two phase levels to 54.8% for six levels. Using this six-level modulation strategy, the fabricated GO Moiré lens achieves continuous focal-length tuning from approximately 10 to 90 mm. Full-colour imaging with magnifications ranging from 1X to 9X is experimentally demonstrated. These results establish a cyclic, mask-free fabrication strategy for efficient multilevel GO flat optics and demonstrate its potential for compact, reconfigurable imaging.

</details>


### [463] [Optically gated transduction enables silicon electrical readout of mid-infrared light](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36475)
*Shutao Zhang,Jiaqing Shen,Chongwu Wang,Jiahui Xu,Wei Chen,Qing Yang Steve Wu,Yan Liu,Xie Yuen Gok,Febiana Tjiptoharsono,Xiaogang Liu,Qi Jie Wang,Joel K. W. Yang,Jinfeng Zhu,Zhaogang Dong*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出"光门控换能"策略：用中红外光子调制已建立的激发态而非直接产生光生载流子，在硅基超表面上实现室温零偏压中红外探测（6.8 μm，调制响应度103 μA/W）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硅的1.1 eV带隙从根本上限制了中红外光子通过价带到导带的直接激发实现高效探测；现有方案依赖增强亚带隙吸收或引入外部红外吸收材料，均未跳出"让硅吸收红外"的思路。

Method: 将Nd³⁺掺杂镧系纳米颗粒与逆设计的Al/p-Si超表面集成，超表面支持双共振，同时增强近红外光门控并共振耦合入射中红外辐射；中红外照明重分布Nd³⁺的发射通道，产生的光态变化经硅肖特基结转换为电信号。

Result: 实现室温、零偏压、6.8 μm的中红外探测，调制响应度达103 μA/W；可将门控与中红外组合输入解耦为三个电学可区分的电流态。

Conclusion: 该工作不追求将硅吸收拓展至红外，而是确立门控光换能作为在硅平台上读取中红外光学信息的途径，为集成红外传感、信号处理与可编程光子系统提供新方向。

Abstract: Silicon is the dominant platform for integrated photonics, yet its wide electronic bandgap of 1.1 eV fundamentally prevents efficient detection of mid-infrared (MIR) photons through direct valence band to conduction band excitation. Existing approaches therefore seek to enhance sub-bandgap absorption or introduce external infrared absorbers. Here we demonstrate a profoundly different detection strategy based on optically gated transduction, in which MIR photons modulate a pre-established excitation state rather than directly generating photocarriers. Our device integrates Nd3+-doped lanthanide nanoparticles with an inverse-designed Al/p-Si metasurface supporting dual resonances that simultaneously enhances optical gating in the near infrared and resonantly couples incident MIR radiation. The MIR illumination redistributes the Nd3+ emission pathways, producing an optical-state change that is converted into an electrical signal through a silicon Schottky junction. The device achieves room-temperature zero-bias detection at 6.8 um with a modulation responsivity of 103 uA/W and resolves combined gate and MIR inputs into three electrically distinguishable current states. Rather than extending silicon absorption into the infrared, this work establishes gated optical transduction as a route for reading MIR optical information on a silicon platform, opening opportunities for integrated infrared sensing, signal processing and programmable photonic systems.

</details>


### [464] [Study of Multilayer TiNx/Ti/TiNx Films Formed In Situ for High-Efficiency Integrated Microheaters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37130)
*Oleg A. Solovyev,Zakhar S. Enbaev,Alexander R. Shevchenko,Aleksander M. Mumlyakov,Pavel A. Berezhnoy,Mikael O. Geodakyan,Mikhail V. Tsvetkov,Michael A. Tarkhov,Igor V. Trofimov*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文提出单真空循环内原位生成三层TiNx/Ti/TiNx功能材料的技术，并研究其结构与电物理性能；临界功率密度约140 MW/cm²，90%临界功率下连续工作24小时，SiO_x保护层改变电热工作 regime 并使温度达约500–700 ℃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要一种可在单真空循环内原位形成多层功能材料的技术，以避免界面污染并提升薄膜微桥器件的功率承载与高温工作能力。

Method: 在单一真空循环中原位沉积三层TiNx/Ti/TiNx结构；对微桥进行结构表征与电物理测试，测试临界功率密度、连续工作寿命，并对比无保护层与带SiO_x保护层微桥的电热特性。

Result: 最大临界功率密度约140 MW/cm²；在90%临界功率下连续工作24小时仍保持功能；SiO_x涂层改变微桥电热工作 regime，估算温度可达约500–700 ℃。

Conclusion: 单真空循环原位制备的TiNx/Ti/TiNx三层材料具有高功率耐受与长时稳定性，SiO_x保护层可作为调控电热工作 regime 与工作温度的有效手段。

Abstract: A technology for the in situ formation of a three-layer TiN$_x$/Ti/TiN$_x$ functional material within a single vacuum cycle is presented, together with the results of investigations of its structural and electrophysical properties. The maximum critical power density reached approximately 140 MW/cm$^2$. Under continuous operation at 90% of the critical power, the structures remained operational for 24 h. The characteristics of microbridges without and with a protective SiO$_x$ layer were compared. The presence of the coating modifies the electrothermal operating regime of the structures and enables estimated temperatures of approximately 500-700 degrees Celsius to be reached.

</details>


### [465] [Channel-Differentiated Topological Charge Flips and Formation of Janus Bound States in the Continuum in Single-Layer Photonic Lattices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37168)
*Sun-Goo Lee,Wook-Jae Lee*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 利用耦合模分析推导一维单层光子晶格中对称保护BIC拓扑电荷的解析表达式，统一描述合并诱导与能带翻转诱导的电荷翻转，并揭示垂直对称性破缺下两辐射通道电荷相反的Janus BIC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BIC的拓扑电荷在与其它偏振奇点合并时或能带翻转时可发生翻转，但缺乏将拓扑电荷与能带结构、通道分辨辐射振幅直接联系起来的解析描述，也缺少对上下辐射通道差异化行为的系统理解。

Method: 采用耦合模理论分析一维单层光子晶格，推导对称保护BIC拓扑电荷的解析表达式；分析能带翻转过程中圆偏振线的形成；引入垂直对称性破缺使电荷翻转通道差异化；并在实验可实现的一维和二维硅基光子晶格中验证Janus BIC。

Result: 解析表达式同时涵盖合并诱导与能带翻转诱导的电荷翻转；能带翻转时BIC拓扑电荷反转并伴随在Γ点交叉的圆偏振线；垂直对称晶格中电荷翻转在上下通道同时发生；破缺垂直对称性后两类翻转均通道差异化，出现两通道携带相反拓扑电荷的Janus BIC参数区间，并在硅基一维、二维晶格中复现。

Conclusion: 将BIC拓扑电荷直接与能带结构和通道分辨辐射振幅相联系，为偏振奇点的通道选择性调控奠定基础。

Abstract: The topological charge of a bound state in the continuum (BIC) can flip when the BIC merges with other polarization singularities or, as recently shown, at band flips. Here, using a coupled-mode analysis, we derive an analytical expression for the topological charge of symmetry-protected BICs in one-dimensional single-layer photonic lattices. The expression captures both merging-induced and band-flip-induced charge flips. We find that, during a band flip, the topological charge of the BIC reverses with the formation of lines of circular polarization that cross at the $Γ$ point. In vertically symmetric lattices, each charge flip occurs simultaneously in the upward and downward radiation channels. Breaking vertical symmetry makes both kinds of charge flips channel-differentiated, creating a parameter interval in which the BIC carries opposite topological charges in the two channels and forms a Janus BIC. We show that Janus BICs also emerge in experimentally accessible one- and two-dimensional silicon-based photonic lattices. Our results link the topological charge of a BIC directly to the band structure and the channel-resolved radiation amplitudes and establish a basis for channel-selective control of polarization singularities.

</details>


### [466] [Wavefunction-templated metamaterials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37248)
*Yutao Chen,Tao Xiao,Jing Li,Aodong Li,Biye Xie*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出"波函数模板化超材料"(wavefunction-templated metamaterials)，通过构造满足边界律的稀疏哈密顿量并经厄米化与谱整形，在可物理实现的超材料中嵌入任意指定、谱孤立的特征态，并在离散晶格与声学超材料中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统超材料的特征模空间分布由预设结构（哈密顿量）决定，难以实现任意指定的本征态。作者希望让超材料直接承载"处方化"的特征态，实现对波函数形状的自由设计。

Method: 构造波函数模板：以目标本征态为输入反推哈密顿量的几何构型，所得哈密顿量服从边界律——所需非局域性仅由单接触边界格点决定，与态内部及晶格尺寸无关；随后对稀疏哈密顿量进行厄米化处理，并通过谱整形在目标本征态周围打开保护性带隙以隔离该态；在离散晶格与声学超材料中验证。

Result: 成功实现承载多样处方化、谱孤立本征态的可物理实现超材料；哈密顿量保持稀疏，非局域需求仅依赖边界单接触位点；经厄米化与谱整形后目标态获得保护性带隙；在离散晶格与声学超材料中均获验证。

Conclusion: 波函数模板化超材料提供了一种通用设计范式，虽在声学中演示，但其原理可推广至热学、电路与光子超材料，实现任意特征态的可控嵌入式设计。

Abstract: Metamaterials, which store, guide and emit waves through their eigenmodes, have enabled the development of devices with unprecedented functionalities. Yet the spatial profiles of conventional metamaterials' eigenmodes are typically determined by their pre-determined structures (Hamiltonians). In this work, we introduce `wavefunction-templated metamaterials', a class of physically realizable metamaterials hosting diverse prescribed, spectrally isolated eigenstates. The resulting Hamiltonian geometries obey a boundary law, with the required nonlocality determined solely by single-contact boundary sites, independent of the state interior or lattice size. The sparse Hamiltonians are then Hermitianized, followed by spectral reshaping to open a protective gap around the target eigenstate. We validate our approach in discrete lattices and acoustic metamaterials. Although demonstrated in acoustics, the principle can be applied to thermal, electrical-circuit and photonic metamaterials.

</details>


### [467] [Rubidium-Referenced Frequency-Doubled Pockels Laser with High-Speed Electro-Optic Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37279)
*Xu Chen,Michael Li,Xiaodong Shi,Lin Zhou,Ran Yang,Mengyao Zhao,Veerendra Dhyani,Sakthi Sanjeev Mohanraj,Guangxing Wu,Hao Hao,Xia Yu,Di Zhu*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文演示了混合集成 InP/薄膜铌酸锂 Pockels 激光器，经由腔内二次谐波产生输出 780 nm 光，兼具 kHz 级本征线宽与超过 1 GHz 的电光调频带宽。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原子物理与量子技术需要兼具窄线宽与快速频率控制的可见光波段激光源，但芯片集成方案难以同时满足这两点。

Method: 将周期极化铌酸锂（PPLN）波导嵌入由扩展分布布拉格反射镜（DBR）构成的激光腔中，DBR 仅在 1560 nm 基频处提供电光可调反馈，形成单共振腔以实现腔内倍频；二次谐波输出随快速调谐而无需共振对准。

Result: 1560 nm 与 780 nm 处本征线宽分别为 2.7 kHz 和 9.0 kHz，两波长电光调谐带宽均超过 1 GHz；780 nm 处无跳模调谐范围 6.48 GHz，可直接对铷 D2 线进行光谱测量；锁定后二次谐波频率波动标准差由 135 MHz 降至 8 MHz，并将原子频率参考传递至基频。

Conclusion: 集成倍频 Pockels 激光器可作为紧凑、快速可调的相干光源，有望简化未来原子与量子光子系统的光学架构。

Abstract: Narrow-linewidth lasers with rapid frequency control are essential for atomic physics and quantum technologies, yet combining these capabilities in chip-integrated sources at visible wavelengths remains challenging. Here we demonstrate a hybrid integrated InP/thin-film lithium niobate Pockels laser that emits at 780 nm through intracavity second-harmonic generation and supports gigahertz-bandwidth frequency tuning. A periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide is embedded in a laser cavity terminated by an extended distributed Bragg reflector, which provides electro-optically tunable feedback only at the 1560 nm fundamental wavelength. This design yields a singly resonant cavity that enhances frequency conversion while allowing the second-harmonic output to follow rapid tuning without resonance alignment. The laser achieves intrinsic linewidths of 2.7 kHz at 1560 nm and 9.0 kHz at 780 nm, with electro-optic tuning bandwidths beyond 1 GHz at both wavelengths. A mode-hop-free tuning range of 6.48 GHz at 780 nm enables direct spectroscopy of the rubidium D2 transition. Locking the second-harmonic output to this transition reduces the standard deviation of its frequency fluctuations from 135 MHz to 8 MHz and transfers the atomic frequency reference to the fundamental. These results establish integrated frequency-doubled Pockels lasers as compact, rapidly tunable sources that could simplify the optical architectures for future atomic and quantum photonic systems.

</details>


### [468] [Surface-Illuminated Interdigitated Ge-on-Si Avalanche Photodiode With Separated Ge Absorption, Si Multiplication, and Lateral Field Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37593)
*Mason Clewis,Kuang-Yun Tu,Ching-Yu Hsu,Zingway Pei*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种台面入射式横向Ge-on-Si叉指SACM雪崩光电二极管，通过横向场工程将雪崩倍增限制在Si中，在1550 nm实现11.81 A/W峰值响应度、-20 V下3.796倍增增益与7.13 GHz带宽，GBP达27.07 GHz。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1550 nm探测用Ge-on-Si APD面临高场易穿透至Ge/Si异质界面、引发界面处过早击穿与暗电流增大的问题，需在保持高速与高增益的同时抑制该效应。

Method: 设计横向叉指式SACM结构（Ge吸收区/Si倍增区分离），对本征区间距、P⁻电荷控制区宽度及指状几何进行工程化设计；结合TCAD仿真分析电场分布、暗电流与雪崩开启电压随结构参数的变化，并制作器件进行1550 nm光电测试（响应度、增益、带宽、GBP及光功率相关增益压缩）。

Result: 仿真表明加宽电荷控制区或本征区可降低固定偏压暗电流、使雪崩开启电压向更高反偏移动；最优结构（本征区间距/P⁻宽度=0.5/0.15 μm）在1550 nm下峰值响应度11.81 A/W，-20 V时倍增增益3.796、3-dB带宽7.13 GHz、匹配偏压GBP 27.07 GHz；光功率相关测量观察到与空间电荷屏蔽一致的增益压缩。

Conclusion: 横向场工程可有效将倍增区局域于Si一侧，验证了该结构用于高速、台面入射式Ge-on-Si APD的可行性。

Abstract: This work presents a surface-illuminated lateral Ge-on-Si interdigitated separate-absorption-charge-multiplication (SACM) avalanche photodiode for 1550-nm detection. The intrinsic-region spacing, P$^-$ charge-control width, and finger geometry are engineered to suppress high-field penetration toward the Ge/Si heterointerface and localize avalanche multiplication in Si. Simulations show that wider charge-control or intrinsic regions reduce fixed-bias dark current and shift avalanche onset to higher reverse bias. Among the tested structures, the intrinsic-region spacing/P$^-$ charge-control width of 0.5/0.15 $μ$m achieved a peak responsivity of 11.81 A/W at 1550 nm. At a -20 V applied voltage, it exhibited a multiplication gain of 3.796, a 3-dB bandwidth of 7.13 GHz, and a matched-bias gain-bandwidth product of 27.07 GHz. Optical-power-dependent measurements also show avalanche-gain compression consistent with space-charge screening. These results demonstrate effective lateral-field engineering for high-speed, surface-illuminated Ge-on-Si APDs.

</details>


### [469] [Catastrophes in Reconnections of Optical Vortex Rings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37615)
*Zhamila Kulchukova,Albert Ferrando,Anton S. Desyatnikov*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文从灾变理论视角研究椭圆高斯光束中光学涡环的拓扑构型，识别出尖点（cusp）与蝴蝶（butterfly）两类灾变，在灾变点附近椭圆形变的微小改变即可引起涡环拓扑的剧烈重构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数微扰通常只引起结果的小变化，但动力系统中也存在小扰动触发结构剧变的情形（涡环可重连、成核或坍缩为点）。这类"退化临界点"正是灾变理论（分岔理论的一支）的研究对象。作者希望把灾变理论引入光学涡旋拓扑研究，定位导致涡环拓扑突变的特定光束参数。

Method: 对椭圆高斯光束中光学涡环的拓扑构型进行理论研究：以光束参数（椭圆形变、相位等）为控制变量，分析涡环形成与演化的退化临界点，并依据灾变理论对临界点进行分类，识别出尖点型与蝴蝶型两类灾变。

Result: 在特定光束参数处，涡环拓扑发生剧烈变化；确认存在尖点与蝴蝶两类灾变，其附近椭圆形变的极小改变即可导致涡环发生复杂的拓扑变换（如重连、成核、坍缩）。

Conclusion: 椭圆高斯光束中涡环拓扑的突变可由灾变理论统一描述，尖点与蝴蝶灾变是控制涡环拓扑转换的关键参数点，为涡旋光束拓扑的精确调控提供了理论依据。

Abstract: A small change in parameters leads to a small change in the outcomes, in most cases. For instance, an optical vortex ring, created in the superposition of two laser beams, can slightly shrink if the phase changes minutely. However, dynamical systems can also experience significant changes due to small perturbations in parameters; the vortex rings can reconnect, nucleate or collapse into a point. Parameters that cause such striking outcomes are at the focal point of catastrophe theory - a branch of bifurcation theory that studies degenerate critical points of a potential function. We present theoretical study of topological configurations of optical vortex rings in elliptic Gaussian beams, which change dramatically at specific beam parameters. We identify two types of catastrophes, cusp and butterfly, near which very small changes of elliptic deformations lead to complex topological transformations of vortex rings.

</details>
